# Biographies of Dǒng, Two Yuán, Liú

## Dǒng Zhuó {.unnumbered #dongzhuo}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Dǒng Zhuó appellation Zhòngyǐng was a Lǒngxī Líntáo man.^[Dǒng Zhuó also has a biography in Hòu Hàn shū 72.] <a href="#annotation-1" id="source-1">[1]</a> From youth he enjoyed vigilantism,^[Vigilantes (xià) were individuals of martial abilities who followed their own justice. Compare with European knight-errants or Japanese rōnin.] once roamed among the Qiāng, completely with their various leaders forming bonds. Later he returned to plow in the wilds, of the leaders some came to join him, [Dǒng] Zhuó with them together returned, and he killed his plowing ox to feast and entertain them. The various leaders were emotionally moved by his intentions, returned home and gathered together various livestock of over a thousand heads to gift to [Dǒng] Zhuó. <a href="#annotation-2" id="source-2">[2]</a> At Hàn Emperor Huán's end, as a son of a respectable family of the six prefectures he became a Feather Forest Cadet.^[The six prefectures of Lǒngxī, Tiānshuǐ, Āndìng, Běidì, Shàngjùn, and Xīhé formed the northwestern border of the Hàn Empire. Feather Forest (yǔlín) was a division of the Imperial guard in the capital city.] [Dǒng] Zhuó had talent and martial ability, in strength few could compare, a pair of belts and two quivers, left and right galloping and shooting.^[This is to mean that Dǒng Zhuó could shoot a bow from either hand while riding.] Became an Army Major,^[An army (jūn) was commanded by a General (jiāngjūn), with a Major (sīmǎ) serving as the General's chief of staff for military affairs.] accompanied Central Cadet General Zhāng Huàn on campaign in Bìng Province and had achievements, appointed Cadet Central, bestowed fine silk of nine thousand pǐ, [Dǒng] Zhuó completely divided and shared it with the clerks and servicemen. Promoted to Guǎngwǔ Magistrate, Shǔ Prefecture North Division Commandant, Western Regions Wùjǐ Colonel, dismissed. Summoned and appointed Bìng Province Inspector, Hédōng Administrator, <a href="#annotation-3" id="source-3">[3]</a> promoted to a Central Cadet General, suppressed Huángjīn, the army was defeated, punished for the crime. Hán Suì and others rose in Liáng Province, again became a Central Cadet General, to the west resisting [Hán] Suì. At Wángyuánxiá's north, he was by Qiāng and Hú of several tens of thousands of people encircled, provisions exhausted and cut off. [Dǒng] Zhuó pretended to wish to catch fish, dammed where his return route would have crossed the river to make a reservoir, having the water stand and fill several tens of lǐ, secretly from below the dam crossed his army and then breached the dam, by the time the Qiāng and Hú heard and learned and pursued, the water was alraedy deep, and they could not cross. At the time six armies had gone up Lǒngxī, five armies were defeated utterly, [Dǒng] Zhuó alone preserved his multitudes and returned, garrisoned and stationed Fúfēng. Appointed Front General, enfeoffed Marquess of Tái village, summoned to be Bìng Province Governor. <a href="#annotation-4" id="source-4">[4]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
董卓字仲穎，隴西臨洮人也。〔一〕少好俠，嘗游羌中，盡與諸豪帥相結。後歸耕於野，而豪帥有來從之者，卓與俱還，殺耕牛與相宴樂。諸豪帥感其意，歸相斂，得雜畜千餘頭以贈卓。〔二〕漢桓帝末，以六郡良家子為羽林郎。卓有才武，旅力少比，雙帶兩鞬，左右馳射。為軍司馬，從中郎將張奐征并州有功，拜郎中，賜縑九千匹，卓悉以分與吏士。遷廣武令，蜀郡北部都尉，西域戊己校尉，免。徵拜并州刺史、河東太守，〔三〕遷中郎將，討黃巾，軍敗抵罪。韓遂等起涼州，復為中郎將，西拒遂。于望垣硤北，為羌、胡數萬人所圍，糧食乏絕。卓偽欲捕魚，堰其還道當所渡水為池，使水渟滿數十里，默從堰下過其軍而決堰。比羌、胡聞知追逐，水已深，不得渡。時六軍上隴西，五軍敗績，卓獨全眾而還，屯住扶風。拜前將軍，封斄鄉侯，徵為并州牧。〔四〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-1" id="annotation-1">[1]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó's father Jūnyǎ from humble office became Yǐngchuān's Lúnshì Commandant. Had three sons: eldest son [Dǒng] Zhuó appellation Mènggāo, early died, next was [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó's younger brother [Dǒng] Mín appellation Shūyǐng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：卓父君雅，由微官為潁川綸氏尉。有三子：長子擢，字孟高，早卒；次即卓；卓弟旻字叔穎。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-2" id="annotation-2">[2]</a> Wú shū states: The prefecture summoned [Dǒng] Zhuó as a clerk, having him supervise control of banditry. The Hú once came out to plunder, capturing many civilians, Liáng Province Inspector Chéng Jiù summoned [Dǒng] Zhuó as a Following Official, sending him to lead troops and cavalry to suppress and capture, greatly defeated them, beheading and capturing in the thousands. Bìng Province Inspector Duàn Jiǒng nominated [Dǒng] Zhuó to the Excellency Offices, Excellency over the Masses Yuán Wěi recruited him as an Assistant.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　吳書曰：郡召卓為吏，使監領盜賊。胡嘗出鈔，多虜民人，涼州刺史成就辟卓為從事，使領兵騎討捕，大破之，斬獲千計。并州刺史段熲薦卓公府，司徒袁隗辟為掾。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-3" id="annotation-3">[3]</a>
Yīngxióng jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó repeatedly suppressed Qiāng and Hú, beginning to end over a hundred battles.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　英雄記曰：卓數討羌、胡，前後百餘戰。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-4" id="annotation-4">[4]</a>
Líng-dì jì states: Zhōngpíng Fifth Year [188], summoned [Dǒng] Zhuó as Minister Treasurer, ordering him to have his camp clerks and servicemen be subordinated to Left General Huángfǔ Sōng, and visit where [the Emperor] was traveling. [Dǒng] Zhuó sent up word: "Liáng Province is disturbed and in chaos, the whales and salamanders not yet exterminated, this is the autumn for Your Servant to vigorously devote his life. The clerks and servicemen jump in enthusiasm, in gratitude for my favor and thinking to repay me, each surrounded Your Servant's chariot, statements and voices earnest and sorrowful, so I was not able to start on the road. At once I will temporarily enact Front General affairs, exhaust heart to reassure and sympathize, devote my strength in traveling the battle lines." Sixth Year [189], appoitned [Dǒng] Zhuó as Bìng Province Governor, also ordering him to have his clerks and troops be subordinated to Huángfǔ Sōng. [Dǒng] Zhuó again sent up word: "Your Servant has handled warfare for ten years, the servicemen and soldiers large and small, have grown close over a long time, attached to Your Servant's favor of raising and nurturing them, pleased to for the country exert their lives in an instant, I beg to lead them to the province, to exert strength on the borders." [Dǒng] Zhuó had twice disobeyed Edict orders, it happened he was by Hé Jìn summoned.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　靈帝紀曰：中平五年，徵卓為少府，敕以營吏士屬左將軍皇甫嵩，詣行在所。卓上言：「涼州擾亂，鯨鯢未滅，此臣奮發效命之秋。吏士踴躍，戀恩念報，各遮臣車，辭聲懇惻，未得即路也。輒且行前將軍事，盡心慰卹，效力行陳。」六年，以卓為并州牧，又敕以吏兵屬皇甫嵩。卓復上言：「臣掌戎十年，士卒大小，相狎彌久，戀臣畜養之恩，樂為國家奮一旦之命，乞將之州，效力邊陲。」卓再違詔敕，會為何進所召。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Emperor Líng died, the Young Emperor succeeded the throne. General-in-Chief Hé Jìn with Director of Retainers Colonel Yuán Shào plotted to execute the various castrate officials, the Dowager Empress would not agree. [Hé] Jìn thus summoned [Dǒng] Zhuó to have him lead troops to visit the capital region, and further secretly ordered him to send up letter stating: "Central Regular Attendant Zhāng Ràng and others stole favor and abused privilege, contaminating and disordering Within the Seas. In the past Zhào Yāng mobilized the armor of Jìnyáng, to drive away the eviles beside the lord.^[Zhào Yāng was a Spring and Autumn era minister of Jìn state. He mobilized an army at his stronghold at Jìnyáng city and took custody over the Duke of Jìn, framing his coup not as treason but as fulfilling a duty to purge evil ministers surrounding his ruler.] Your Servant at once sounds bells and drums to Luòyáng, at once suppressing [Zhāng] Ràng and the rest," wishing to pressure and coerce the Dowager Empress. [Dǒng] Zhuó had not yet arrived when [Hé] Jìn was destroyed. <a href="#annotation-5" id="source-5">[5]</a> Central Regular Attendant Duàn Guī and others seized the Emperor and fled to Xiǎopíngjīn, [Dǒng] Zhuó therefore led his multitudes to welcome the Emperor at Běimáng, returned to the Palace. <a href="#annotation-6" id="source-6">[6]</a> At the time [Hé] Jìn's younger brother Chariots and Cavalry General [Hé] Miáo was by [Hé] Jìn's multitudes killed. <a href="#annotation-7" id="source-7">[7]</a> [Hé] Jìn's and [Hé] Miáo's division retainers had no one to join, and all went over to [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó also sent Lǚ Bù to kill Metal Mace Bearer^[Metal Mace Bearer (zhíjīnwú) was in charge of security and policing the capital city.] Dīng Yuán and absorbed his multitudes. therefore the capital city's military power was entirely with [Dǒng] Zhuó. <a href="#annotation-8" id="source-8">[8]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
靈帝崩，少帝即位。大將軍何進與司隸校尉袁紹謀誅諸閹官，太后不從。進乃召卓使將兵詣京師，并密令上書曰：「中常侍張讓等竊幸乘寵，濁亂海內。昔趙鞅興晉陽之甲，以逐君側之惡。臣輒鳴鐘鼓如洛陽，即討讓等。」欲以脅迫太后。卓未至，進敗。〔一〕中常侍段珪等劫帝走小平津，卓遂將其眾迎帝于北芒，還宮。〔二〕時進弟車騎將軍苗為進眾所殺，〔三〕進、苗部曲無所屬，皆詣卓。卓又使呂布殺執金吾丁原，并其眾，故京都兵權唯在卓。〔四〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #hejin}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-5" id="annotation-5">[5]</a> Xú Hàn shū states: [Hé] Jìn appellation Suìgāo was a Nányáng man, the Dowager Empress's elder brother of a different mother. [Hé] Jìn originally was a butcher family's son, his father called [Hé] Zhēn. After [Hé] Zhēn died, [Hé] Jìn had his younger sister rely on the Yellow Gates^[The Yellow Gates (huángmén) department consisted of eunuch officials serving in the restricted areas of the Palace, so named for the yellow gates that marked the areas.] to be able to enter the Lateral Courts, she had favor, Guānghé Third Year [180] established as Imperial Empress, [Hé] Jìn because of this became noble and influential. Zhōngpíng Inaugural Year [184], the Huángjīn rose, appointed [Hé] Jìn as General-in-Chief.

Diǎnlüè records [Dǒng] Zhuó's memorial stating: "Your Servant in prostration considers that the reason Heaven's Under has had rebellion without end, is entirely because of the Yellow Gate Regular Attendant Zhāng Ràng and the rest disgracing and impeding Natural Order, interfering with and usurping the Ruler's Mandates, their fathers and sons and elder and younger brothers further occupy provinces and prefectures, on one letter exiting their gates, then they obtain a thousand gold, the capital region various prefectures of several millions of rich fertile fine farms all belong to [Zhāng] Ràng and the rest, reaching to causing resentments to rise up, witch rebels^[Witch rebels (yāozéi) were rebels said to deceive and bewitch the masses.] to swarm and rise. Your Servant previously served Edict to suppress Yūfúluó, the officers and servicemen were starving and exhausted, would not agree to cross the Hé, all saying they wished to visit the capital to first execute the castrates to eliminate the harms of the people, and from the Terrace Pavilion beg for supplies and pay. Your Servant complied to reassure and succor, until reaching Xīn'ān. Your Servant has heard that ladeling boiling water to stop boiling does not compare to extinguishing fire and removing fuel, that although lancing an ulcer is paintful it is superior to flesh rotting, that while drowning calling for a boat is regretting when it is too late."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　續漢書曰：進字遂高，南陽人，太后異母兄也。進本屠家子，父曰真。真死後，進以妹倚黃門得入掖庭，有寵，光和三年立為皇后，進由是貴幸。中平元年，黃巾起，拜進大將軍。典略載卓表曰：「臣伏惟天下所以有逆不止者，各由黃門常侍張讓等侮慢天常，操擅王命，父子兄弟並據州郡，一書出門，便獲千金，京畿諸郡數百萬膏腴美田皆屬讓等，至使怨氣上蒸，妖賊蜂起。臣前奉詔討於扶羅，將士飢乏，不肯渡河，皆言欲詣京師先誅閹豎以除民害，從臺閣求乞資直。臣隨慰撫，以至新安。臣聞揚湯止沸，不如滅火去薪，潰癰雖痛，勝于養肉，及溺呼船，悔之無及。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-6" id="annotation-6">[6]</a> Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì states: The Emperor on Eighth Moon Gēngwǔ [189 Sep 24] was seized by the various Yellow Gates, on foot exiting Gǔ Gate, fleeing to the Hé's banks. The various Yellow Gates then threw themselves into the Hé and died. At the time the Emperor was aged fourteen, the King of Chénliú aged nine years, elder and younger brothers alone in the night on foot walked wishing to return to the Palace, it was completely dark, they followed firefly lights to walk several lǐ, found a civilian's house and on an open cart traveled. Xīnwèi [189 Sep 25] the Excellencies and Ministers on down with [Dǒng] Zhuó together welcomed the Emperor at Běimáng slope's bottom.

Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: Before this a children's rhyme said: "Marquess not a Marquess, a King not a King, a thousand chariots and ten thousand cavalry flee Běimáng." [Dǒng] Zhuó at the time just arrived, garrisoned Xiǎnyáng Park, heard the Emperor was about to return, led the multitudes to welcome the Emperor.

Diǎnlüè states: The Emperor looked out and saw [Dǒng] Zhuó's troops and shed tears. The various Excellencies said to [Dǒng] Zhuó stating: "There is Edict to withdraw troops." [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "You Excellencies for the state are senior ministers, were not able to rectify and correct the Ruling House, so that it cause the country to be spread adrift, what withdrawing troops is there?" Therefore they together entered the city.

Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó with the Emperor spoke, speaking and could not understand. Then he again with the King of Chénliú spoke, asking how the disaster and chaos came about, the King answered from beginning to the end, with nothing ommitted. [Dǒng] Zhuó was greatly pleased, and then had the intention to depose [the Young Emperor] and establish [the King of Chénliú as Emperor].

Yīngxióng jì states: Hénán Central Division Assistant Mǐn Gòng supported the Emperor and the King of Chénliú up to reach Luò lodging to rest. The Emperor alone rode one horse, the King of Chénliú with [Mǐn] Gòng together rode one horse, from Luò lodge went south. The Excellencies and Ministers and Hundred Officials presented welcome at Běimáng slope's bottom, therefore Grand Commandant Cuī Liè at the front guided. [Dǒng] Zhuó led infantry and cavalry of several thousand to come welcome, [Cuī] Liè shouted to have them back away, [Dǒng] Zhuó cursed at [Cuī] Liè stating: "Day and night across three hundred lǐ I came, how can you speak of backing away? Am I not able to cut off your head?" Ahead he met the Emperor and stated: "Your Majesty had Regular Attendants and Lesser Yellow Gate make chaos like this, to bring about disaster and destruction, is your failing not small?" Also hastened to the King of Chénliú and stated: "I am Dǒng Zhuó, come and let me hold you." Then he took the King from [Mǐn] Gòng's arms, [Dǒng] Zhuó with the King joined horses and went.

Yīngxióng jì states: Another version says the King would not go into [Dǒng] Zhuó's arms
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　張璠漢紀曰：帝以八月庚午為諸黃門所劫，步出穀門，走至河上。諸黃門既投河死。時帝年十四，陳留王年九歲，兄弟獨夜步行欲還宮，闇暝，逐螢火而行，數里，得民家以露車載送。辛未，公卿以下與卓共迎帝於北芒阪下。獻帝春秋曰：先是童謠曰：「侯非侯，王非王，千乘萬騎走北芒。」卓時適至，屯顯陽苑。聞帝當還，率眾迎帝。典略曰：帝望見卓兵涕泣。群公謂卓曰：「有詔卻兵。」卓曰：「公諸人為國大臣，不能匡正王室，至使國家播蕩，何卻兵之有！」遂俱入城。獻帝紀曰：卓與帝語，語不可了。乃更與陳留王語，問禍亂由起；王答，自初至終，無所遺失。卓大喜，乃有廢立意。英雄記曰：河南中部掾閔貢扶帝及陳留王上至雒舍止。帝獨乘一馬，陳留王與貢共乘一馬，從雒舍南行。公卿百官奉迎於北芒阪下，故太尉崔烈在前導。卓將步騎數千來迎，烈呵使避，卓罵烈曰：「晝夜三百里來，何云避，我不能斷卿頭邪？」前見帝曰：「陛下令常侍小黃門作亂乃爾，以取禍敗，為負不小邪？」又趨陳留王，曰：「我董卓也，從我抱來。」乃於貢抱中取王。英雄記曰：一本云王不就卓抱，卓與王併馬而行也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #hemiao}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-7" id="annotation-7">[7]</a> Yīngxióng jì says: [Hé] Miáo was the Dowager Empress's elder brother of the same mother, a son from the previous marriage to the Zhū clan. [Hé] Jìn's division retainer commander Wú Kuāng formerly resented [Zhū/Hé] Miáo for not being of the same intentions with [Hé] Jìn, and also suspected him of plotting with the eunuchs, and so his order within his army said: "The one who killed the General-in-Chief was the Chariots and Cavalry [General Hé Miáo]" Therefore he led troops with [Dǒng] Zhuó's younger brother [Dǒng] Mín to together kill [Hé] Miáo at Zhūjué watchtower's bottom.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　英雄記云：苗，太后之同母兄，先嫁朱氏之子。進部曲將吳匡，素怨苗不與進同心，又疑其與宦官通謀，乃令軍中曰：「殺大將軍者，車騎也。」遂引兵與卓弟旻共攻殺苗於朱爵闕下。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-8" id="annotation-8">[8]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: When [Dǒng] Zhuó first entered Luòyáng, his infantry and cavalry did not exceed three thousand, himself fearing his troops were few and unable to subdue the far and near, every four to five days, at once in the night he sent troops out the four city gates, and the next day laid out flags and drums toe enter, announcing report saying: "Western troops again enter and arrive within Luò." People were not aware, and said [Dǒng] Zhuó troops were uncountable.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　九州春秋曰：卓初入洛陽，步騎不過三千，自嫌兵少，不為遠近所服；率四五日，輒夜遣兵出四城門，明日陳旌鼓而入，宣言云「西兵復入至洛中」。人不覺，謂卓兵不可勝數。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Before this, [Hé] Jìn had sent Cavalry Commandant Tàishān's Bào Xìn to recruit troops wherever he was, he happened to arrive, [Bào] Xìn said to [Yuán] Shào stating: "[Dǒng] Zhuó gathers strong troops, has ulterior ambitions, now to not early plan against him, we will be controlled by him. As they have newly arrived and are weary, attacking him he can be taken." [Yuán] Shào feared [Dǒng] Zhuó and did not dare move, [Bào] Xìn therefore returned to his hometown.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
先是，進遣騎都尉太山鮑信所在募兵，適至，信謂紹曰：「卓擁彊兵，有異志，今不早圖，將為所制；及其初至疲勞，襲之可禽也。」紹畏卓，不敢發，信遂還鄉里。
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Thereupon because for a long time it had not rained, certificate dismissed Excellency of Works Liú Hóng and [Dǒng] Zhuó replaced him, very soon promoted to Grand Commandant, Lent Stave and Battle-Ax and Tiger Elite. Therefore he deposed the Emperor to be King of Hóngnóng, soon after also killed the King and Dowager Empress Hé, established Emperor Líng's youngest son the King of Chénliú, who was Emperor Xiàn. <a href="#annotation-9" id="source-9">[9]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó was promoted to Chancellor of State, enfeoffed Marquess of Méi, in paying respects was not to use personal name, to wear sword and shoes when ascending Palace Halls, also enfeoffed [Dǒng] Zhuó's mother as Lady of Chíyáng, installing a household director and deputy. [Dǒng] Zhuó had happened to lead elite troops to come right when the Emperor's House was in great chaos, obtained power to depose and establish, occupied and possessed the Military Arsenal armor and weapons, the state treasures, his power shook Heaven's Under. [Dǒng] Zhuó by nature was cruel and ruthless and not benevolent, and therefore used strict punishments to coerce the multitudes, the slightest angry glare was certain to be avenged, people could not preserve themselves. <a href="#annotation-10" id="source-10">[10]</a> Once he sent the army to arrive at Yángchéng, at the time it happened to be the Second Moon Soil God sacrifices, the people each were below their altars, everywhere they arrived they cut off the heads of the males, drove their carts and oxen, carried off their women and belongings, having all the cut off heads fastened to the cart yokes and axles, in a continuous line and returning to Luò, saying they had attacked rebels with great winnings, declaring Ten Thousand Years. Entered Kāiyáng City Gate, burned the heads, had the women given to the armored soldiers as slaves and concubines. They went as far as violating the Palace women and princesses. His vicious rebelliousness was like this.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
於是以久不雨，策免司空劉弘而卓代之，俄遷太尉，假節鉞虎賁。遂廢帝為弘農王。尋又殺王及何太后。立靈帝少子陳留王，是為獻帝。〔一〕卓遷相國，封郿侯，贊拜不名，劍履上殿，又封卓母為池陽君，置家令、丞。卓既率精兵來，適值帝室大亂，得專廢立，據有武庫甲兵，國家珍寶，威震天下。卓性殘忍不仁，遂以嚴刑脅眾，睚眥之隙必報，人不自保。〔二〕嘗遣軍到陽城。時適二月社，民各在其社下，悉就斷其男子頭，駕其車牛，載其婦女財物，以所斷頭繫車轅軸，連軫而還洛，云攻賊大獲，稱萬歲。入開陽城門，焚燒其頭，以婦女與甲兵為婢妾。至于姦亂宮人公主。其凶逆如此。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-9" id="annotation-9">[9]</a> Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó planned to depose the Emperor, gathered the various ministers at the Court Hall, his comment stating: "Greatest is Heaven and Earth, next is Lord and Servant, by this is there governance. Now the Imperial Emperor is ignorant and weak, and cannot serve the Ancestral Temple or for Heaven's Under be Ruler. I wish to comply with the precedent of Yī Yǐn and Huò Guāng, and establish the King of Chénliú. How about it?" Secretariat Writer Lú Zhí said: "According to the Shàng Shū, Tài Jiǎ after being established was not enlightened, Yī Yǐn exiled him to Tóng Palace. The King of Chāngyì was established for twenty-seven days, his crimes exceeded over a thousand, and therefore Huò Guāng deposed him. Now the Superior is rich in springs and autumns,^[This is an idiom to mean one is still young, having many years (springs and autumns) ahead of them.] conduct not yet having faults, not comparable to the previous situations." [Dǒng] Zhuó was angry, dismissed the seating, wishing to execute [Lú] Zhí, Attendant Central Cài Yōng persuaded him, [Lú Zhí] was able to escape. Ninth Moon Jiǎxū [189 Sep 28], [Dǒng] Zhuó again greatly convened the various ministers and said: "The Dowager Empress oppressed the Yǒnglè Dowager Empress, causing her to in distress die, violating the rituals of daughter-in-law to mother-in-law, without the integrity of filial devotion.^[The Yǒnglè Dowager Empress, family name Dǒng, called by her residence in Yǒnglè Palace, was the mother of Hàn Emperor Líng. After Emperor Líng's death, Emperor Líng's Empress, family name Hé, took power as Dowager and quickly moved to eliminate her potentially dangerous political rival. The Dowager Dǒng and Dǒng Zhuó were from other sides of the empire and not related.] Heaven's Son is young in character, pliable and weak and not a Lord. In the past Yī Yǐn exiled Tài Jiǎ, Huò Guāng deposed Chāngyì, written in the canon registers, all believe it good. Now the Dowager Empress should be as Tài Jiǎ, the Imperial Emperor should be as Chāngyì. The King of Chénliú is benevolent and filial, and should ascend the Honored Imperial Throne."
Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù records the certificate stating: "Imperial Emperor Xiào-Líng did not reach Gāozōng's blessings of long life, early to abandon his servants. The Imperial Emperor undertook the continuation, Within the Seas leaned to watch, but the Emperor's natural disposition is frivolous and unsteady, demeanor not respectful, in mourning is slow and lazy, weak as before. His vicious character is clear, his obscenities spread and heard, damaging and disgracing the Divine Vessels, shaming and defiling the Ancestral Temple. The Imperial Dowager Empress's instructions were without motherly bearing, her control of government neglectful and chaotic. The Yǒnglè Dowager Empress suddenly passed away, the multitude of discussions were confused. The Way of the Three Networks, the Order of Heaven and Earth, yet thus have deficiencies, of crimes the largest. The King of Chénliú [Liú] Xié has sagely virtue grand and lush, is upright and honest far and beyond, ample low sharp high,^[This is a physiognomy term for the head, referring to a wide jaw (low) and narrow forehead (high).] having the form of Yáo's portraits, resides in mourning with sorrow and grief, speech never reaching evil, his precocious nature has the exemplary qualities of Zhōu Chéng. His glorious sound and beautiful praises, Heaven's Under has heard, and should inherit the Vast Enterprise, to unify the ten thousand ages, and can carry on the Ancestral Temple. Depose the Imperial Emperor to be King of Hóngnóng. The Imperial Dowager Empress returns the government." The Secretariat Writer's reading of the text completed, of the various ministers none spoke. Secretariat Writer Dīng Gōng said: "Heaven brought disaster on the Hàn House, the decline and chaos vast and many. In the past Zhài Zhòng deposed Hū and established Tū, the Chūnqiū commended this expedience. Now the chief ministers weighed what was appropriate for the plans of the State Altars, truly in accord with Heaven and Humanity, I request to declare Ten Thousand Years." As [Dǒng] Zhuó had the Dowager Empress deposed, therefore the Excellencies and Ministers on down did not wear mourning clothes, at the gathering for the burial, they wore plain white clothes and nothing more.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝紀曰：卓謀廢帝，會群臣於朝堂，議曰：「大者天地，次者君臣，所以為治。今皇帝闇弱，不可以奉宗廟，為天下主。欲依伊尹、霍光故事，立陳留王，何如？」尚書盧植曰：「案尚書太甲既立不明，伊尹放之桐宮。昌邑王立二十七日，罪過千餘，故霍光廢之。今上富於春秋，行未有失，非前事之比也。」卓怒，罷坐，欲誅植，侍中蔡邕勸之，得免。九月甲戌，卓復大會群臣曰：「太后逼迫永樂太后，令以憂死，逆婦姑之禮，無孝順之節。天子幼質，軟弱不君。昔伊尹放太甲，霍光廢昌邑，著在典籍，僉以為善。今太后宜如太甲，皇帝宜如昌邑。陳留王仁孝，宜即尊皇祚。」獻帝起居注載策曰：「孝靈皇帝不究高宗眉壽之祚，早棄臣子。皇帝承紹，海內側望，而帝天姿輕佻，威儀不恪，在喪慢惰，衰如故焉；凶德既彰，淫穢發聞，損辱神器，忝污宗廟。皇太后教無母儀，統政荒亂。永樂太后暴崩，眾論惑焉。三綱之道，天地之紀，而乃有闕，罪之大者。陳留王協，聖德偉茂，規矩邈然，豐下兌上，有堯圖之表；居喪哀戚，言不及邪，岐嶷之性，有周成之懿。休聲美稱，天下所聞，宜承洪業，為萬世統，可以承宗廟。廢皇帝為弘農王。皇太后還政。」尚書讀冊畢，群臣莫有言，尚書丁宮曰：「天禍漢室，喪亂弘多。昔祭仲廢忽立突，春秋大其權。今大臣量宜為社稷計，誠合天人，請稱萬歲。」卓以太后見廢，故公卿以下不布服，會葬，素衣而已。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-10" id="annotation-10">[10]</a> Wèi shū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó's desires were without limit, he spoke to his guest retainers stating: "My physiognomy is nobility without superior."

Yīngxióng jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó wished to shake and awe, Attendant Censor Rǎo Lóngzōng visited [Dǒng] Zhuó to report affairs and did not take off sword, at once beat him to death, the capital region was shaken and disturbed. He excavated Hé Miáo's coffin, taking out the corpse, dismembered and discarded it beside the road. Also arrested [Hé] Miáo's mother the Lady of Wǔyáng and killed her, discarded the corpse in the Park thorn hedges, not collected for burial.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：卓所願無極，語賓客曰：「我相，貴無上也。」英雄記曰：卓欲震威，侍御史擾龍宗詣卓白事，不解劍，立撾殺之，京師震動。發何苗棺，出其尸，枝解節棄於道邊。又收苗母舞陽君殺之，棄尸於苑枳落中，不復收斂。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, [Dǒng] Zhuó trusted and appointed Secretariat Writer Zhōu Bì, City Gate Colonel Wǔ Qióng and others, and employed those they nominated Hán Fù, Liú Dài, Kǒng Zhòu, Zhāng Zī, Zhāng Miǎo, and others to be sent out to govern the provinces and prefectures, but when [Hán] Fù and the rest reached office, all gathered troops to lead to suppress [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó heard of this, believed that [Zhōu] Bì and [Wǔ] Qióng and the rest were communicating the situation with them to sell him out, and beheaded them all. <a href="#annotation-11" id="source-11">[11]</a> 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，卓信任尚書周毖，城門校尉伍瓊等，用其所舉韓馥、劉岱、孔伷、（張資）〔張咨〕、張邈等出宰州郡。而馥等至官，皆合兵將以討卓。卓聞之，以為毖、瓊等通情賣己，皆斬之。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-11" id="annotation-11">[11]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Zhōu] Bì appellation Zhòngyuǎn was a Wǔwēi man. [Wǔ] Qióng appellation Déyú was a Rǔnán man.

Xiè Chéng's Hòu Hàn shū states: Wǔ Fú appellation Déyú in youth had great integrity, became a prefecture below the gates writing aide. His home village's chief had a crime, the Administrator had [Wǔ] Fú send out the instructions to order to the departments down for the Investigator^[Investigator (dūyóu) was a prefecture position, in charge of the postal relay stations within the prefecture, and of investigating and impeaching local officials.] to arrest him. [Wǔ] Fú would not agree to receive the instructions, prostrat on the ground looked up to remonstrate stating: "Though a Lord not be a Lord, a Servant cannot not be a Servant. How can your enlightened office^[Enlightened office (míngfǔ) was a term of address for a prefecture administrator.] order [me, Wǔ ]Fú^[Individuals can refer to themselves by their own personal name as a sign of humility.] to receve instructions, to order the exterior to arrest my home village's chief? I further beg you assign a different clerk." The Administrator was impressed and listened to him. Later General-in-Chief Hé Jìn recruited him as an East Department Associate, gradually promoted to Attendant Central, Hénán Intendant, Surpassing Cavalry Colonel. When Dǒng Zhuó made chaos, the Hundred Bureaus trembled in fear. [Wǔ] Fú wore small armor, inside his Court dress tied and girdled a knife to meet [Dǒng] Zhuó, wishing to watch for an opportunity to assassinate and kill him. The conversation finished and they took leave, [Dǒng] Zhuó escorted him into the corridor, [Wǔ] Fú took advantage to take out the knife and stabbed at him. [Dǒng] Zhuó had much strength, drew back and was not hit. At once arrested [Wǔ] Fú. [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "You wish to rebel?" [Wǔ] Fú greatly shouted stating: "You are not my Lord, I am not your Servant, what rebellion is there? You disorded the state and usurped the Ruler, crimes overflowing and evils large. Today is my death day, therefore I merely came to execute a rebel, I regret I could not use chariots to tear you apart in the public market^[This was a form of execution where the victim had their four limbs and head tied to five chariots and was then pulled apart, reserved for the most heinous crimes.] to apologize to Heaven's Under." Therefore killed [Wǔ] Fú.

Xiè Chéng record of [Wǔ] Fú's appellation and home prefecture then with [Wǔ] Qióng is the same, but the circumstances of death then with [Wǔ] Fú is different. It is unknown if "Fú" was another personal name of [Wǔ] Qióng, or if there separately was a Wǔ Fú. Overall it is uncertain.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：毖字仲遠，武威人。瓊字德瑜，汝南人。謝承後漢書曰：伍孚字德瑜，少有大節，為郡門下書佐。其本邑長有罪，太守使孚出教，敕曹下督郵收之。孚不肯受教，伏地仰諫曰：「君雖不君，臣不可不臣，明府奈何令孚受教，敕外收本邑長乎？更乞授他吏。」太守奇而聽之。後大將軍何進辟為東曹屬，稍遷侍中、河南尹、越騎校尉。董卓作亂，百僚震慄。孚著小鎧，於朝服裏挾佩刀見卓，欲伺便刺殺之。語闋辭去，卓送至閤中，孚因出刀刺之。卓多力，退卻不中，即收孚。卓曰：「卿欲反邪？」孚大言曰：「汝非吾君，吾非汝臣，何反之有？汝亂國篡主，罪盈惡大，今是吾死日，故來誅姦賊耳，恨不車裂汝於市朝以謝天下。」遂殺孚。謝承記孚字及本郡，則與瓊同，而致死事乃與孚異也，不知孚為瓊之別名，為別有伍孚也？蓋未詳之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Hénèi Administrator Wáng Kuāng sent Tàishān troops to garrison Héyáng Ford, about to plot against [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó sent decoy troops as if about to cross at Píngyīn, secretly sent elite multitudes to from Xiǎopíng's north cross, turning to strike their rear, greatly defeated them at the ford's north, the dead were almost all of them. [Dǒng] Zhuó because powerful figures east of the mountains were rising together was fearful and not at ease. Chūpíng Inaugural Year Second Moon [190 Mar 24 - Apr 22], thus relocated Heaven's Son to set capital at Cháng'ān, burned the Luòyáng Palace Residences, entirely excavated the tombs, seizing the treasures. <a href="#annotation-12" id="source-12">[12]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó reached the western capital, became Grand Preceptor, called as Shàngfù.^[Grand Preceptor (tàishī) was the most senior of the Three Excellencies position used by Zhōu. It was restored here to honor Dǒng Zhuó with an exceptional position above the Excellencies. Shàngfù was an honorific previously used to honor the Zhōu dynasty Grand Preceptor Tàigōng Wàng, and therefore interpreted to mean something like a father figure for the Emperor.] He rode Blue Canopy Gold Decorated chariot, claw paintings on the two wheel-guards, at the time people called it the Pole-Scraping Chariot. <a href="#annotation-13" id="source-13">[13]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó's younger brother [Dǒng] Mín became Left General, enfeoffed Marquess of Hù, elder brother's son [Dǒng] Huáng became Attendant Central Central Mary Colonel managing troops, his clansmen paternal and maternal all were lined up in Court. <a href="#annotation-14" id="source-14">[14]</a> The Excellencies and Ministers on meeting [Dǒng] Zhuó bowed below the carriage, [Dǒng] Zhuó was not courteous in return. Summoned and called on the Three Terraces Secretariat Writers on down to personally visit [Dǒng] Zhuó's office to report on affairs. <a href="#annotation-15" id="source-15">[15]</a> Built Méi Fortress, its height equal to Cháng'ān city walls, amassed grain for thirty years of reserves, <a href="#annotation-16" id="source-16">[16]</a> saying if his affairs were successful he would dominate Heaven's Under, and if not successful, maintaining this was enough to last through old age. Once on reaching Méi to travel the fortress, the Excellencies and Ministers on down saw him off outside Héng Gate. <a href="#annotation-17" id="source-17">[17]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó in advance laid out curtains to drink, invited surrendered Běidì rebels of several hundred people, among the seats first cut off their tongues, some cut off hands and feet, some dug out eyes, some in cauldrons boiled them, not yet died, writhing and turning among the cups and tables, those gathered all trembled and dropped their spoons and chopsticks, but [Dǒng] Zhuó drank and ate at ease. The Grand Scribe observed auras and reported there would be a great minister killed.^[Grand Scribe (tàishǐ) was responsible for record-keeping, which also included the recording and interpretation of omens such as atmospheric auras.] Former Grand Commandant Zhāng Wēn at the time was Minister of the Guard, previously was not friendly with [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó in his heart resented him, taking advantage of the Heavens having an omen and wishing to obstruct calamity,^[The omen could refer to Dǒng Zhuó himself, so he wished to have another senior minister killed to fulfill the omen to avoid having it applied to himself.] sent someone to report that [Zhāng] Wēn was communicating with Yuán Shù, and therefore whipped him to death. <a href="#annotation-18" id="source-18">[18]</a> Laws and ordinances were severe and harsh, by loves and hates excessively punished, so that people falsely accused one another, those that died junjustly were in the thousands. The Hundred Surnames wailed, on the road glancing.^[To mean that people were too afraid to speak to one another.] <a href="#annotation-19" id="source-19">[19]</a> He completely smashed and destroyed the Bronze Men and the Bell Stands, reaching to destroying Wǔzhū coins, to recast into small coins, size five fēn, without inscriptions, the material and hole without inner or outer rims,^[Coins of the time were circular, with a square hole at the center. The inner and outer rims would normally have defined border edges to prevent coin clipping.] not trimmed or polished. Therefore money was cheap and goods expensive, grain of one hú reached several hundred thousand. From then afterward money was not circulated.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
河內太守王匡，遣泰山兵屯河陽津，將以圖卓。卓遣疑兵若將於平陰渡者，潛遣銳眾從小平北渡，繞擊其後，大破之津北，死者略盡。卓以山東豪傑並起，恐懼不寧。初平元年二月，乃徙天子都長安。焚燒洛陽宮室，悉發掘陵墓，取寶物。〔一〕卓至西京，為太師，號曰尚父。乘青蓋金華車，爪畫兩轓，時人號曰竿摩車。〔二〕卓弟旻為左將軍，封鄠侯；兄子璜為侍中中軍校尉典兵；宗族內外並列朝廷。〔三〕公卿見卓，謁拜車下，卓不為禮。召呼三臺尚書以下自詣卓府啟事。〔四〕築郿塢，高與長安城埒，積穀為三十年儲，〔五〕云事成，雄據天下，不成，守此足以畢老。嘗至郿行塢，公卿已下祖道於橫門外。〔六〕卓豫施帳幔飲，誘降北地反者數百人，於坐中先斷其舌，或斬手足，或鑿眼，或鑊煮之，未死，偃轉杯案閒，會者皆戰慄亡失匕箸，而卓飲食自若。太史望氣，言當有大臣戮死者。故太尉張溫時為衛尉，素不善卓，卓心怨之，因天有變，欲以塞咎，使人言溫與袁術交關，遂笞殺之。〔七〕法令苛酷，愛憎淫刑，更相被誣，冤死者千數。百姓嗷嗷，道路以目。〔八〕悉椎破銅人、鐘虡，及壞五銖錢。更鑄為小錢，大五分，無文章，肉好無輪郭，不磨鑢。于是貨輕而物貴，穀一斛至數十萬。自是後錢貨不行。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-12" id="annotation-12">[12]</a> Huà Qiáo's Hàn shū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó wished to move to Cháng'ān, summoned the Excellencies and Ministers on down for a great discussion. Excellency over the Masses Yáng Biāo said: "In the past Pán Gēng five times moved, Yīn's peoples were all resentful, and therefore he composed three chapters to inform the people of Heaven's Under.^[Pán Gēng was a king of the Shāng/Yīn dynasty. Three chapters preserved in the Shàng Shū are attributed to him.] Now Within the Seas is calm and stable, to without reason move the capital, one fears the Hundred Surnames will be alarmed and disturbed, boiling up and ants swarming into chaos." [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "Guānzhōng is fertile and rich, therefore Qín was able to absorb and swallow Six States.^[Guānzhōng "Inside the Passes" refers to the Wèi river valley, named for the surrounding mountains and mountain passes. It had been the heartland of Qín state.] Now to relocate to the western capital, even if the powerful and strong east of the passes dare have any move, I will use strong troops to trample them, and can drive them into the blue sea." [Yáng] Biāo said: "Within the Seas, disturbing it is extremely easy, calming it is extremely difficult. Also the Cháng'ān Palace Residences are in ruins, and cannot be quickly rebuilt." [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "At the time Emperor Wǔ resided at Dùlíng south mountain's bottom, there were ceramics kilns of several thousand locations, drawing from Liáng Province timber and wood east downstream to build the Palace Residences, the achievement is not difficult." [Dǒng] Zhuó's could not obtain his intentions, and so changed color and said: "Does Your Excellency wish to ruin my plans? Biān Zhāng and Hán Yuē^[Hán Yuē was another personal name of Hán Suì.] had letters come, wishing to have the Court certainly relocate the capital. If large armies go east downstream, I would no longer be able to rescue you, Your Excellency might as wel join the Yuán clan to march west." [Yáng] Biāo said: "The west is naturally [my, Yáng] Biāo's road to take, I only look back not knowing what will become of Heaven's Under." The discussion ended. [Dǒng] Zhuó ordered the Director of Retainers Colonel Xuān Fán to use disaster omens to impeach and memorialize, and therefore certificate dismissed [Yáng] Biāo.

Xù Hàn shū states: Grand Commandant Huáng Wǎn, Excellency over the Masses Yáng Biāo, Excellency of Works Xún Shuǎng together visited [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "In the past Gāozǔ set capital in Guānzhōng, after eleven reigns was the Internal Restoration, changing the capital to Luòyáng. From Guāng-Wǔ to the present again is eleven reigns,^[The count of eleven is achieved by not including Emperors that were retroactively declared illegitimate. The count also does not include the two founding Emperors Gāozǔ and Guāng-Wǔ, which would lead to the more commonly cited twelve reigns.] Citing Shí Bāo Shì Chén,^[The title Shí Bāo Shì Chèn can be interpreted as "Prophecies of the Stone Bud Room." During Hàn there were various apocryphal prophecy texts in circulation. Almost none are extant except for quotations and references in other works.] it is appropriate to again return the capital to Cháng'ān." Those seated were all alarmed and startled, none dared to answer. [Yáng] Biāo said: "Moving the capital and changing systems is Heaven's Under's great affair, all should follow the hearts of the people and what is appropriate to the times. In the past Pán Gēng five times moved, Yīn's peoples all were resentful, therefore he composed three chapters to inform them. In the past Wáng Mǎng usurped and rebelled, changing and disordering the Five Constants, in the time of Gēngshǐ and the Chìméi,^[Gēngshǐ "Another Beginning" was a title used by Liú Xuán, who attempted to declare a restoration of Hàn with himself as Emperor. The Chìméi "Red Eyebrows" was a large rebel group, named for painting their foreheads red to identify themselves, which killed Liú Xuán and devastated Cháng'ān.] Cháng'ān was burned, the Hundred Surnames devastated and harmed, the people wandering in exile, out of a hundred not one remained. Guāng-Wǔ received the Mandate, changed the capital to Luò city, this was appropriate. Now when about to establish a sagely Ruler, to glorify and expand Han's blessings, to yet without reason abandon the Palaces and Temples, discard the Parks and Tombs, one fears the Hundred Surnames will be alarmed and startled, not understand this reasoning, and certainly boil over and ants swarm to result in disturbance and chaos. The Shí Bāo Shì Chèn is a book of witchcraft, how can it be trusted in and employed?" [Dǒng] Zhuó changed color and said: "Does Your Excellency Yáng wish to ruin the country's plans? East of the passes is about to be in chaos, where the rebels are rising. The Xiáo and Hán are rugged and firm, the state's weighty defense. Also from Lǒngyòu fetching timber,^[Lǒngyòu "Right of Lǒng mountain" was a prefecture and general region in the northwest, known for its timber.] the labors are not difficult. Dùlíng south mountain's bottom has Xiào-Wǔ's former pottery locations, to make bricks and tiles, in one morning it can be done. The Palace Residences and Government Offices, overall how are they worth discussing? The Hundred Surnames and petty civilians, how are they worth consulting? If there is hesitation, I will use large armies to drive them, how can they do as they please?" The Hundred Bureaus was terrified and lost color. [Huáng] Wǎn spoke to [Dǒng] Zhuó stating: "This is a great affair. Excellency Yáng's speech, is it not worth more consideration?" [Dǒng] Zhuó dismissed the seated, that day ordered the Director of Retainers to memorialize against [Yáng] Biāo and [Huáng] Wǎn, and both were dismissed from office. When the Great Carriage^[The Great Carriage (dàjià) was one of the formal carriages of the Emperor, and also used as a euphemism to refer to the Emperor.] went west, [Dǒng] Zhuó's division troops burned Luòyáng city walls' exterior to within a hundred lǐ. Also he personally commanded troops to burn the South and North Palaces and the Ancestral Temple, the Office Treasury, civilian homes, within the city walls was razed to the ground and completely destroyed. Also he arrested all the wealthy households, claiming to punish evils to confiscate their property, the dead without crimes were uncountable.

Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó captured troops east of the mountains, with pig fat smeared cloth of over ten pǐ, used to wrap their bodies, and afterward burned them, first from the feet rising up. Captured Yuán Shào's Yù Province Following Official Lǐ Yán, boiled him to death. [Dǒng] Zhuó had a favored Hú, who relied on the favor to act unrestrained, was by the Director of Retainers Colonel Zhào Qiān killed. [Dǒng] Zhuó was greatly furious and said: "Even my favorite dog yet I would not wish to have others shout at, so all the more for a man!" Thus summoned the Director of Retainers to the capital office and beat him to death.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　華嶠漢書曰：卓欲遷長安，召公卿以下大議。司徒楊彪曰：「昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉天下之民。（而）〔今〕海內安穩，無故移都，恐百姓驚動，麋沸蟻聚為亂。」卓曰：「關中肥饒，故秦得并吞六國。今徙西京，設令關東豪彊敢有動者，以我彊兵踧之，可使詣滄海。」彪曰：「海內動之甚易，安之甚難。又長安宮室壞敗，不可卒復。」卓曰：「武帝時居杜陵南山下，有成瓦窑數千處，引涼州材木東下以作宮室，為功不難。」卓意不得，便作色曰：「公欲沮我計邪？邊章、韓約有書來，欲令朝廷必徙都。若大兵（來）〔東〕下，我不能復相救，公便可與袁氏西行。」彪曰：「西方自彪道徑也，顧未知天下何如耳！」議罷。卓敕司隸校尉宣璠以災異劾奏，因策免彪。續漢書曰：太尉黃琬、司徒楊彪、司空荀爽俱詣卓，卓言：「昔高祖都關中，十一世後中興，更都洛陽。從光武至今復十一世，案石苞室讖，宜復還都長安。」坐中皆驚愕，無敢應者。彪曰：「遷都改制，天下大事，皆當因民之心，隨時之宜。昔盤庚五遷，殷民胥怨，故作三篇以曉之。往者王莽篡逆，變亂五常，更始赤眉之時，焚燒長安，殘害百姓，民人流亡，百無一在。光武受命，更都洛邑，此其宜也。今方建立聖主，光隆漢祚，而無故捐宮廟，棄園陵，恐百姓驚愕，不解此意，必麋沸蟻聚以致擾亂。石苞室讖，妖邪之書，豈可信用？」卓作色曰：「楊公欲沮國家計邪？關東方亂，所在賊起。崤函險固，國之重防。又隴右取材，功夫不難。杜陵南山下有孝武故陶處，作塼瓦，一朝可辦。宮室官府，蓋何足言！百姓小民，何足與議。若有前卻，我以大兵驅之，豈得自在。」百寮恐怖失色。琬謂卓曰：「此大事。楊公之語，得無重思！」卓罷坐，即日令司隸奏彪及琬，皆免官。大駕即西。卓部兵燒洛陽城外面百里。又自將兵燒南北宮及宗廟、府庫、民家，城內掃地殄盡。又收諸富室，以罪惡沒入其財物；無辜而死者，不可勝計。獻帝紀曰：卓獲山東兵，以豬膏塗布十餘匹，用纏其身，然後燒之，先從足起。獲袁紹豫州從事李延，煮殺之。卓所愛胡，恃寵放縱，為司隸校尉趙謙所殺。卓大怒曰：「我愛狗，尚不欲令人呵之，而況人乎！」乃召司隸都官撾殺之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}

<a href="#source-13" id="annotation-13">[13]</a> Wèi shū states: Saying it infringed on Heaven's Son.

Xiàn-dì jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó had become Grand Preceptor, further wished to be called Shàngfù, and about it asked Cài Yōng. [Cài] Yōng said: "In the past King Wǔ received the Mandate, Tàigōng was Preceptor, assisting and aiding the Zhōu House, to attack those without morality, and therefore Heaven's Under honored him, calling him as Shàngfù. Now Your Excellency's achievements and virtue truly are towering and imposing, but it is appropriate to wait for the east of the passes to all be settled, the Chariot Carriage to return east, and only afterward discuss it." Thus he stopped. The capital region had an earthquake, [Dǒng] Zhuó also asked [Cài] Yōng. [Cài] Yōng replied stating: "Earthquakes are Yīn flourishing,^[Yīn refers to the feminine/earth/dark/cold/low principle in contrast to the masculine/heaven/light/hot/high Yáng principle in Yīn-Yáng duality.] caused by a great minister overstepping regulations. Your Excellency rides a Blue Canopy chariot, far and near believe it inappropriate." [Dǒng] Zhuó followed this, and changed to riding a Gold Drecorated Black Canopy chariot.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　魏書曰：言其逼天子也。獻帝紀曰；卓既為太師，復欲稱尚父，以問蔡邕。邕曰：「昔武王受命，太公為師，輔佐周室，以伐無道，是以天下尊之，稱為尚父。今公之功德誠為巍巍，宜須關東悉定，車駕東還，然後議之。」乃止。京師地震，卓又問邕。邕對曰：「地動陰盛，大臣踰制之所致也。公乘青蓋車，遠近以為非宜。」卓從之，更乘金華皂蓋車也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-14" id="annotation-14">[14]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó's sons carried in the bosoms of concubines all were enfeoffed Marquesses, playing with gold [seals] and purple [ribbons]. His son's daughter named [Dǒng] Bái, at the time not yet of age [under fifteen], was enfeoffed as Lady of Wèiyáng. At Méi city's east raised a platform, depth and width over two zhàng, height five to six chǐ, had [Dǒng] Bái ride a curtained Gold Decorated Blue Canopy Chariot, Commandants and Central Cadet Generals and Inspectors of a thousand dàn rank that were at Méi, each were made to ride curtained carriage with hairpin pens,^[In formal Court dress, officials would use writing brush pens as hairpins in their headgear in order to be able to write notes and draft government documents at any time.] to be [Dǒng] Bái's guides and escorts, to the top of the platform, having his elder brother's son [Dǒng] Huáng as Envoy Conferring the Seal and Ribbon.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　英雄記曰：卓侍妾懷抱中子，皆封侯，弄以金紫。孫女名白，時尚未笄，封為渭陽君。於郿城東起壇，從廣二丈餘，高五六尺，使白乘軒金華青蓋車，都尉、中郎將、刺史千石在郿者，各令乘軒簪筆，為白導從，之壇上，使兄子璜為使者授印綬。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-15" id="annotation-15">[15]</a> Shānyáng-gōng Zǎijì states: Previously [Dǒng] Zhuó was Front General, Huángfǔ Sōng was Left General, both on campaign against Hán Suì, each would not defer to the other. Later [Dǒng] Zhuó was summoned to be Minister Treasurer and Bìng Province Governor, his troops to be subordinated to [Huángfǔ] Sōng, [Dǒng] Zhuó was greatly furious. Reaching to becoming Grand Preceptor, [Huángfǔ] Sōng was Censorate Central Deputy, bowed below the chariot. [Dǒng] Zhuó asked [Huángfǔ] Sōng: "Yìzhēn^[Huángfǔ Sōng's appellation (zì).] are you submitting now?" [Huángfǔ] Sōng said: "How could I have know Your Enlightened Excellency was then reach to this?" [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "The swan inherently has far-reaching ambition, but the sparrows naturally do not understand." [Huángfǔ] Sōng said: "In I with Your Enlightened Excellency both were swans, but unexpectedly now you have changed into a Fènghuáng.^[The fènghuáng is a mythical bird considered the king of birds. The term is sometimes translated as "phoenix" but the fènghuáng does not have the same associations of cyclical rebirth through fire as the phoenix myth.] [Dǒng] Zhuó laughed and said: "If you had earlier submitted, today you could not bow."

Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì states: [Dǒng] Zhuó clapped his hands and said to Huángfǔ Sōng stating: "Yìzhēn are you afraid or not?" [Huángfǔ] Sōng replied stating: "Your Enlightened Excellency by virtue assists the Court, great celebrations are about to arrive, what fear is to be had? If excessive punishments are flaunted, then Heaven's Under would all be afraid, how would it only be [me, Huángfǔ] Sōng?" [Dǒng] Zhuó was silent, and therefore with [Huángfǔ] Sōng made peace.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　山陽公載記曰：初卓為前將軍，皇甫嵩為左將軍，俱征韓遂，各不相下。後卓徵為少府并州牧，兵當屬嵩，卓大怒。及為太師，嵩為御史中丞，拜於車下。卓問嵩：「義真服未乎？」嵩曰：「安知明公乃至於是！」卓曰：「鴻鵠固有遠志，但燕雀自不知耳。」嵩曰：「昔與明公俱為鴻鵠，不意今日變為鳳皇耳。」卓笑曰：「卿早服，今日可不拜也。」張璠漢紀曰：卓抵其手謂皇甫嵩曰：「義真怖未乎？」嵩對曰：「明公以德輔朝廷，大慶方至，何怖之有？若淫刑以逞，將天下皆懼，豈獨嵩乎？」卓默然，遂與嵩和解。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}

::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-16" id="annotation-16">[16]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: Méi from Cháng'ān is two hundred sixty lǐ.^[During Hàn, one lǐ was about 415 meters, 260 lǐ would be about 108 kilometers.]
:::

::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　英雄記曰：郿去長安二百六十里。
:::

〔六〕橫音光。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}

<a href="#source-18" id="annotation-18">[18]</a> Fú-zǐ states: In Emperor Líng's time postings at the gates sold government offices, thereupon Grand Commandant Duàn Jiǒng, Excellency over the Masses Cuī Liè, Grand Commmandant Fán Líng, Excellency of Works Zhāng Wēn and their sorts, all donated cash up to ten million and down to five million to buy the Three Excellencies. [Duàn] Jiǒng repeatedly on campaign had great achievements, [Cuī] Liè had weighty reputation in the northern provinces, [Zhāng] Wēn had outstanding talent, [Fán] Líng was able to accomodate the times, all were prominent servicemen of their time, yet they used money to obtain position, so all the more for Liú Xiāo, Táng Zhēn, Zhāng Hào and their factions.

Fēngsú Tōng states: Director of Retainers Liú Xiāo due to the faction of the various Regular Attendants reached position in the Excellency assistants.

Xù Hàn shū states: Táng Zhēn was Central Regular Attendant Táng Héng's younger brother. Zhāng Hào was Central Regular Attendant Zhāng Fèng's younger brother.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔七〕　傅子曰：靈帝時牓門賣官，於是太尉段熲、司徒崔烈、太尉樊陵、司空張溫之徒，皆入錢上千萬下五百萬以買三公。熲數征伐有大功，烈有北州重名，溫有傑才，陵能偶時，皆一時顯士，猶以貨取位，而況于劉囂、唐珍、張顥之黨乎！風俗通曰：司隸劉囂，以黨諸常侍，致位公輔。續漢書曰：唐珍，中常侍唐衡弟。張顥，中常侍張奉弟。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-19" id="annotation-19">[19]</a> Wèi shū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó sent Director of Retainers Colonel Liú Xiāo to register the clerks and civilians that as sons were not filial, as servants were not loyal, as clerks were not pure, as younger brothers were not obedient, and those in answer to this were all executed and their property confusciated by the government. Thereupon loves and hates mutually rose, of the people many died unjustly.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔八〕　魏書曰：卓使司隸校尉劉囂籍吏民有為子不孝，為臣不忠，為吏不清，為弟不順，有應此者皆身誅，財物沒官。於是愛憎互起，民多冤死。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Third Year Fourth Moon [192 Apr 30 - May 28], Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn, Secretariat Writers Deputy-Director Shìsūn Ruì, [Dǒng] Zhuó's officer Lǚ Bù together planned to executed [Dǒng] Zhuó. At the time, Heaven's Son had an illness and was newly recovered, great assembly at Wèiyāng Hall. [Lǚ] Bù sent his same prefecture Cavalry Commandant Lǐ Sù and others to lead personal troops of over ten people, falsely dressed in guard uniforms defending the Side Gate. [Lǚ] Bù kept in his bosom an Edict letter. [Dǒng] Zhuó arrived, [Lǐ] Sù and the rest blocked [Dǒng] Zhuó. [Dǒng] Zhuó in alarm shouted where [Lǚ] Bù was. [Lǚ] Bù said: "There is an Edict." Therefore killed [Dǒng] Zhuó, exterminated Three Clans. Registrar Tián Jǐng ran ahead to [Dǒng] Zhuó's corpse, [Lǚ] Bù also killed him. Altogether the killed were three people, of the rest none dared move. <a href="#annotation-20" id="source-20">[20]</a> Cháng'ān servicemen and civilians all congratulated one another, those that had flattered [Dǒng] Zhuó were all sent down to prison and died. <a href="#annotation-21" id="source-21">[21]</a> 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
三年四月，司徒王允、尚書僕射士孫瑞、卓將呂布共謀誅卓。是時，天子有疾新愈，大會未央殿。布使同郡騎都尉李肅等，將親兵十餘人，偽著衛士服守掖門。布懷詔書。卓至，肅等格卓。卓驚呼布所在。布曰「有詔」，遂殺卓，夷三族。主簿田景前趨卓尸，布又殺之；凡所殺三人，餘莫敢動。〔一〕長安士庶咸相慶賀，諸阿附卓者皆下獄死。〔二〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-20" id="annotation-20">[20]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: At the time there was a folk song that said: "Thousand lǐ grass, how green green, ten days divination, yet not surviving."^[Thousand (千), lǐ (里), and grass (艸) together form the character Dǒng (董). Ten (十), day (日), and divination (卜) form the character Zhuó (卓).] Also thre was a composed "Dǒng Flees" song. Also there was a Dào priest that wrote on a cloth (bù) with the "Lǚ" character to show to [Dǒng] Zhuó, [Dǒng] Zhuó did not understand it referred to Lǚ Bù. [Dǒng] Zhuó was about to enter the assembly, lined up infantry and cavalry, from the camp to the Palace, in Court Dress escorted to go through the middle. His horse stumbled and would not advance, [Dǒng] Zhuó in his heart was bewildered and wished to stop, [Lǚ] Bù encouraged to have him go, so he wore armor inside and entered. When [Dǒng] Zhuó died, at the time the sun and moon were pure and quite, the slightest breeze did not rise. [Dǒng] Mín, [Dǒng] Huáng and the rest with their clan old and young were all at Méi, all returned, and were by their various subordianates chopped down or shot. [Dǒng] Zhuó's mother was aged ninety, fled to the fortress gate stating: "I beg to be spared from death." At once cut off her head. The Yuán clan's disciples and former clerks replaced the coffins of the various Yuán killed at Méi, collected and gathered the Dǒng clan corpses to their side and burned them. Exposed [Dǒng] Zhuó's corpse in the market. [Dǒng] Zhuó was fat, the grease flowed to soak the ground, the grass turning red. The clerks guarding the corpse in the dark made a large wick, stuck it in [Dǒng] Zhuó's navel to make a lamp, bright reaching to dawn, and was like this for several days. Later [Dǒng] Zhuó's former division retainers collected the ashes of the burned, combining it into one coffin, buried at Méi. Inside [Dǒng] Zhuó's fortress the gold was twenty to thirty thousand jīn, silver eighty to ninety thousand jīn, pearls and jade and brocade and silk and unusual trinkets and various things all were piled into a tall mountain, it could not be counted.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：時有謠言曰：「千里艸，何青青，十日卜，猶不生。」又作董逃之歌。又有道士書布為「呂」字以示卓，卓不知其為呂布也。卓當入會，陳列步騎，自營至宮，朝服導引行其中。馬躓不前，卓心怪欲止，布勸使行，乃衷甲而入。卓既死，當時日月清淨，微風不起。旻、璜等及宗族老弱悉在郿，皆還，為其群下所斫射。卓母年九十，走至塢門曰「乞脫我死」，即斬首。袁氏門生故吏，改殯諸袁死于郿者，斂聚董氏尸于其側而焚之。暴卓尸于市。卓素肥，膏流浸地，草為之丹。守尸吏暝以為大炷，置卓臍中以為燈，光明達旦，如是積日。後卓故部曲收所燒者灰，并以一棺棺之，葬于郿。卓塢中金有二三萬斤，銀八九萬斤，珠玉錦綺奇玩雜物皆山崇阜積，不可知數。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-21" id="annotation-21">[21]</a> Xiè Chéng's Hòu Hàn shū states: Cài Yōng was with Wáng Yǔn seated, heard [Dǒng] Zhuó had died, and had a sound of sighing in pity. [Wáng] Yǔn reproached [Cài] Yōng stating: "[Dǒng] Zhuó was the state's great rebel, killed Ruler and slaughtered Ministers, what Heaven and Earth would not bless, what Humanity and Divinity alike abhored. You are the King's servant, for generations received the Hàn's grace, the State's Ruler was endangered, you never once turned spear, [Dǒng] Zhuó received Heaven's punishment, yet instead you sigh in sorrow?" Then ordered to arrest and send to the Minister of Justice. [Cài] Yōng apologized to [Wáng] Yǔn stating: "Though I am not loyal, yet I know great righteousness. Safety or danger of antiquity to the present, my ears are full of hearing, my mouth always discusses, how could I turn back on the state and so turn to [Dǒng] Zhuó? Words of insane blindness came out in error and brings in misfortune, I hope for tattooing head as punishment to continue writing Hàn history. The Excellencies and Ministers cherished [Cài] Yōng's talent, all together remonstrated [Wáng] Yǔn. [Wáng] Yǔn said: "In the past Emperor Wǔ did not kill Sīmǎ Qiān, letting him compose a book of slander, passed to later generations. Right now the state's blessings are in the middle of decline, war horses in the suburbs, we cannot allow a flattering minister to use pen in a Young Ruler's Left and Right, later it will cause our group to all receive slanderous comments." Therefore killed [Cài] Yōng.

Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: Cài Yōng though was by [Dǒng] Zhuó closely appointed, his feelings certainly were not of his faction. How could he not know of [Dǒng] Zhuó's treachery and viciousness, that he was by Heaven's Under loathed? On hearing of his death, logically there would be no sigh of pity. Even supposing if it was so, he would not have answered such words in Wáng Yǔn's seating. This probably is Xiè Chéng's absurd record. Scribe [Sīmǎ] Qiān's Annals and Biographies widely had unique achievements to the world, but yet to say that Wáng Yǔn said that Xiào-Wǔ should have earlier killed [Sīmǎ] Qiān, this is not the words of the knowledgable. [Sīmǎ] Qiān merely did not conceal Xiào-Wǔ's failings, only directly writing his affairs, what slander was there? Wáng Yǔn's loyal uprightness could be said to reflect on oneself without guilt, without fear of slander, if he wished to kill [Cài] Yōng, he would have discussed why [Cài] Yōng should die or not, how could he worry of being slandered himself and so unjustly kill a good man? This all is the extreme of false accusations and nonsense.

Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì states: Previously, Cài Yōng for speaking out on affairs met with exile, his reputation heard in Heaven's Under, his righteousness moving servicemen of will. When he returned, the inner favorites hated him. [Cài] Yōng was afraid, and so fled to the sea shore, dealing with and relying on Tàishān's Yáng clan, accumulating to ten years. When [Dǒng] Zhuó became Grand Commandant, recruited him as an Assistant, for high performance became Attendant Censor Managing Documents, within three days then reached Secretariat Writer. Later promoted to Bādōng Administrator, [Dǒng] Zhuó sent up to have him stay and appointed Attendant Central, reaching Cháng'ān became Left Central Cadet General. [Dǒng] Zhuó valued his talent, generously treated him, every time there was a Court affair, always had [Cài] Yōng provide the drafts. Reaching to when [Wáng] Yǔn was about to kill [Cài] Yōng, at the time of the famed servicemen many spoke up for him, [Wáng] Yǔn repented and wished to stop, but [Cài] Yōng was already dead.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　謝承後漢書曰：蔡邕在王允坐，聞卓死，有歎惜之音。允責邕曰：「卓，國之大賊，殺主殘臣，天地所不祐，人神所同疾。君為王臣，世受漢恩，國主危難，曾不倒戈，卓受天誅，而更嗟痛乎？」便使收付廷尉。邕謝允曰：「雖以不忠，猶識大義，古今安危，耳所厭聞，口所常玩，豈當背國而向卓也？狂瞽之詞，謬出患入，願黥首為刑以繼漢史。」公卿惜邕才，咸共諫允。允曰：「昔武帝不殺司馬遷，使作謗書，流於後世。方今國祚中衰，戎馬在郊，不可令佞臣執筆在幼主左右，後令吾徒並受謗議。」遂殺邕。臣松之以為蔡邕雖為卓所親任，情必不黨。寧不知卓之姦凶，為天下所毒，聞其死亡，理無歎惜。縱復令然，不應反言于王允之坐。斯殆謝承之妄記也。史遷紀傳，博有奇功于世，而云王允謂孝武應早殺遷，此非識者之言。但遷為不隱孝武之失，直書其事耳，何謗之有乎？王允之忠正，可謂內省不疚者矣，既無懼于謗，且欲殺邕，當論邕應死與不，豈可慮其謗己而枉戮善人哉！此皆誣罔不通之甚者。張璠漢紀曰：初，蔡邕以言事見徙，名聞天下，義動志士。及還，內寵惡之。邕恐，乃亡命海濱，往來依太山羊氏，積十年。卓為太尉，辟為掾，以高第為侍御史治書，三日中遂至尚書。後遷巴東太守，卓上留拜侍中，至長安為左中郎將。卓重其才，厚遇之。每有朝廷事，常令邕具草。及允將殺邕，時名士多為之言，允悔欲止，而邕已死。
:::
:::
:::

### Lǐ Jué, Guō Sì {.unnumbered #lijue #guosi}

::: {.columns #niufu}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, [Dǒng] Zhuó's daughter's husband Central Cadet General Niú Fǔ managed troops in a separate garrison at Shǎn, divided and sent Colonels Lǐ Jué, Guō Sì, Zhāng Jì to plunder Chénliú's and Yǐngchuān's various counties. When [Dǒng] Zhuó died, Lǚ Bù sent Lǐ Sù to arrive at Shǎn, wishing to with Edict mandate execute [Niú] Fǔ. [Niú] Fǔ and the rest opposed [Lǐ] Sù in battle, [Lǐ] Sù was defeated and fled to Hóngnóng, [Lǚ] Bù executed [Lǐ] Sù. <a href="#annotation-22" id="source-22">[22]</a> After that in [Niú] Fǔ's camp soldiers there were some in the night that rebelled and exited, inside the camp was alarmed, [Niú] Fǔ believed all were rebelling, and so took gold and treasures, alone with those he had previously generously treated, Pūhú Chì'ér and others of five to six people accompanying, went over the city wall north to cross the Hé, Chì'ér and the rest were greedy for his gold and treasures, cut off his head and sent it to Cháng'ān.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，卓女婿中郎將牛輔典兵別屯陝，分遣校尉李傕、郭汜、張濟略陳留、潁川諸縣。卓死，呂布使李肅至陝，欲以詔命誅輔。輔等逆與肅戰，肅敗走弘農，布誅肅。〔一〕其後輔營兵有夜叛出者，營中驚，輔以為皆叛，乃取金寶，獨與素所厚（友）〔攴〕胡赤兒等五六人相隨，踰城北渡河，赤兒等利其金寶，斬首送長安。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-22" id="annotation-22">[22]</a> Wèi shū states: [Niú] Fǔ was afraid and timid and lost his composure, could not be at ease with himself. Always he held a talismen for warding off weapons,^[A talisman for warding off weapons (bì bīng fú) was a magical charm to protect against weapons.] had an axe and block^[Axe and block were tools for execution, placing the victim's head atop the block and then cutting the head off with the axe.] delivered to his side, wishing to strengthen himself. When meeting guests, he first had a physiognomist appraise them, to know if they had a rebellious aura or not, and also stalk divined to know good or bad fortune,^[Stalk divination (shì) was an ancient divination practice of using yarrow stalks to generate random numbers to select one of the sixty-four hexagrams.] and only afterward then met them. Central Cadet General Dǒng Yuè came to meet [Niú] Fǔ, [Niú] Fǔ had a stalk divination for him, obtained Duì bottom Lí top, the stalk diviner said: "Fire overcoming metal, is the hexagram of outside plotting against inside."^[The trigram Lí (☲) is associated with fire, the trigram duì with metal (☱). Lí on top of Duì forms the hexagram gé (䷰).] Immediately killed [Dǒng] Yuè.

Xiàn-dì jì says: The stalk divining person always was whipped by [Dǒng] Yué therefore he took advantage of this to take revenge on him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　魏書曰：輔恇怯失守，不能自安。常把辟兵符，以鈇鑕致其旁，欲以自彊。見客，先使相者相之，知有反氣與不，又筮知吉凶，然後乃見之。中郎將董越來就輔，輔使筮之，得兌下離上，筮者曰：「火勝金，外謀內之卦也。」即時殺越。獻帝紀云：筮人常為越所鞭，故因此以報之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
By the time [Lǐ] Jué and the rest returned, [Niú] Fǔ was already destroyed, the multitudes had none ot rely on, wishing to each scatter and go home. There had been no pardon letter, and it was heard that those in Cháng'ān wished to completely execute all the Liáng Province men, they were anxious and afraid and did not know what to do. Used Jiǎ Xǔ's strategy, therefore led the multitudes and went west, wherever they were collecting troops, by the time they reached Cháng'ān, the multitudes were over a hundred thousand, <a href="#annotation-23" id="source-23">[23]</a> with [Dǒng] Zhuó's former division retainer Fán Chóu, Lǐ Méng, Wáng Fāng and others surrounding and besieging Cháng'ān city. In ten days the city fell, with [Lǚ] Bù battled inside the city, [Lǚ] Bù was defeated and fled. [Lǐ] Jué and the rest released the troops to plunder Cháng'ān's old and young, killing them completely, the dead like a wolf's mat.^[A wolf's mat (lángjí) was a metaphor for total chaos and disorder, based on a folk belief that wolves left a trampled mess wherever they stopped in order to not be tracked.] Executed the ones who killed [Dǒng] Zhuó, exposed the corpse of Wáng Yǔn in the market. <a href="#annotation-24" id="source-24">[24]</a> Buried [Dǒng] Zhuó at Méi, large gale and torrential rain shook [Dǒng] Zhuó's grave, water flowed into the storage, drifitng away his coffins. [Lǐ] Jué became Chariots and Cavalry General, Marquess of Chíyáng,^[Chíyáng county was in Zuǒpíngyí.] designate Director of Retainers Colonel, Lent Stave. [Guō] Sì became Rear General, Marquess of Měiyáng.^[Měiyáng county was in Yòufúfēng.] [Fán] Chóu became Right General, Marquess of Wànnián.^[Wànnián county was in Zuǒpíngyí.] [Lǐ] Jué, [Guō] Sì, [Fán] Chóu usurped control of the Court and government. <a href="#annotation-25" id="source-25">[25]</a> [Zhāng] Jì became Agile Cavalry General, Marquess of Píngyáng,^[Píngyáng county was in Hédōng.] garrisoned Hóngnóng.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
比傕等還，輔已敗，眾無所依，欲各散歸。既無赦書，而聞長安中欲盡誅涼州人，憂恐不知所為。用賈詡策，遂將其眾而西，所在收兵，比至長安，眾十餘萬，〔一〕與卓故部曲樊稠、李蒙、王方等合圍長安城。十日城陷，與布戰城中，布敗走。傕等放兵略長安老少，殺之悉盡，死者狼籍。誅殺卓者，尸王允于市。〔二〕葬卓于郿，大風暴雨震卓墓，水流入藏，漂其棺槨。傕為車騎將軍、池陽侯，領司隸校尉、假節。汜為後將軍、美陽侯。稠為右將軍、萬年侯。傕、汜、稠擅朝政。〔三〕濟為驃騎將軍、平陽侯，屯弘農。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-23" id="annotation-23">[23]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Lǐ] Jué and the rest were at Shǎn, all were afraid, urgently gathered troops to defend themselves. Hú Wéncái, Yáng Zhěngxiū all were Liáng Province's great figures, but Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn previously was not friendly with them. Reaching to Lǐ Jué's rebellion, [Wáng] Yǔn then called [Hú] Wéncái and [Yáng] Zhěngxiū to have them go east to explain to them, did not borrow a warm expression, and spoke stating: "What do the rats east of the passes wish to do? You go shout at them." Thereupon the two men went, in fact summoned troops and returned [as part of the besiegers].
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　九州春秋曰：傕等在陝，皆恐怖，急擁兵自守。胡文才、楊整脩皆涼州大人，而司徒王允素所不善也。及李傕之叛，允乃呼文才、整脩使東解釋之，不假借以溫顏，謂曰：「關東鼠子欲何為邪？卿往呼之。」於是二人往，實召兵而還。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-24" id="annotation-24">[24]</a> Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì states: [Lǚ] Bù's troops were dfeated, he halted horse at Qīngsuǒ Gate's exterior, spoke to [Wáng] Yǔn stating: "Your Excellency can leave." [Wáng] Yǔn said: "Calming the country is my highest hope. If it cannot be obtained, then I will offer my body to death. The Court's Young Ruler depends on us and no other, on facing danger to cowardly escape, I will not do. Strive hard and apologize to the various Excellencies east of the passes, to remember the country." [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì entered Cháng'ān city, garrisoned the South Palace Side Gate, killed Minister Charioteer Lǔ Kuí, Minister Herald Zhōu Huàn, City Gate Colonel Cuī Liè, Surpassing Cavalry Colonel Wáng Qí. The clerks and civilians dead could not be counted. Excellency over the Masses Wáng Yǔn grasped Heaven's Son to go up Xuānpíng City Gate to avoid the troops, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest at the City Gate's bottom bowed, prostrate on the ground and knocking head [on the ground]. The Emperor spoke to [Lǐ] Jué and the rest stating: "You cannot create power or fortune,^[To create power (zuò wēi) and to create fortune (zuò fú) is an idiom for the authority of the ruler to order deaths and spare lives.] but yet then release troops without restraint, what do you wish to do?" [Lǐ] Jué and the rest said: "Dǒng Zhuó was loyal to Your Majesty, but without reason was by Lǚ​ Bù killed. We Your Servants are avenging [Dǒng] Zhuó, we do not dare to rebel. We request that when the affair is finished, to go to the Minister of Justice to receive punishment." [Wáng] Yǔn was thoroughly forced out to go meet [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué executed [Wáng] Yǔn and his wife and children and clansmen of over ten people. Inside Cháng'ān city of the male and female and large and small none did not shed tears. [Wáng] Yǔn appellation Zǐshī was a Tàiyuán Qí man. In youth he had great integrity, Guō Tài met and was amazed with him, stating: "Student Wáng in one day crosses a thousand lǐ, a talent to be a King's aide." Though [Guō] Tài was his senior, then they established a relationship. The Three Excellencies all recruited him, he served as Yù Province Inspector, recruited Xún Shuǎng, Kǒng Róng as Following Officials, promoted to Hénán Intendant, Secretariat Writers Director. Reaching to becoming Excellency over the Masses, his way in assisting the Ruling House, extremely had the integrity of a great minister. From Heaven's Son on down, all depended on him. [Dǒng] Zhuó also relied on and trusted him, entrusting him with the Court.

Huà Qiáo states: The servicemen by uprightness establishes, by strategy relieves, by righteousness succeeds. Like Wáng Yǔn's accomodating Dǒng Zhuó and sharing in his power, watching for his opening and then trapping his crimes. At this time, Heaven's Under was difficult to resolve, the root of it was all controlled by loyalty and righteousness, therefore accomodating [Dǒng] Zhuó did not lose uprighteness, sharing in power was not to be unrighteous, watching for opening was not to be deceitful, therefore by strategy relieving and righteousness succeeding, yet it was the result of uprightness.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　張璠漢紀曰：布兵敗，駐馬青瑣門外，謂允曰：「公可以去。」允曰：「安國家，吾之上願也，若不獲，則奉身以死。朝廷幼主恃我而已，臨難苟免，吾不為也。努力謝關東諸公，以國家為念。」傕、汜入長安城，屯南宮掖門，殺太僕魯馗、大鴻臚周奐、城門校尉崔烈、越騎校尉王頎。吏民死者不可勝數。司徒王允挾天子上宣平城門避兵，傕等於城門下拜，伏地叩頭。帝謂傕等曰：「卿無作威福，而乃放兵縱橫，欲何為乎？」傕等曰：「董卓忠于陛下，而無故為呂布所殺。臣等為卓報讎，弗敢為逆也。請事竟，詣廷尉受罪。」允窮逼出見傕，傕誅允及妻子宗族十餘人。長安城中男女大小莫不流涕。允字子師，太原祁人也。少有大節，郭泰見而奇之，曰：「王生一日千里，王佐之才也。」泰雖先達，遂與定交。三公並辟，歷豫州刺史，辟荀爽、孔融為從事，遷河南尹、尚書令。及為司徒，其所以扶持王室，甚得大臣之節，自天子以下，皆倚賴焉。卓亦推信之，委以朝廷。華嶠曰：夫士以正立，以謀濟，以義成，若王允之推董卓而分其權，伺其間而弊其罪。當此之時，天下之難解矣，本之皆主於忠義也，故推卓不為失正，分權不為不義，伺閒不為狙詐，是以謀濟義成，而歸於正也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-25" id="annotation-25">[25]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Lǐ] Jué was a Běidì man. [Guō] Sì was a Zhāngyè man, another name [Guō] Duō.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　英雄記曰：傕，北地人。汜，張掖人，一名多。
:::
:::
:::

### Hán Suì, Mǎ Téng  {.unnumbered #mateng #hansui}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
That Year, Hán Suì, Mǎ Téng, and others surrendered, led their multitudes to visit Cháng'ān. Appointed [Hán] Suì as Defending West General, sent to return to Liáng Province, [Mǎ] Téng as Campaigning West General, garrisoning Méi. Attendant Central Mǎ Yǔ with Remonstration Consultant Grandee Zhǒng Shào, Left Central Cadet General Liú Fàn and others planned, wishing to have [Mǎ] Téng attack Cháng'ān, themselves as inside support, to execute [Lǐ] Jué and the rest. [Mǎ] Téng led troops to reach Chángpíng Watchtower, [Mǎ] Yǔ and the rest's plan leaked, fled out to Huáilǐ. [Fán] Chóu struck [Mǎ] Téng, [Mǎ] Téng was defeated and fled, returned to Liáng Province; also attacked Huáilǐ, [Mǎ] Yǔ and the rest all died. At the time the Three Adjuncts' people were still several hundred thousand households, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest released troops to pillage and plunder, attack and rob cities and towns, the people were starving and destitute, within two years they were eating each other and completely wiped out. <a href="#annotation-26" id="source-26">[26]</a> 
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
是歲，韓遂、馬騰等降，率眾詣長安。以遂為鎮西將軍，遣還涼州，騰征西將軍，屯郿。侍中馬宇與諫議大夫种邵、左中郎將劉範等謀，欲使騰襲長安，己為內應，以誅傕等。騰引兵至長平觀，宇等謀泄，出奔槐里。稠擊騰，騰敗走，還涼州；　又攻槐里，宇等皆死。時三輔民尚數十萬戶，傕等放兵劫略，攻剽城邑，人民飢困，二年閒相啖食略盡。〔一〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-26" id="annotation-26">[26]</a> Xiàn-dì jì states: At that time of newly moving the capital, of the Palace women many lost clothes, the Emperor wished to issue the Management Office's^[The Management Office (yùfǔ) was the Imperial Palace's internal treasury and storehouse.] silk to give to them, Lǐ Jué did not wish it, stating: "Inside the Palace there is clothing, why make more?" Edict sold stable horses of over a hundred, the Management Office and Minister of Agriculture produced various silks of twenty thousand pǐ, with the revenue of the sold stable horses, bestowed on the Excellencies and Ministers on down reaching to the poor people that could not support themselves. Lǐ Jué said: "My residence stores are few," and so had all conveyed and placed in his camp. Jiǎ Xǔ said: "This is the Superior's intentions, it cannot be refused." [Lǐ] Jué did not follow this.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝紀曰：是時新遷都，宮人多亡衣服，帝欲發御府繒以與之，李傕弗欲，曰：「宮中有衣，胡為復作邪？」詔賣廄馬百餘匹，御府大司農出雜繒二萬匹，與所賣廄馬直，賜公卿以下及貧民不能自存者。李傕曰「我邸閣儲偫少」，乃悉載置其營。賈詡曰「此上意，不可拒」，傕不從之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
The various officers fought over power, therefore killed [Fán] Chóu, absorbed his multitudes. <a href="#annotation-27" id="source-27">[27]</a> [Guō] Sì with [Lǐ] Jué turned to mutual suspicion, battled and fought within Cháng'ān. <a href="#annotation-28" id="source-28">[28]</a> [Lǐ] Jué held hostage Heaven's Son in his camp, burned the Palace Halls and City Gates, plundered the Government Offices, completely collecting the [imperial] chariots and carriages and uniforms and imperial objects to be placed in his house. <a href="#annotation-29" id="source-29">[29]</a> [Lǐ] Jué sent the Excellencies and Ministers to visit [Guō] Sì to ask for peace, [Guō] Sì seized the mall. <a href="#annotation-30" id="source-30">[30]</a> Attached and struck one another for successive moons, the dead were in the tens of thousands. <a href="#annotation-31" id="source-31">[31]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
諸將爭權，遂殺稠，并其眾。〔一〕汜與傕轉相疑，戰鬥長安中。〔二〕傕質天子於營，燒宮殿城門，略官寺，盡收乘輿服御物置其家。〔三〕傕使公卿詣汜請和，汜皆執之。〔四〕相攻擊連月，死者萬數。〔五〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-27" id="annotation-27">[27]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: At Mǎ Téng's and Hán Suì's defeat, Fán Chóu pursued reaching Chéncāng. [Hán] Suì spoke with [Fán] Chóu stating: "Heaven and Earth turn around, it cannot be predicted. The root of the fighting is not private grudges, it is merely an affair of the Ruling House. You and I are of the same region, although now there is a small opposition, there will be large agreement. I wish to with good words take leave of you. If by chance ten thousand to one it is not as wished, later can we meet one another again?" Both withdrew cavalry and went ahead to meet horses, crossed arms to meet one another, together spoke for a long time and then separated. [Lǐ] Jué's elder brother's son [Lǐ] Lì accompanied [Fán] Chóu, [Lǐ] Lì returned and reported to [Lǐ] Jué: "Hán and Fán met on horse and talked, it is not known what was discussed, their affection was extremely close." [Lǐ] Jué because of this suspected [Fán] Chóu of privately making peace with [Hán] Suì and having ulterior intentions. [Fán] Chóu wished to lead troops east to set out the passes, from [Lǐ] Jué requested additional troops. Took advantage to invite [Fán] Chóu to a meeting to discuss, and then at the seating killed [Fán] Chóu.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　九州春秋曰：馬騰、韓遂之敗，樊稠追至陳倉。遂語稠曰：「天地反覆，未可知也。本所爭者非私怨，王家事耳。與足下州里人，今雖小違，要當大同，欲相與善語以別。邂逅萬一不如意，後可復相見乎！」俱卻騎前接馬，交臂相加，共語良久而別。傕兄子利隨稠，利還告傕，韓、樊交馬語，不知所道，意愛甚密。傕以是疑稠與韓遂私和而有異意。稠欲將兵東出關，從傕索益兵。因請稠會議，便於坐殺稠。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-28" id="annotation-28">[28]</a> Diǎnlüè states: [Lǐ] Jué repeatedly set alcohol and invited [Guō] Sì, sometimes keeping [Guō] Sì to stay overnight. [Guō] Sì's wife feared [Lǐ] Jué would give [Guō] Sì maids and concubines that would steal his affection from her, and thought to alienate them. It happened that [Lǐ] Jué sent gifted food, the wife thus used fermented beans to resemble a poison, [Guō] Sì was about to eat, the wife said: "The food from the outside came, suppose if there is a problem?" Therefore she plucked out the poison to show him, stating: "One perch does not have two males, I firmly doubt, General, your trust in Excellency Lǐ." On another day [Lǐ] Jué again invited [Guō] Sì, greatly intoxicated. [Guō] Sì suspected [Lǐ] Jué of poisoning him, strained manure juice and drank it to then vomit. Thereupon it then grew into hostility, and so they drilled troops to attack one another.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　典略曰：傕數設酒請汜，或留汜止宿。汜妻懼傕與汜婢妾而奪己愛，思有以離閒之。會傕送饋，妻乃以豉為藥，汜將食，妻曰：「食從外來，倘或有故！」遂摘藥示之，曰：「一栖不二雄，我固疑將軍之信李公也。」他日傕復請汜，大醉。汜疑傕藥之，絞糞汁飲之乃解。於是遂生嫌隙，而治兵相攻。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-29" id="annotation-29">[29]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Previously, [Guō] Sì planned to welcome Heaven's Son to visit his camp, in the night there was a deserter who informed [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué sent his elder brother's son [Lǐ] Xiān to lead several thousand troops to encircle the Palace, with chariots of three carriages to welcome Heaven's Son. Yáng Biāo said: "Since antiquity of Emperors and Kings none have been in the houses of servants of men. Actions must accord with the hearts of Heaven's Under, you sirs in doing this, it is not right." [Lǐ] Xiān said: "The General's plan is settled." Thereupon Heaven's Son rode one carriage, Noble Lady Fú-shì one carriage, Jiǎ Xǔ and Zuǒ Líng one carriage, the remainder all walked to follow. That day, [Lǐ] Jué further moved the carriages to visit the north fortress, sending a Colonel to supervise the fortress gates, inside and outside cut off. The various attendant ministers all had expressions of hunger, at the time it was the peak of summer heat, the people were completely cold in heart. The Emperor requested rice of five hú, ox bones of five sets to bestow on the Left and Right, [Lǐ] Jué said: "Morning and evening I send up food, What use is rice for?" Thus gave rotten ox bones, all of foul odor and could not be eaten. The Emperor was greatly furious, wished to question and reprimand him. Attendant Central Yáng Qí sent up a sealed message that said: "[Lǐ] Jué is a man of the frontiers, accustomed to Yí manners, now he also himself knows his violations are perverse and rebellious, always having expressions of discontentment, wishing to escort the Chariot Carriage to visit Huángbáichéng to relieve his anger. Your Servant wishes for Your Majesty to endure this, one cannot yet expose his crimes." The Emperor accepted this. Previously, [Lǐ] Jué garrisoned Huángbáichéng, and therefore planned wishing to relocate there. [Lǐ] Jué, as Excellency over the Masses Zhào Wēn did not agree with him, thus detained [Zhào] Wēn inside the fortress. [Zhào] Wēn heard that [Lǐ] Jué wished to move the carriages, his letter to [Lǐ] Jué said: "Your Excellency formerly claimed to avenge Excellency Dǒng, however in fact slaughtered and sacked the Ruler's city, massacred the chief ministers, what Heaven's Under cannot understand house by house or be explained to door by door. Now to contend over the discord of angry glances, to create an enmity of a thousand jūn, the people are [suffering] in mud and ash, each unable to make a living, but not once do you change to waking, and therefore achieve disaster and chaos. The Court repeatedly sends down enlightened Edicts, wishing to order peace and reconciliation, the Edict mandates are not enacted, favor and grace daily damaged, yet you further wish to escort the carriage to Huángbáichéng, this truly is what [I, this] old man cannot understand. According to the Yì, 'one overstep is an overstep, twice is trespass, thrice and yet not changing, exterminates the head, ominous.' It is not as good as early making peace together, leading troops back to garrison, above coming the Ten Thousand Carriages, below preserving the living people, would it not be extreme fortune?" [Lǐ] Jué was greatly furious, wished to send someone to murder [Zhào] Wēn. His younger cousin [Lǐ] Yīng was [Zhào] Wēn's former Assistant, remonstrated him for several days and so he stopped. The Emperor heard of [Zhào] Wēn's letter to [Lǐ] Jué, and asked Attendant Central Cháng Qià stating: "[Lǐ] Jué does not know good from evil, [Zhào] Wēn's words were too cutting, it can make one cold in heart." Replied stating: "Lǐ Yīng already resolved it." The Emperor then was pleased.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　獻帝起居注曰：初，汜謀迎天子幸其營，夜有亡告傕者，傕使兄子暹將數千兵圍宮，以車三乘迎天子。楊彪曰：「自古帝王無在人臣家者。舉事當合天下心，諸君作此，非是也。」暹曰：「將軍計定矣。」於是天子一乘，貴人伏氏一乘，賈詡、左靈一乘，其餘皆步從。是日，傕復移乘輿幸北塢，使校尉監塢門，內外隔絕。諸侍臣皆有飢色，時盛暑熱，人盡寒心。帝求米五斛、牛骨五具以賜左右，傕曰：「朝餔上飯，何用米為？」乃與腐牛骨，皆臭不可食。帝大怒，欲詰責之。侍中楊琦上封事曰：「傕，邊鄙之人，習于夷風，今又自知所犯悖逆，常有怏怏之色，欲輔車駕幸黃白城以紓其憤。臣願陛下忍之，未可顯其罪也。」帝納之。初，傕屯黃白城，故謀欲徙之。傕以司徒趙溫不與己同，乃內溫塢中。溫聞傕欲移乘輿，與傕書曰：「公前託為董公報讎，然實屠陷王城，殺戮大臣，天下不可家見而戶釋也。今爭睚眥之隙，以成千鈞之讎，民在塗炭，各不聊生，曾不改寤，遂成禍亂。朝廷仍下明詔，欲令和解，詔命不行，恩澤日損，而復欲輔乘輿于黃白城，此誠老夫所不解也。於易，一過為過，再為涉，三而弗改，滅其頂，凶。不如早共和解，引兵還屯，上安萬乘，下全生民，豈不幸甚！」傕大怒，欲遣人害溫。其從弟應，溫故掾也，諫之數日乃止。帝聞溫與傕書，問侍中常洽曰：「傕弗知臧否，溫言太切，可為寒心。」對曰：「李應已解之矣。」帝乃悅。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
