<a href="#source-30" id="annotation-30">[30]</a> Huà Qiáo's Hàn shū states: [Guō] Sì feasted the Excellencies and Ministers, discussed a wish to attack [Lǐ] Jué. Yáng Biāo said: "The various ministers together fighting, one man seizes Heaven's Son, one man takes hostage the Excellencies and Ministers, how can this be done?" [Guō] Sì was angry, wished to use his own hand and blade on him, Central Cadet General Yáng Mì with the Left and Right had many remonstrations, [Guō] Sì thus returned them.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　華嶠漢書曰：汜饗公卿，議欲攻傕。楊彪曰：「群臣共鬥，一人劫天子，一人質公卿，此可行乎？」汜怒，欲手刃之，中郎將楊密及左右多諫，汜乃歸之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-31" id="annotation-31">[31]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: [Lǐ] Jué by nature enjoyed the arts of ghosts and spirits and heterodox ways, always having Dào priests and witch women sing songs and beat drums to call down divinities, offered sacrifices to the Six Dīng,^[The Six Dīng (liù dīng) were the Dào spirits Dīngmǎo, Dīngsì, Dīngwèi, Dīngyǒu, Dīnghài, Dīngchǒu, believed to be used by the God of Heaven to perform labors, and therefore that Dào priests could summon them to perform tasks.] objects of talismens and amulets,^[Talismen impeachments (fúhé) were similar to the actual talismen (fú) carried by messengers to verify the authenticity of orders, but instead used to give orders to spirits. Amulets (yāshèng) were magic items said to be able to suppress (yā) and overcome (shèng) other magic influences.] none he did not use. Also at the outside of the Court secretariat gates, for Dǒng Zhuó he made a Spirit Seat, repeatedly using oxen and sheep to sacrifice to it, when finishing passed the secretariat side doors to inquire on [the Emperor's] rising and activities, requesting to enter to meet. [Lǐ] Jué wore three knives, his hand further carried a whip joined to hold one knife. The Attendant Central and Attendant Cadets saw [Lǐ] Jué wearing weapons, all were terrified, and also wore swords and held knives, ahead entering to stand to the Emperor's side. [Lǐ] Jué faced the Emperor, sometimes saying "Enlightened Majesty," sometimes saying "Enlightened Emperor," to the Emperor saying that Guō Sì was insolent, the Emperor also complied with his thinking when answering him. [Lǐ] Jué was pleased, went out and said: "The Enlightened Majesty is truly a worthy and sagely Ruler," his thoughts therefore were self-confident, himself saying he had thoroughly won over Heaven's Son's pleased heart. However, he yet did not wish to let the close ministers wear swords at the Emperor's side, and spoke to someone saying: "Does this group of boys wish to plot against me? Why do they all hold knives?" Attendant Central Lǐ Zhēn was of [Lǐ] Jué's home region, formerly with [Lǐ] Jué was friendly, and said to [Lǐ] Jué: "The reason they hold knives, is that in the military one cannot not do so, this is the country's precedent." [Lǐ] Jué's thoughts then were resolved. Heaven's Son because Visitors Deputy Director Huángfǔ Lì was of an old family of Liáng Province, had talent in diplomatic response, sent him to make peace between [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì. [Huángfǔ] Lì first visited [Guō] Sì, [Guō] Sì accepted the Edict mandate. Visited [Lǐ] Jué, [Lǐ] Jué would not agree, saying: "I have the achievement of suppressing Lǚ Bù, assisted the government, the Three Adjuncts purified and quiet, Heaven's Under knows this. Guō Duō is merely a horse stealing caitiff, how dare he then wish to share my level? I certainly will execute him. You are a Liáng Province man, observe my overall strategies and multitudes of servicemen, are they sufficient to deal with [Guō] Duō or not? [Guō] Duō also seized as hostages the Excellencies and Ministers, behaving like this, yet you carelessly wish to profit Guō Duō, [I,] Lǐ Jué have the guts to myself understand this." [Huángfǔ] Lì answered stating: "In the past Yǒuqióng Hòuyì relied on his skill in shooting, not thinking of sufferings or troubles, so that it brought about his death. More recently the strength of Excellency Dǒng [Zhuó], you Enlightened General with your own eyes witnessed, inside he had Excellency Wáng [Yǔn] as his interior controller, outside he had Dǒng Mín, [Dǒng] Chéng, [Dǒng] Huáng as his ruthless enforcers,^[Ruthless enforcers (gěngdú) can be interpreted more literally as 'bone stuck in the throat' (gěng) and 'poison' (dú).] Lǚ Bù received favor and yet rebelled and plotted against him, and within an instant, his head was hanging from the end of a pole. This is to have valor but lack planning. Now you General personally act as the highest officer, grasping Battle-Ax and wielding Stave, sons and grandsons holding power, clansmen carrying favor, the country's best positions^[The term hǎojué originally referred to a fine alcohol goblet, and by extension came to refer to high office with generous salary.] are all occupied by them. Now Guō Duō siezes as hostages the Excellencies and Ministers, you General coerce the Utmost Honored, which is lighter and heavier? Zhāng Jì with Guō Duō and Yáng Dìng have plans, and also are joined by the capped and girdled.^[Capped and girdled (guāndài) refer to the gentry class.] Yáng Fèng is only a Báibō leader,^[The Báibō "white waves" was a bandit confederation.] yet understands that what you General are doing is not right, though you General may honor and favor him, yet he will not agree to exhaust his strength [for you]." [Lǐ] Jué would not accept [Huángfǔ] Lì's advice, and so shouted at him to send him out. [Huángfǔ] Lì went out, visited the secretariat gates, reported that [Lǐ] Jué would not agree to obey the Edict, statements and speach insubordinate. Attendant Central Hú Miǎo, who was favored by [Lǐ] Jué, called the Edict carrier to have him embellish the statements, and also spoke to [Huángfǔ] Lì stating: "Geneeral Lǐ's treatment of you is not meager, and also Excellency Huángfǔ [Sōng] becoming Grand Commandant was by General Lǐ's strength." [Huángfǔ] Lì answered stating: "Hú Jìngcái, you are the country's attendant minister,^[Chángbó was originally a Zhōu office title, but by Hàn had become a metaphorical term to refer to the Emperor's attendants, such as the Attendant Centrals or Regular Attendants.] a servant of assisting support, your language and words are like this, how can you be employed?" [Hú] Miǎo said: "I merely worry that if you lose General Lǐ's goodwill, I fear it will not be easy [for you]. What do I have to do with you?" [Huángfǔ] Lì said: "My family for generations received favor, and I personally also always have been in the curtains,^[Curtains wéiwò refer to the inner rooms of the Imperial Palace.] for a Lord's dishonor the Servant dies, if I am connected to the country, by Lǐ Jué killed, then it is Heaven's Will." Heaven's Son heard that [Huángfǔ] Lì's answer speech was cutting, feared [Lǐ] Jué would hear of it, and immediately ordered to send away [Huángfǔ] Lì. [Huángfǔ] Lì had just gone out the camp gates, [Lǐ] Jué sent Tiger Elite Wáng Chāng to call him. [Wáng] Chāng knew [Huángfǔ] Lì was loyal and upright, let him go, returned to answer to [Lǐ] Jué, saying that in pursuing him he did not catch him. Heaven's Son sent Left Central Cadet General Lǐ Gù Holding Stave to appoint [Lǐ] Jué as Marshal-in-Chief,^[Dà Sīmǎ was an irregularly used title for a supreme commander of all military forces.] to the right of the Three Excellencies.^[Here right is the same as above, left as below.] [Lǐ] Jué hinmself believed he had obtained the strength of ghosts and divinities, and so generously reward the various witches.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　獻帝起居注曰：傕性喜鬼怪左道之術，常有道人及女巫歌謳擊鼓下神，祠祭六丁，符劾厭勝之具，無所不為。又於朝廷省門外，為董卓作神坐，數以牛羊祠之，訖，過省閤問起居，求入見。傕帶三刀，手復與鞭合持一刃。侍中、侍郎見傕帶仗，皆惶恐，亦帶劍持刀，先入在帝側。傕對帝，或言「明陛下」，或言「明帝」，為帝說郭汜無狀，帝亦隨其意答應之。傕喜，出言「明陛下真賢聖主」，意遂自信，自謂良得天子歡心也。雖然，猶不欲令近臣帶劍在帝邊，謂人言「此曹子將欲圖我邪？而皆持刀也」。侍中李禎，傕州里，素與傕通，語傕「所以持刀者，軍中不可不爾，此國家故事」。傕意乃解。天子以謁者僕射皇甫酈涼州舊姓，有專對之才，遣令和傕、汜。酈先詣汜，汜受詔命。詣傕，傕不肯，曰：「我有〔討〕呂布之功，輔政四年，三輔清靜，天下所知也。郭多，盜馬虜耳，何敢乃欲與吾等邪？必欲誅之。君為涼州人，觀吾方略士眾，足辦多不？多又劫質公卿，所為如是，而君苟欲利郭多，李傕有膽自知之。」酈答曰：「昔有窮后羿恃其善射，不思患難，以至于斃。近董公之強，明將軍目所見，內有王公以為內主，外有董旻、承、璜以為鯁毒，呂布受恩而反圖之，斯須之間，頭縣竿端，此有勇而無謀也。今將軍身為上將，把鉞仗節，子孫握權，宗族荷寵，國家好爵而皆據之。今郭多劫質公卿，將軍脅至尊，誰為輕重邪？張濟與郭多、楊定有謀，又為冠帶所附。楊奉，白波帥耳，猶知將軍所為非是，將軍雖拜寵之，猶不肯盡力也。」傕不納酈言，而呵之令出。酈出，詣省門，白傕不肯從詔，辭語不順。侍中胡邈為傕所幸，呼傳詔者令飾其辭。又謂酈曰：「李將軍於卿不薄，又皇甫公為太尉，李將軍力也。」酈答曰：「胡敬才，卿為國家常伯，輔弼之臣也，語言如此，寧可用邪？」邈曰：「念卿失李將軍意，恐不易耳！我與卿何事者？」酈言：「我累世受恩，身又常在幃幄，君辱臣死，當坐國家，為李傕所殺，則天命也。」天子聞酈答語切，恐傕聞之，便敕遣酈。酈裁出營門，傕遣虎賁王昌呼之。昌知酈忠直，縱令去，還答傕，言追之不及。天子使左中郎將李固持節拜傕為大司馬，在三公之右。傕自以為得鬼神之力，乃厚賜諸巫。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns #yangfenghanxian}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Lǐ] Jué's officer Yáng Fèng with [Lǐ] Jué's army scribe Sòng Guǒ and others planned to kill [Lǐ] Juè, the matter leaked, therefore they led troops to rebel against [Lǐ] Jué. [Lǐ] Jué's multitudes rebelled, he gradually weakened. Zhāng Jì from Shǎn reconciliated them, Heaven's Son thus was able to get out, reached to between Xīnfēng and Bàlíng. <a href="#annotation-32" id="source-32">[32]</a> Guō Sì again wished to coerce Heaven's Son to return and set capital at Méi. Heaven's Son fled to [Yáng] Fèng's camp, [Yáng] Fèng struck [Guō] Sì and defeated him. [Guō] Sì fled to Nánshān, [Yáng] Fèng with General Dǒng Chéng with Heaven's Son returned to Luòyáng. [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì regretted letting go Heaven's Son, restored peace between themselves, pursued and reached Heaven's Son at Hóngnóng's Cáoyáng. [Yáng] Fèng urgently recruited Hédōng's former Báibō leaders Hán Xiān, Hú Cái, Lǐ Lè and others to unite, with [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì greatly battled. [Yáng] Fèng's troops were defeated, [Lǐ] Jué and the rest unleashed troops to kill the Excellencies and Ministers and Hundred Officials, plundering the Palace women and entering Hóngnóng. <a href="#annotation-33" id="source-33">[33]</a> Heaven's Son fled to Shǎn, crossed the Hé north, lost the supply wagons, on foot travelled, only the Imperial Empress and Noble Ladies following, reached Dàyáng, stopped inside a person's house. <a href="#annotation-34" id="source-34">[34]</a> [Yáng] Fèng and [Hán] Xiān and others therefore with Heaven's Son set capital at Ānyì, driving and riding an ox cart. Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo, Minister Charioteer Hán Róng, and the close ministers that were following were over ten people. Appointed [Hán] Xiān as Campaigning East,[Hú] Cái as Campaigning West, [Lǐ] Lè as Campaigning North Generals, all with [Yáng] Fèng and [Dǒng] Chéng maintaining the government. Sent [Hán] Róng to reach Hóngnóng, with [Lǐ] Jué and [Guō] Sì and the rest making peace, returned the plundered Palace women and Excellencies and Ministers and Hundred Officials, with carriages and chariots and horses of several carriages. At the time locusts rose, that year was a drought and no grain, the following officials ate jujubes and greens. <a href="#annotation-35" id="source-35">[35]</a> The various officers could not lead one another, above and below in chaos, grain provisions exhausted. [Yáng] Fèng, [Hán] Xiān, [Dǒng] Chéng thus had Heaven's Son return to Luòyáng. Set out Jī Pass, down Zhǐ Road, Zhāng Yáng with food welcomed on the road, appointed Marshal-in-Chief. The story is in [Zhāng] Yáng's biography. Heaven's Son entered Luòyáng, the Palace Residences were completely burned down, the roads and streets overgrown in weeds, the Hundred Officials draped in thistles and thorns, sheltered between mounds and walls. The provinces and prefectures each gathered troops to guard themselves, none had any come [to help]. The hunger and destitution gradually became extreme, the Secretariat Writers Cadets on down personally went out to collect firewood, some starved to death between the walls.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
傕將楊奉與傕軍吏宋果等謀殺傕，事泄，遂將兵叛傕。傕眾叛，稍衰弱。張濟自陝和解之，天子乃得出，至新豐、霸陵閒。〔一〕郭汜復欲脅天子還都郿。天子奔奉營，奉擊汜破之。汜走南山，奉及將軍董承以天子還洛陽。傕、汜悔遣天子，復相與和，追及天子於弘農之曹陽。奉急招河東故白波帥韓暹、胡才、李樂等合，與傕、汜大戰。奉兵敗，傕等縱兵殺公卿百官，略宮人入弘農。〔二〕天子走陝，北渡河，失輜重，步行，唯皇后貴人從，至大陽，止人家屋中。〔三〕奉、暹等遂以天子都安邑，御乘牛車。太尉楊彪、太僕韓融近臣從者十餘人。以暹為征東、才為征西、樂征北將軍，並與奉、承持政。遣融至弘農，與傕、汜等連和，還所略宮人公卿百官，及乘輿車馬數乘。是時蝗蟲起，歲旱無穀，從官食棗菜。〔四〕諸將不能相率，上下亂，糧食盡。奉、暹、承乃以天子還洛陽。出箕關，下軹道，張楊以食迎道路，拜大司馬。語在楊傳。天子入洛陽，宮室燒盡，街陌荒蕪，百官披荊棘，依丘牆閒。州郡各擁兵自衛，莫有至者。飢窮稍甚，尚書郎以下，自出樵采，或飢死牆壁閒。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-32" id="annotation-32">[32]</a> Xiàn-dì Qǐjū zhù states: Previously, Heaven's Son went out and arrived at Xuānpíng Gate, about to cross the bridge, [Guō] Sì's troops of several hundred men screened the bridge and asked: "Is it Heaven's Son?" The chariot could not advance. [Lǐ] Jué's troops of several hundred men all held large halberds to the carriage chariots left and right, Attendant Central Liú Ài greatly shouted saying: "It is Heaven's Son." Had Attendant Central Yáng Qí highly raise the chariot curtain. The Emperor spoke to the various soldiers: "You do not withdraw? How dare you press close to the Utmost Honored?" [Guō] Sì and the rest's soldiers then withdrew. They had crossed the bridge, the servicemen multitudes all shouted Ten Thousand Years.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝起居注曰：初，天子出到宣平門，當度橋，汜兵數百人遮橋問「是天子邪」？車不得前。傕兵數百人皆持大戟在乘輿車左右，侍中劉艾大呼云：「是天子也。」使侍中楊琦高舉車帷。帝言諸兵：「汝不卻，何敢迫近至尊邪？」汜等兵乃卻。既度橋，士眾咸呼萬歲。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-33" id="annotation-33">[33]</a> Xiàn-dì jì states: At the time Secretariat Writers Directory Shìsūn Ruì was by the chaotic troops murdered.

Sānfǔ Juélù zhù states: [Shìsūn] Ruì appellation Jūnróng was a Fúfēng man, for generations a scholar family. [Shìsūn] Ruì in his youth continued the family enterprise, widely learned with nothing not understood, served successively in prominent positions. When [Dǒng] Zhuó had been executed, promoted to Minister of Agriculture, for the state became Three-Elder. Every time the Three Excellencies had an opening, [Shìsūn] Ruì always was among the selected candidates. When Grand Commandants Zhōu Zhōng and Huángfǔ Sōng, Excellencies over the Masses Chúnyú Jiā and Zhào Wēn, Excellencies of Works Yáng Biāo and Zhāng Xǐ and others became Excellencies, all had declined and deferred to [Shìsūn] Ruì.^[Traditionally high appointments involved the candidate ritually declining and suggesting another candidate. This was an expected ritual display of humility, but may have also served a practical purpose of giving time to build and confirm a consensus before finalizing an appointment.] When Heaven's Son set capital at Xǔ, recalled and discussed [Shìsūn] Ruì's achievements, enfeoffed his son [Shìsūn] Mńg as Marquess of Tánjīn precinct. [Shìsūn] Méng appellation Wénshǐ, also had talent and learning, with Wáng Càn was friendly. When about to accept the fief, [Wáng] Càn composed a poem to gift to [Shìsūn] Méng, [Shìsūn] Méng had a reply, [both] in [Wáng] Càn's Collected Works.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝紀曰：時尚書令士孫瑞為亂兵所害。三輔決錄注曰：瑞字君榮，扶風人，世為學門。瑞少傳家業，博達無所不通，仕歷顯位。卓既誅，遷大司農，為國三老。每三公缺，瑞常在選中。太尉周忠、皇甫嵩，司徒淳于嘉、趙溫，司空楊彪、張喜等為公，皆辭拜讓瑞。天子都許，追論瑞功，封子萌澹津亭侯。萌字文始，亦有才學，與王粲善。臨當就國，粲作詩以贈萌，萌有答，在粲集中。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-34" id="annotation-34">[34]</a> Xiàn-dì jì states: Previously, commentators wished ot have Heaven's Son sail the Hé east downstream, Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo said: "Your Servant is a Hóngnóng man, from here on east, there are thirty-six rapids, not what the Ten Thousand Carriages should follow." Liú Ài said: "Your Servant formerly was Shǎn Magistrate, know its dangerous terrain, even with [boat] pilots yet there there are capsizes, all the more now with no pilots. The Grand Commandant's plan is correct." Thus stopped. Reaching to when about to cross north, sent Lǐ Lè to prepare boats. Heaven's Son on foot walked hurriedly to the river bank, the bank was high and could not be descended, Dǒng Chéng and the rest planned and wished to use horse bridles to tie together to fasten to the Emperor's waist. At the time the Central Palace's servant Fú Dé supported the Central Palace,^[Central Palace [zhōng gōng] refers to the Empress.] one hand holding ten pǐ of fabric, thus took [Fú] Dé's silk to tie together into a seat. Marching Army Colonel Shàng Hóng had much strength, had [Shàng] Hóng occupy the front carrying the Emperor on his back, then able to descend to board the boat. The rest that could not cross were extremely many, further sent boats to collect those that could not cross, all fought to climb onto the boats, the people on the boats with blades cut off their fingers, the fingers inside the boats could be scooped.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　獻帝紀曰：初，議者欲令天子浮河東下，太尉楊彪曰：「臣弘農人，從此已東，有三十六灘，非萬乘所當從也。」劉艾曰：「臣前為陝令，知其危險，有師猶有傾覆，況今無師，太尉謀是也。」乃止。及當北渡，使李樂具船。天子步行趨河岸，岸高不得下，董承等謀欲以馬羈相續以繫帝腰。時中宮僕伏德扶中宮，一手持十匹絹，乃取德絹連續為輦。行軍校尉尚弘多力，令弘居前負帝，乃得下登船。其餘不得渡者甚眾，復遣船收諸不得渡者，皆爭攀船，船上人以刃櫟斷其指，舟中之指可掬。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-35" id="annotation-35">[35]</a> Wèi shū states: The carriage [the Emperor] at the time resided within thorn hedges, the gates and doors could not be closed. When Heaven's Son with the various ministers gathered, soldiers leaned on the hedge top to watch, jostling one another to laugh. The various officers concentrated power, some without authority whipping and killing Secretariat Writers. When the Director of Retainers Colonel went out and in, civilians and soldiers threw stones at him. Of the various officers some sent maids to visit the secretariat side doors, some personally with gifts of alcohol and food went to drink with Heaven's Son, the Attendant Centrals would not let them pass, they shouted curses, and therefore could not be stopped. Also they competed to memorialize to appoint civilians from the various cmaps and walls to be their division retainers, seeking from them gifts and bribes. Physicians and running lackeys all became Colonels, the Censorate in carving seals could not provide for them, and so used awls to draw and show there was an inscription, some did not have time for that.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　魏書曰：乘輿時居棘籬中，門戶無關閉。天子與群臣會，兵士伏籬上觀，互相鎮壓以為笑。諸將專權，或擅笞殺尚書。司隸校尉出入，民兵抵擲之。諸將或遣婢詣省閤，或自齎酒啖，過天子飲，侍中不通，喧呼罵詈，遂不能止。又競表拜諸營壁民為部曲，求其禮遺。醫師、走卒，皆為校尉，御史刻印不供，乃以錐畫，示有文字，或不時得也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] then welcomed Heaven's Son to set capital at Xǔ. [Hán] Xiān and [Yáng] Fèng were not able to uphold Ruling Law, each went out and fled, plundering between Xú and Yáng [Provinces], killed by Liú Bèi. <a href="#annotation-36" id="source-36">[36]</a> Dǒng Chéng followed Tàizǔ for over a year, executed. Jiàn'ān Second Year [197], sent Visitors Deputy Director Péi Mào to lead various officers west of the passes to execute [Lǐ] Jué, exterminated Three Clans. <a href="#annotation-37" id="source-37">[37]</a> [Guō] Sì was by his officer Wǔ Xí attacked, died at Méi. [Zhāng] Jì in hunger arrived at Nányáng to plunder, was by Ráng men killed, his cousin's son [Zhāng] Xiù took over his multitudes. [Hú] Cái, [Lǐ] Lè remained in Hédōng, [Hú] Cái for a family grudge was killed, [Lǐ] Lè of illness died. [Hán] Suì and [Mǎ] Téng personally returned to Liáng Province, again raided one another, later [Mǎ] Téng entered [Court] to be Minister of the Guard, his son [Mǎ] Chāo managed his division retainers. Sixteenth Year [211], [Mǎ] Chāo with the Guānzhōng's various officers with [Hán] Suì and others rebelled, Tàizǔ campaigned against and defeated them. The story is in the [Wǔ Annals](01.qmd#caocao). [Hán] Suì fled to Jīnchéng, was by his officers killed. [Mǎ] Chāo occupied Hànyáng, [Mǎ] Téng in connection was exterminated three clans. Zhào Qú and others raised righteous troops to suppress [Mǎ] Chāo, [Mǎ] Chāo fled to Hànzhōng and followed Zhāng Lǔ, later fled to Liú Bèi, died in Shǔ.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖乃迎天子都許。暹、奉不能奉王法，各出奔，寇徐、揚間，為劉備所殺。〔一〕董承從太祖歲餘，誅。建安二年，遣謁者僕射裴茂率關西諸將誅傕，夷三族。〔二〕汜為其將五習所襲，死于郿。濟飢餓，至南陽寇略，為穰人所殺，從子繡攝其眾。才、樂留河東，才為怨家所殺，樂病死。遂、騰自還涼州，更相寇，後騰入為衛尉，子超領其部曲。十六年，超與關中諸將及遂等反，太祖征破之。語在武紀。遂奔金城，為其將所殺。超據漢陽，騰坐夷三族。趙衢等舉義兵討超，超走漢中從張魯，後奔劉備，死于蜀。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-36" id="annotation-36">[36]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Liú] Bèi enticed [Yáng] Fèng to a mutual meeting, took advantage to at the seated assembly seize him. [Hán] Xiān having lost [Yáng] Fèng was isolated, at the time wished to flee back to Bìng Province, was by Zhùqiū garrison leader Zhāng Xuān intercepted and killed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：備誘奉與相見，因於坐上執之。暹失奉勢孤，時欲走還并州，為杼秋屯帥張宣所邀殺。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-37" id="annotation-37">[37]</a> Diǎnlüè states: [Lǐ] Jué's head arrived, there was Edict to hang it high.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　典略曰：傕頭至，有詔高縣。
:::
:::
:::

## Yuán Shào {.unnumbered #yuanshao}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Yuán Shào appellation Běnchū was Rǔnán Rǔyáng man.^[Yuán Shào also has a biography in Hòu Hàn shū 74.] His great-great-grandfather [Yuán] Ān was a Hàn Excellency over the Masses. From [Yuán] Ān on down four generations occupied Three Excellencies positions, from this their influence covered Heaven's Under. <a href="#annotation-38" id="source-38">[38]</a> [Yuán] Shào had handsome appearance and imposing presence, able to humble himself to subordinate servicemen, of servicemen many attached to him. Tàizǔ in youth associated with him. As a General-in-Chief's Assistant he became Attendant Censor, <a href="#annotation-39" id="source-39">[39]</a> gradually promoted to Central Army Colonel, reached Director of Retainers.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
袁紹字本初，汝南汝陽人也。高祖父安，為漢司徒。自安以下四世居三公位，由是勢傾天下。〔一〕紹有姿貌威容，能折節下士，士多附之，太祖少與交焉。以大將軍掾為侍御史，〔二〕稍遷中軍校尉，至司隸。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-38" id="annotation-38">[38]</a> Huà Qiáo's Hàn shū states: [Yuán] Ān appellation Shàogōng enjoyed study and had imposing gravitas. In Emperor Míng's time^[Hàn Emperor Míng, personal name Liú Zhuāng, regined 57 - 75 AD, Annals in Hòu Hàn shū 2.] he became Chǔ prefecture Adminsitrator, governed the prison cases of the King of Chǔ, those with redressed grievances were over four hundred families, all received preservation and rescue, [Yuán] Ān therefore became a famed minister.^[Emperor Míng's younger brother Liú Yīng, the King of Chǔ, was charged with plotting treason in late 70 to early 71 AD, leading to his removal as King and eventually his suicide. Chǔ kingdom was converted to Chǔ prefecture, and a large number of implicated individuals were arrested and investigated. As the Chǔ prefecture Administrator reviewing the legal cases, Yuán Ān was able to save the lives of many of the imprisoned.] In Emperor Zhāng's time^[Hàn Emperor Zhāng, personal name Liú Dá, reigned 75 - 88 AD, Annals in Hòu Hàn shū 3.] reached Excellency over the Masses, begat Shǔ prefecture Administrator [Yuán] Jīng. [Yuán] Jīng's younger brother [Yuán] Chǎng became Excellency of Works. [Yuán] Jīng's son [Yuán] Tāng was Grand Commandant. [Yuán] Tāng's four sons: eldest son [Yuán] Píng, [Yuán] Píng's younger brother Chéng was Left Central Cadet General, both early died; [Yuán] Chéng's younger brother [Yuán] Féng, [Yuán] Féng's younger brother [Yuán] Wěi, both became Excellencies.

Wèi shū states: From [Yuán] Ān on down, all broadly favored and embraced the masses, with no selectiveness. Guests that entered their gates whether worthy or foolish all obtained their desires, Heaven's Under submitted to them. [Yuán] Shào in fact was [Yuán] Féng's concubine-born son, [Yuán] Shù's elder brother of a different mother, sent out to be posterity for [Yuán] Chéng as a son.^[In Hàn traditions, adoption was done in order to main ancestral sacrifices, and therefore usually done within the same male-line clan to maintain lineages that had gone extinct. Here Yuán Chéng's line had gone extinct so Yuán Féng had Yuán Shào adopted over to nominally continue his elder brother's lineage.]

Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Chéng appellation Wénkāi was strong and vigorous and had good proportions, the noble [Imperial in-law] relations powerful and dominant from General-in-Chief Liáng Jì on down all joined in friendship with him, of his advice none was not followed. Therefore the capital region made a proverb stating: "For a matter not resolved, asked Wénkāi."^[During the final decades of Hàn, the government was dominated by the powerful clans that married with the Imperial family, usually in the form of child Emperors controlled by a regency of their mother or stepmother Dowager Empress and her clan relatives. Perhaps the most notorious of these was Liáng Jì (88 - 159 AD), who came to power through his younger sister the Empress Liáng. See the biography of Liáng Jì in Hòu Hàn shū 34.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　華嶠漢書曰：安字邵公，好學有威重。明帝時為楚郡太守，治楚王獄，所申理者四百餘家，皆蒙全濟，安遂為名臣。章帝時至司徒，生蜀郡太守京。京弟敞為司空。京子湯，太尉。湯四子：長子平，平弟成，左中郎將，並早卒；成弟逢，逢弟隗，皆為公。魏書曰：自安以下，皆博愛容眾，無所揀擇；賓客入其門，無賢愚皆得所欲，為天下所歸。紹即逢之庶子，術異母兄也，出後成為子。英雄記曰：成字文開，壯健有部分，貴戚權豪自大將軍梁冀以下皆與結好，言無不從。故京師為作諺曰：「事不諧，問文開。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-39" id="annotation-39">[39]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Shào was born and then his father [Yuán Chéng] died, the two Excellencies [Yuán Féng, Yuán Wěi] favored him. In youth he became a Cadet, when capped was sent out as Púyáng Chief,^[The capping ceremony (ruòguàn) marked the transition to adulthood, when a boy received the headdress of an adult. During Hàn, Púyáng county was in Hédōng prefecture. A county with a population less than ten thousand households was governed by a Chief (zhǎng) instead of the usual Magistrate (lìng).] had pure reputation. Encountering his mother's passing, he observed mourning to completion, and also posthumously enacted mourning for his father, altogther at the burial mound hut for six years.^[In traditional mourning ritual, an individual observes a nominal three years mourning period for each parent. In practice "three years" did not necessarily mean thirty-six months, but here Yuán Shào was likely making a calculated political withdrawal from government service.] The ritual completed, he lived privately in Luòyáng, not rashly connecting with guests. Those that were not famed Within the Seas were not able to meet him. Also he enjoyed roaming as a vigilante, with Zhāng [Miǎo] Mèngzhuó, Hé [Yóng] Bóqiú, Wú Zǐqīng, Xǔ [Yōu] Zǐyuǎn, Wǔ [Qióng] Déyú and others all becoming friends that would run [to help each other].^[For Zhāng Miǎo see the biography of Lǚ Bù in Sān Guó zhì 7. For Hé Yóng see Hòu Hàn shū 67. Wú Zǐqīng is no longer known, but he may have been the Wú Shuò. For Xǔ Yōu see later in the biography of Yuán Shào. For Wǔ Qióng see the biography of [Dǒng Zhuó](#dongzhuo).] Did not answer recruitment mandates. Central Regular Attendant Zhào Zhōng spoke with the various Yellow Gates stating: "Yuán Běnchū sits and creates reputation, not answering calls of summons but yet raising Death Squad, one does not know what this boy wishes to do." [Yuán] Shào's father's younger brother [Yuán] Wěi heard of this, and repeatedly reproached [Yuán] Shào stating: "You will ruin our family!" [Yuán] Shào thereupon then rose to answer the General-in-Chief's recruitment.^[Death Squad (sǐshì) refers to individuals said to be unafraid of death and willing to undertake suicidal missions in service of their sponsor. A private individual not accepting recruitments to government positions while raising a private army would naturally fall under suspicion of plotting treason.]

Your Servant Sōngzhī notes: Wèi shū says [Yuán] Shào was [Yuán] Féng's concubine-born son, sent out as posterity to his father's elder brother [Yuán] Chéng. By what this record says, then it would appear that he truly was born from [Yuán] Chéng. A man posthumously mourning their birth parent, Ritual is without this writing, so all the more to be [adoptive] posterity and yet able to enact it. The two books are uncertain as to which is correct.^[Here Péi Sōngzhī notes that observing a mourning period for a parent so late after the fact has no basis in Ritual canon. This is perhaps further evidence that Yuán Shào was using a nominal claim of mourning for a calculated political withdrawal.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　英雄記曰：紹生而父死，二公愛之。幼使為郎，弱冠除濮陽長，有清名。遭母喪，服竟，又追行父服，凡在冢廬六年。禮畢，隱居洛陽，不妄通賓客，非海內知名，不得相見。又好游俠，與張孟卓、何伯求、吳子卿、許子遠、伍德瑜等皆為奔走之友。不應辟命。中常侍趙忠謂諸黃門曰：「袁本初坐作聲價，不應呼召而養死士，不知此兒欲何所為乎？」紹叔父隗聞之，責數紹曰：「汝且破我家！」紹於是乃起應大將軍之命。臣松之案：魏書云「紹，逢之庶子，出後伯父成」。如此記所言，則似實成所生。夫人追服所生，禮無其文，況於所後而可以行之！二書未詳孰是。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Emperor Líng passed away, the Dowager Empress's elder brother General-in-Chief Hé Jìn with [Yuán] Shào planned to execute the various castrate officials, <a href="#annotation-40" id="source-40">[40]</a> the Dowager Empress would not agree. Thus summoned Dǒng Zhuó, wishing to coerce the Dowager Empress. The Regular Attendants and Yellow Gates heard of this, all visited [Hé] Jìn to apologize, entirely to be at his disposal. At the time [Yuán] Shào urged [Hé] Jìn that they could then at this eliminate them, reaching to twice and thrice, but [Hé] Jìn did not permit it. Ordered [Yuán] Shào to send Luòyáng's general strategy military clerks to investigate and manage the various eunuchs. Also ordered [Yuán] Shào's younger brother Tiger Elite Central Cadet General [Yuán] Shù to select mild and generous Tiger Elites of two hundred men, to enter the Restricted Center, to replace the Yellow Gates that held weapons at the gates and ramps to guard the gates and doors. Central Regular Attendant Duàn Guī and others feigned a Dowager Empress mandate to summon [Hé] Jìn to enter to discuss, and therefore killed him, inside the Palace was in chaos. <a href="#annotation-41" id="source-41">[41]</a> [Yuán] Shù led the Tiger Elite to burn the South Palace's Jiādé Hall's Qīngsuǒ Gate, wishing to by this force out [Duàn] Guī and the rest. [Duàn] Guī and the rest did not go out, seized the Emperor and the Emperor's younger brother the King of Chénliú to flee to Xiǎopíng Ford. [Yuán] Shào had beheaded the eunuch appointed Director of Retainers Colonel Xǔ Xiāng, and therefore reined in troops to capture the various castrates, without regard to young or old killed them all. Some without beards were mistakenly killed, to the point of some exposing their bodies to then obtain escape. Of the eunuchs some had good conduct and maintained themselves but yet met with this. The excessiveness was like this. The dead were over two thousand people. Urgently pursued [Duàn] Guī and the rest, [Duàn] Guī and the rest all threw themselves into the Hé and died. The Emperor was able to return to the Palace.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
靈帝崩，太后兄大將軍何進與紹謀誅諸閹官，〔一〕太后不從。乃召董卓，欲以脅太后。常侍、黃門聞之，皆詣進謝，唯所錯置。時紹勸進便可於此決之，至于再三，而進不許。令紹使洛陽方略武吏檢司諸宦者。又令紹弟虎賁中郎將術選溫厚虎賁二百人，當入禁中，代持兵黃門陛守門戶。中常侍段珪等矯太后命，召進入議，遂殺之，宮中亂。〔二〕術將虎賁燒南宮嘉德殿青瑣門，欲以迫出珪等。珪等不出，劫帝及帝弟陳留王走小平津。紹既斬宦者所署司隸校尉許相，遂勒兵捕諸閹人，無少長皆殺之。或有無鬚而誤死者，至自發露形體而後得免。宦者或有行善自守而猶見及。其濫如此。死者二千餘人。急追珪等，珪等悉赴河死。帝得還宮。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-40" id="annotation-40">[40]</a> Xù Hàn shū states: [Yuán] Shào sent his retainer Zhāng Jīn to explain to [Hé] Jìn stating: "The Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants have held power for a long time, also the Yǒnglè Dowager Empress^[The Yǒnglè Dowager Empress, called for Yǒnglè Palace, was the mother of Hàn Emperor Líng.] with the various Regular Attendants exclusively colluded in wealth and profit, General you should organize Heaven's Under, and for Within the Seas remove the troubles." [Hé] Jìn believed it correct, and therefore with [Yuán] Shào joined plans.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　續漢書曰：紹使客張津說進曰：「黃門、常侍秉權日久，又永樂太后與諸常侍專通財利，將軍宜整頓天下，為海內除患。」進以為然，遂與紹結謀。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-41" id="annotation-41">[41]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: Previously [Yuán] Shào explained to [Hé] Jìn stating: "The Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants for accumualted reigns have been excessively powerful, their authority subduing Within the Seas, formerly Dòu Wǔ wished to execute them but instead was murdered by them,^[The eunuchs employed in the Yellow Gates and Regular Attendants had dominated the government during the reigns of Hàn Emperors Huán and Líng. Previously, Hàn Emperor Huán had empowered the eunuchs to use them in a coup against his overly powerful regent Liáng Jì. Emperor Huán later died without an heir, leading to the posthumous adoption and enthronment of a distant cousin, Emperor Líng, under the regency of the Dowager Empress Dòu and her father Dòu Wǔ. Dòu Wǔ planned to purge the eunuchs, but the plan leaked and the eunuchs struck first, purging Dòu Wǔ and maintaining their dominant positions under Emperor Líng.] merely because his seated speech leaked, and he had the Five Camps servicemen as troops.^[The Five Camps (wǔ yíng) was the regular standing army at the capital city Luòyáng.] The Five Camps servicemen grew up in the capital region, submitted in fear to the central people,^[Central people (zhōng rén) refers to the people in control of the Palace, in this case the eunuchs.] but the Dòu clan instead employed them as the front line, and therefore they indeed rebelled and fled over to the Yellow Gates, this was bringing on oneself defeat and extermination. Now you General have the honor of the Foremost Maternal Uncle,^[Hé Jìn was the elder half-brother of the Dowager Empress Hé, mother of the Emperor.] Two Offices both managing strong troops,^[The other office may refer to the Dowager Empress Hé's other half brother Hé Miáo, who held office as Chariots and Cavalry General. Hé Jìn and the Dowager shared the same father, Hé Miáo and the Dowager the same mother, but Hé Miáo was adopted over to the Hé family and took the Hé surname.] the division retainers and officers and clerks, all are outstanding heroes and famed servicemen, happy to exhaustively devote strength to the death, the task is in your hand, Heaven's is supporting in the timing. Now to for Heaven's Under execute and eliminate the greedy and corrupt, the achievements will be prominent, bequeath reputation to later generations, even Zhōu's Shēn Bó, how would he be worth discussing?^[Shēn Bó, or "Earl of Shēn," was a celebrated relative by marriage of the Zhōu dynasty's ruling family, maternal uncle of Zhōu King Xuān.] Now the Greatly Departed is in the Front Hall,^[Greatly Departed (dà xíng) refers to the recently deceased Emperor, before the posthumous name is determined. At this time Emperor Líng had recently died and his body was in the Palace Front Hall, though the posthumous name Líng had not yet been selected.] you General use Edict letter to manage the troops to guard and defend, and need not enter the Palace." [Hé] Jìn accepted this advice, later instead became doubtful. [Yuán] Shào feared [Hé] Jìn would change [his mind], and coerced [Hé] Jìn stating: "Now the preparations are already complete, the situation already exposed, General how can you not quickly settle it? When matters are detained changes appear, when missing the opportunity disaster arrives." [Hé] Jìn did not listen, and therefore was destroyed.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　九州春秋曰：初紹說進曰：「黃門、常侍累世太盛，威服海內，前竇武欲誅之而反為所害，但坐言語漏泄，以五營士為兵故耳。五營士生長京師，服畏中人，而竇氏反用其鋒，遂果叛走歸黃門，是以自取破滅。今將軍以元舅之尊，二府並領勁兵，其部曲將吏，皆英雄名士，樂盡死力，事在掌握，天贊其時也。今為天下誅除貪穢，功勳顯著，垂名後世，雖周之申伯，何足道哉？今大行在前殿，將軍以詔書領兵衛守，可勿入宮。」進納其言，後更狐疑。紹懼進之改變，脅進曰：「今交搆已成，形勢已露，將軍何為不早決之？事留變生，後機禍至。」進不從，遂敗。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Dǒng Zhuó called [Yuán] Shào, discussed a wish to depose the Emperor and establish the King of Chénliú. At the time Yuán Shào's father's younger brother [Yuán] Wěi was Grand Tutor, [Yuán] Shào falsely agreed to it, stating: "This is a great affair, I will go out and with the Grand Tutor discuss." [Dǒng] Zhuó said: "The Liú clan's lineage is not worth restoring." [Yuán] Shào did not answer, with horizontal saber deep salute and then left.^[Horizontal saber deep salute (héng dāo cháng yī) was a deep standing bow with both hands clasped together and extended forward, while keeping one's sword or saber horizontal across the body.] <a href="#annotation-42" id="source-42">[42]</a> [Yuán] Shào had gone out, and therefore deserted and fled to Jì Province. Attendant Central Zhōu Bì, City Gate Colonel Wǔ Qióng, Consultant Cadet Hé Yóng and others all were famed servicemen, [Dǒng] Zhuó trusted them, but they secretly supported [Yuán] Shào, thus they persuaded [Dǒng] Zhuó stating: "Deposing and establishing are great affairs, not what ordinary men can reach. [Yuán] Shào does not understand the overall picture, was frightened and therefore went out and fled, not having ulterior ambitions. Now to urgently offer bounty for him, the situation certainly will change [badly]. The Yuán clan has cultivated kindness for four generations, their family lineage and former clerks are everywhere Under Heaven, if he collects towering figures to gather masses and multitudes, outstanding heroes will take advantage of this and rise, then the east of the mountains will not be Your Excellency's possession. It is not as good as pardoning him, appointing him a prefecture administrator, then [Yuán] Shào will be pleased to escape punishment, and certainly there will be no worries." [Dǒng] Zhuó believed it correct, and so appointed [Yuán] Shào as Bóhǎi Administrator, enfeoffed Marquess of Kàng village.^[Kàng village was in Yǐngchuān. See the annotations to Hòu Hàn shū 74.]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
董卓呼紹，議欲廢帝，立陳留王。是時紹叔父隗為太傅，紹偽許之，曰：「此大事，出當與太傅議。」卓曰：「劉氏種不足復遺。」紹不應，橫刀長揖而去。〔一〕紹既出，遂亡奔冀州。侍中周毖、城門校尉伍瓊、議郎何顒等，皆名士也，卓信之，而陰為紹，乃說卓曰：「夫廢立大事，非常人所及。紹不達大體，恐懼故出奔，非有他志也。今購之急，勢必為變。袁氏樹恩四世，門世故吏遍於天下，若收豪傑以聚徒眾，英雄因之而起，則山東非公之有也。不如赦之，拜一郡守，則紹喜于免罪，必無患矣。」卓以為然，乃拜紹勃海太守，封邟鄉侯。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-42" id="annotation-42">[42]</a> Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Dǒng] Zhuó wished to depose the Emperor, said to [Yuán] Shào stating: "The Imperial Emperor is immature and ignorant, not a Ruler of Ten Thousand Chariots. The King of Chénliú is yet superior, now I wish to establish him. That a person may have youthful intelligence but when grown may be stupid, I also know; what can be done? It should for the time being be so. Did you not see Emperor Líng? Remembering that makes a man indignant and bitter." [Yuán] Shào said: "The Hàn House has ruled Heaven's Under for four hundred and some years, grace and favor deep and rich, the numerous people have revered it for a long time. Now though the Emperor is young and immature, he has not had evils announced and heard Under Heaven, Your Excellency wishes to depose the legitimate to establish the concubine-born,^[The then-Emperor Liú Biàn was born from the Empress, his younger brother the King of Chénliú Liú Xié was born from a concubine.] I fear the masses will not follow Your Excellency's suggestion." [Dǒng] Zhuó said to [Yuán] Shào stating: "Impudent boy! How are Heaven's Under's affairs not decided by me? I now will do it, who dares not follow? Do you say that Dǒng Zhuó's saber is not sharp?" [Yuán] Shào said: "The strong Under Heaven, how are they only Your Excellency Dǒng?" He drew his girdle saber horizontal and saluted and then left.

Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: [Yuán] Shào at this time with [Dǒng] Zhuó did not yet reach to hostility, therefore [Dǒng] Zhuó with him consulted on plans. If only for speaking disagreement in discussion, to at once curse him as an 'impudent boy' and have a heart to use blade, and then [Yuán] Shào's reply answer was all the more stubbornly defiant,^[The translation 'stubbornly defiant' assumes that the text's qū jiāng is an equivalent to jué jiàng (倔強)] also how could [Dǒng] Zhuó tolerate and not apply harm? Moreover regarding [Yuán] Shào in this speech, advancing it was not clear and upright, withdrawing it violated tact and humility, but instead made obvious his intention to compete vigorously, to charge the spearpoint of a roaring beast, for one with ambition for achievement and enterprise, logically how could it be so? This story, the absurdity is extreme.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝春秋曰：卓欲廢帝，謂紹曰：「皇帝沖闇，非萬乘之主。陳留王猶勝，今欲立之。人有少智，大或癡，亦知復何如，為當且爾；卿不見靈帝乎？念此令人憤毒！」紹曰；「漢家君天下四百許年，恩澤深渥，兆民戴之來久。今帝雖幼沖，未有不善宣聞天下，公欲廢適立庶，恐眾不從公議也。」卓謂紹曰：「豎子！天下事豈不決我？我今為之，誰敢不從？爾謂董卓刀為不利乎！」紹曰：「天下健者，豈唯董公？」引佩刀橫揖而出。臣松之以為紹於時與卓未搆嫌隙，故卓與之諮謀。若但以言議不同，便罵為豎子，而有推刃之心，及紹復答，屈疆為甚，卓又安能容忍而不加害乎？且如紹此言，進非亮正，退違詭遜，而顯其競爽之旨，以觸哮闞之鋒，有志功業者，理豈然哉！此語，妄之甚矣。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Yuán] Shào therefore in Bóhǎi raised troops, intending to execute [Dǒng] Zhuó. The story is in the [Wǔ Annals](01.qmd#caocao). [Yuán] Shào declared himself Chariots and Cavalry General, leading the alliance, with Jì Province Governor Hán Fù establishing Yōu Province Governor Liú Yú as Emperor, sent envoy to present petition to visit [Liú] Yú, [Liú] Yú did not dare accept. Later [Hán] Fù's army at Ānpíng was by Gōngsūn Zàn defeated. [Gōngsūn] Zàn therefore led troops to enter Jì Province, with suppressing [Dǒng] Zhuó as pretext, inside wishing to surprise attack [Hán] Fù. [Hán] Fù was filled with unease. <a href="#annotation-43" id="source-43">[43]</a> It happened that [Dǒng] Zhuó to the west entered the passes, [Yuán] Shào returned his army to Yánjīn, took advantage of [Hán] Fù being frightened and anxious, sent Chénliú's Gāo Gàn, Yǐngchuān's Xún Chén and others to persuade [Hán] Fù stating: "Gōngsūn Zàn rides on victory to come heading south, while various prefectures are complying with him. Yuán Chēqí^[This refers to Yuán Shào by his office as Chariots and Cavalry General (chēqí jiāngjūn)] leads an army heading east, this is his intentions cannot be known, I humbly believe you General to be endangered by it." [Hán] Fù said: "What is to be done about it?" [Xún] Chén said: "Gōngsūn leads the soldiers of Yān and Dài, his advance cannot be faced. Yuán-shì^[Shì is an honorific used to avoid Yuán Shào's personal name out of respect.] is a hero of the time, and certainly will not be your subordinate, General. Jì Province is the heavy resource of Heaven's Under, if the two stalwarts join forces, troops meeting below the city walls, danger and destruction can immediately be waited for. Yuán-shì is your old friend, General, and moreover of the alliance. Right now in the plans for you General, none compare to leading Jì Province to yield to Yuán-shì. When Yuán-shì obtains Jì Province, then [Gōngsūn] Zàn will be unable to contest it, and he will certainly generously favor you, General. Jì Province going to a close friend, is you General having the reputation of yielding to worthiness, and you body will be as secure as Tài Mountain. May you General not doubt!" [Hán] Fù by nature was fearful and timid, and therefore agreed with this plan. [Hán] Fù's Chief Clerk Gěng Wǔ, Separate Carriage Mǐn Chún, Manager Central Lǐ Lì^[Chief Clerk (zhǎngshǐ) was the chief of staff for a high official. Separate Carriage (biéijià) and Manager Central (zhìzhōng) were the two highest provincial staff officers under the provincial Governor.] remonstrated [Hán] Fù stating: "Although Jì Province is rustic, those wearing armor are a million, the grain lasts ten years. Yuán Shào is an isolated guest with exhausted armor, relying on us for breath, like an infant atop the palm of the hand, cut off its milk, and immediately it can be starved ot death. Why then wish to have the province given to him?" [Hán] Fù said: "I am the Yuán clan's former clerk, moreover my talent does not compare to Běnchū. Measuring virtue and so yielding, is what the ancients valued, why do you sirs alone complain?" Following Officials Zhào Fú, Chéng Huàn requested to with troops resist them, [Hán] Fù also did not listen. Thus yielded to [Yuán] Shào, <a href="#annotation-44" id="source-44">[44]</a> [Yuán] Shào therefore was designated Jì Province Governor.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
紹遂以勃海起兵，將以誅卓。語在武紀。紹自號車騎將軍，主盟，與冀州牧韓馥立幽州牧劉虞為帝，遣使奉章詣虞，虞不敢受。後馥軍安平，為公孫瓚所敗。瓚遂引兵入冀州，以討卓為名，內欲襲馥。馥懷不自安。〔一〕會卓西入關，紹還軍延津，因馥惶遽，使陳留高幹、潁川荀諶等說馥曰：「公孫瓚乘勝來向南，而諸郡應之，袁車騎引軍東向，此其意不可知，竊為將軍危之。」馥曰：「為之奈何？」諶曰：「公孫提燕、代之卒，其鋒不可當。袁氏一時之傑，必不為將軍下。夫冀州，天下之重資也，若兩雄并力，兵交於城下，危亡可立而待也。夫袁氏，將軍之舊，且同盟也，當今為將軍計，莫若舉冀州以讓袁氏。袁氏得冀州，則瓚不能與之爭，必厚德將軍。冀州入於親交，是將軍有讓賢之名，而身安於泰山也。願將軍勿疑！」馥素恇怯，因然其計。馥長史耿武、別駕閔純、治中李歷諫馥曰：「冀州雖鄙，帶甲百萬，穀支十年。袁紹孤客窮軍，仰我鼻息，譬如嬰兒在股掌之上，絕其哺乳，立可餓殺。奈何乃欲以州與之？」馥曰：「吾，袁氏故吏，且才不如本初，度德而讓，古人所貴，諸君獨何病焉！」從事趙浮、程奐請以兵拒之，馥又不聽。乃讓紹，〔二〕紹遂領冀州牧。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-43" id="annotation-43">[43]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: Páng Jì persuaded [Yuán] Shào stating: "General you have raised a great affair but yet rely on another for supplies, to not occupy a province, is to have no way to preserve oneself." [Yuán] Shào answered saying: "Jì Province's troops are strong, my servicemen are hungry and tired, supposing if it cannot be done, there will be nowhere left to stand." [Páng] Jì said: "You can with Gōngsūn Zàn exchange news, guiding him to come south, to strike and take Jì Province. Gōngsūn [Zàn] certainlly will arrive and then [Hàn] Fù will be afraid, take advantage to send an explanation of the benefits and harms, for him lay out the disasters and fortunes, [Hán] Fù certainly will abdicate and yield. At that interval, you can occupy his position." [Yuán] Shào followed this advice and [Gōngsūn] Zàn indeed came.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　英雄記曰：逢紀說紹曰：「將軍舉大事而仰人資給，不據一州，無以自全。」紹答云：「冀州兵彊，吾士飢乏，設不能辦，無所容立。」紀曰：「可與公孫瓚相聞，導使來南，擊取冀州。公孫必至而馥懼矣，因使說利害，為陳禍福，馥必遜讓。於此之際，可據其位。」紹從其言而瓚果來。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-44" id="annotation-44">[44]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Hán] Fù sent Overall Supervisor Following Officials Zhào Fú and Chéng Huàn with strong crossbows of ten thousand to garrison Héyáng. [Zhào] Fú and the rest heard that [Hán] Fù wished to have Jì Province given to [Yuán] Shào, from Mèngjīn galloped east downstream. At the time [Yuán] Shào was still at Zhāogē's Qīng river's mouth, [Zhào] Fú and the rest from the rear came, the boats several hundred ships, multitudes over ten thousand men, organized troops drumming and in the night passing [Yuán] Shào's camp, [Yuán] Shào extremely hated it. [Zhào] Fú and the rest arrived, spoke to [Hán] Fù stating: "Yuán Běnchū's army is without a dǒu of provisions, each are already scattering. Although he has Zhāng Yáng and Yūfúluó newly attached, they will not yet agree to be employed, and are not sufficient to be opposition. We your minor Following Officials request to personally with our present troops resist them. Within ten days, they will certainly collapse apart. Enlightened General you only should open doors and highly rest. What is to worry about, what is to fear?" [Hán] Fù did not listen, and so left his position, going out to reside in Zhào Zhōng's former residence. Sent his son to present Jì Province's Seal and Ribbon at Líyáng to give to [Yuán] Shào.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　九州春秋曰：馥遣都督從事趙浮、程奐將彊弩萬張屯河陽。浮等聞馥欲以冀州與紹，自孟津馳東下。時紹尚在朝歌清水口，浮等從後來，船數百艘，眾萬餘人，整兵鼓夜過紹營，紹甚惡之。浮等到，謂馥曰：「袁本初軍無斗糧，各己離散，雖有張楊、於扶羅新附，未肯為用，不足敵也。小從事等請自以見兵拒之，旬日之間，必土崩瓦解；明將軍但當開閤高枕，何憂何懼！」馥不從，乃避位，出居趙忠故舍。遣子齎冀州印綬於黎陽與紹。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Following Official Jū Shòu <a href="#annotation-45" id="source-45">[45]</a> persuaded [Yuán] Shào stating: "General when you were capped you ascended to Court, then spread fame Within the Seas. On happening on an interval of deposing and establishing, then your loyalty and righteousness roused to action. Alone on horseback going out to flee, then Dǒng Zhuó was filled with terror. Crossing the Hé and going north, then Bóhǎi bowed head. Rousing the soldiers of one prefecture, gathering the multitudes of Jì Province, your power shakes the Hé's north, your name heavy Under Heaven. Although the Huángjīn are crafty and chaotic, the Hēishān trampling and insolent, on raising an army and heading east, then Qīng Province can be settled; returning to suppress the Hēishān, then Zhāng Yān can be exterminated; turning the multitudes to head north, then Gōngsūn will certainly be destroyed; shaking and coercing the Róng and Dí, then the Xiōngnú will certainly follow. Crossing the Great Hé's north, uniting the lands of Four Provinces, collecting the talents of outstanding heroes, gahtering multitudes of a million, welcoming the Great Chariot from the western capital, restoruing the Ancestral Temple at Luò city, declaring orders Under Heaven, to suppress the not yet submitted, in this way contending advance, who is able to withstand it? Within a few years, this achievement will not be difficult." [Yuán] Shào was pleased and said: "This is my heart." At once memorialized [Jū] Shòu as Overseer of the Army, Exerting Authority General. <a href="#annotation-46" id="source-46">[46]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó sent Metal Mace Bearer Húmǔ Bǎn, General Architect Wú Xiū to present Edict letter to explain to [Yuán] Shào, [Yuán] Shào sent Hénèi Administrator Wáng Kuāng to kill them. <a href="#annotation-47" id="source-47">[47]</a> [Dǒng] Zhuó heard that [Yuán] Shào had obtained the east of the passes, and so entirely executed [Yuán] Shào's clansmen Grand Tutor [Yuán] Wěi and the rest. At that time, of the powerful vigilantes many attached to [Yuán] Shào all thinking to avenge him, the provinces and prefectures swarmed and rose, none not borrowing his name [as justification]. [Hán] Fù was full of fear, from [Yuán] Shào requested to leave, and went to depend on Zhāng Miǎo. <a href="#annotation-48" id="source-48">[48]</a> Later [Yuán] Shào sent an envoy to visit [Zhāng] Miǎo, having a discussion on plans, with [Zhāng] Miǎo whispering in ears. [Hán] Fù was seated above, believed he was being met with plotting and framing, very soon rose and went to the privy and killed himself. <a href="#annotation-49" id="source-49">[49]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
從事沮授〔一〕說紹曰：「將軍弱冠登朝，則播名海內；值廢立之際，則忠義奮發；單騎出奔，則董卓懷怖；濟河而北，則勃海稽首。振一郡之卒，撮冀州之眾，威震河朔，名重天下。雖黃巾猾亂，黑山跋扈，舉軍東向，則青州可定；還討黑山，則張燕可滅；回眾北首，則公孫必喪；震脅戎狄，則匈奴必從。橫大河之北，合四州之地，收英雄之才，擁百萬之眾，迎大駕於西京，復宗廟於洛邑，號令天下，以討未復，以此爭鋒，誰能敵之？比及數年，此功不難。」紹喜曰：「此吾心也。」即表授為監軍、奮威將軍。〔二〕卓遣執金吾胡母班、將作大匠吳脩齎詔書喻紹，紹使河內太守王匡殺之。〔三〕卓聞紹得關東、乃悉誅紹宗族太傅隗等。當是時，豪俠多附紹，皆思為之報，州郡蜂起，莫不假其名。馥懷懼，從紹索去，往依張邈。〔四〕後紹遣使詣邈，有所計議，與邈耳語。馥在坐上，謂見圖構，無何起至溷自殺。〔五〕
:::

〔一〕沮音葅。

<a href="#source-46" id="annotation-46">[46]</a> Xiàn-dì jì states: Jū Shòu was a Guǎngpíng man, in youth had great ambition, many expedient strategies. Served in the province as a Separate Carriage, nominated Abundant Talent, successively Magistrate in two counties, also became Hán Fù's Separate Carriage, memorialized and appointed a Cavalry Commandant. Yuán Shào obtained Jì Province, also recruited him.

Yīngxióng jì states: At the time the Year Name was Chūpíng, [Yuán] Shào's appellation was Běnchū, he himself believed that the Year with his appellation corresponded, and he certainly would be able to subdue and pacify the disaster and chaos.^[Yuán Shào is interpreting the Year Name Chūpíng "Beginning of Pacification" as "(Běn)chū pacifies."]
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝紀曰：沮授，廣平人，少有大志，多權略。仕州別駕，舉茂才，歷二縣令，又為韓馥別駕，表拜騎都尉。袁紹得冀州，又辟焉。英雄記曰：是時年號初平，紹字本初，自以為年與字合，必能克平禍亂。

:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #humuban}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-47" id="annotation-47">[47]</a> Hàn Mò Míngshì lù states: [Húmǔ] Bān appellation Jìpí was a Tàishān man, in youth with Shānyáng's Dù Shàng, Dōngpíng's Zhāng Miǎo and others of eight men all disparaged wealth and attended to righteousness, rousing and relieving people and servicemen, the era called them the Eight Kitchens.^[Eight Kitchens (bāchú) may be to mean that they "fed" society through their charity and righteousness.]

Xiè Chéng's Hòu Hàn shū states: [Húmǔ] Bān was Wáng Kuāng's younger sister's husband, Dǒng Zhuó sent [Húmǔ] Bān carrying Edict to arrive at Hénèi to explain to and dismiss the Righteous Troops. [Wáng] Kuāng accepted Yuán Shào's directions, arrested [Húmǔ] Bān and bound him in prison, wishing to kill him to show to the army. [Húmǔ] Bān's letter to [Wáng] Kuāng said: "Since antiquity onward, there has never been subordinate land vassal lords raising troops to head toward the capital region. Liú Xiàng's Zhuàn states: 'In throwing a rat, fear for the vessel.'^[Liú Xiàng (77 - 6 BC) was a Western Hàn era scholar.] Even for a vessel yet fear for it, all the more when [Dǒng] Zhuó now is situated inside the Palace towers, with Heaven's Son as his screen, the Young Ruler is in the Palace, how can he be suppressed? I with Grand Tutor His Excellency Mǎ, Minister Charioteer Zhào Qí, Minister Treasurer Yīn Xiū all accepted Edict mandate. The various prefectures east of the passes, although they truly loathe [Dǒng] Zhuó, yet they accept and serve the Ruling Mandate, not daring to disgrace it. But you sir alone confine me in prison, wishing to have my blood smear the drums,^[Smearing blood on drums (xìn gǔ) was an ancient war ritual where the blood of some sacrifice was smeared onto war drums, to pray for good fortune in battle.] this is the most extreme of perverse cruelty without morality. I and Dǒng Zhuó have what kinship, in righteousness how am I alike in evil? Yet you sir spread the mouth of tigers and wolves, spit the venom of long serpents, your rage at [Dǒng] Zhuó transferred onto another, what extreme ruthlessness! Death is what any person finds difficult, however it is a humiliation to be murdered by a mandman. If the deceased have awareness, I will complain of you sir to the August Heavens. That marriage is the pivot of disaster or fortune, today it is proven. Formerly we were of one body, now we are blood enemies. [I, this] dead man's sons of two men, then are your sister's sons, after my body is destroyed, be careful to not let them see my skeleton." [Wáng] Kuāng obtained the letter, hugged [Húmǔ] Bān's two sons and sobbed. [Húmǔ] Bān therefore died in prison.

[Húmǔ] Bān once saw Tàishān Fǔjūn and Hébó,^[Tàishān Fǔjūn is a god of Tài Mountain, Hébó a god of the Hé, or Yellow River.] the matter is in Sōushén jì, the words many and not recorded here.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　漢末名士錄曰：班字季皮，太山人，少與山陽度尚、東平張邈等八人並輕財赴義，振濟人士，世謂之八廚。謝承後漢書曰：班，王匡之妹夫，董卓使班奉詔到河內，解釋義兵。匡受袁紹旨。收班繫獄，欲殺之以徇軍。班與匡書云：「自古以來，未有下土諸侯舉兵向京師者。劉向傳曰『擲鼠忌器』，器猶忌之，況卓今處宮闕之內，以天子為藩屏，幼主在宮，如何可討？僕與太傅馬公、太僕趙岐、少府陰脩俱受詔命。關東諸郡，雖實嫉卓，猶以銜奉王命，不敢玷辱。而足下獨囚僕于獄，欲以釁鼓，此悖暴無道之甚者也。僕與董卓有何親戚，義豈同惡？而足下張虎狼之口，吐長蛇之毒，恚卓遷怒，何甚酷哉！死，人之所難，然恥為狂夫所害。若亡者有靈，當訴足下於皇天。夫婚姻者禍福之機，今日著矣。曩為一體，今為血讎。亡人子二人，則君之甥，身沒之後，慎勿令臨僕尸骸也。」匡得書，抱班二子而泣。班遂死於獄。班嘗見太山府君及河伯，事在搜神記，語多不載。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-48" id="annotation-48">[48]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Yuán] Shào appointed Hénèi's Zhū Hàn as Overall Office Following Official. [Zhū] Hàn in previous times was disrespected by [Hán] Fù, inside held resentment, and moreover wished to cater to [Yuán] Shào's intentions, without authority mobilized the city wall troops to besiege [Hán] Fù's mansion, drawing blade and ascending into the rooms. [Hán] Fù fled upstairs. Captured [Hán] Fù's eldest son, hammered and broke both his legs. [Yuán] Shào at once arrested [Zhū] Hàn, killed him. [Hán] Fù yet was anxious and afraid, and therefore reported to [Yuán] Shào to request to leave.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　英雄記曰：紹以河內朱漢為都官從事。漢先時為馥所不禮，內懷怨恨，且欲邀迎紹意，擅發城郭兵圍守馥第，拔刃登屋。馥走上樓，收得馥大兒，槌折兩腳。紹亦立收漢，殺之。馥猶憂怖，故報紹索去。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #quyi}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-49" id="annotation-49">[49]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: Gōngsūn Zàn struck the Qīng Province Huángjīn rebels, greatly defeated them, returned to garrison Guǎngzōng,^[Guǎngzōng was in Jùlù prefecture.] replacing the administrators and magistrates, of Jì Province's Chief Clerks none did not watch the winds and comply in answer, opening the gates to receive him. [Yuán] Shào personally went to campaign against [Gōngsūn] Zàn, meeting in battle at Jiè Bridge's south by twenty lǐ. [Gōngsūn] Zàn's infantry of over thirty thousand emn formed a square formation, cavalry as two wings, left and right each over five thousand, the White Force Righteous Followers forming the center core, also divided to form two regiments, left shooting right, right shooting left, the banners and armor shined Heaven and Earth. [Yuán] Shào ordered Qū Yì with eight hundrd troops as the first to ascend, strong crossbows of a thousand sets flanking and continuing after them, [Yuán] Shào personally with infantry of several tens of thousands joined in formation to the rear. [Qū] Yì for a long time had been at Liáng Province, aware of and trained in Qiāng warfare, his troops all valiant and keen. [Gōngsūn] Zàn saw their troops were few, immediately unleashed the cavalry wishing to overrun and trample them. [Qū] Yì's troops all lay below shields and did not move, until they reached within several tens of bù, then at the same time all rose, scattering dust and greatly shouting, directly forward charging, the strong crossbows thundered and fired, all that was hit was certain to topple, right on the battle lines cut off [Gōngsūn] Zàn's appointed Jì Province Inspector Yán Gāng's armored head, obtained over a thousand heads. [Gōngsūn] Zàn's army was defeated utterly, infantry and cavalry fled and ran, no longer returning to camp. [Qū] Yì pursued eaching Jiè Bridge, [Gōngsūn] Zàn's rearguard troops returned to battle atop the bridge, [Qū] Yì further defeated them, therefore arrived at [Gōngsūn] Zàn's camp, pulled out his Ivory Gates,^[Ivory Gates (yámén) were ivory tipped flags that marked military camp entrances.] the remaining multitudes inside the camp all further scattered and fled. [Yuán] Shào was at the rear, had not yet arrived at the bridge by ten and several lǐ, dismounted horse and released saddle, saw [Gōngsūn] Zàn was already defeated, did not set preparations, below his tent only strong crossbows of several tens of sets and large halberd servicemen of over a hundred men accompanied his person. [Gōngsūn] Zàn's division's fleeing cavalry of over two thousand suddenly arrived, immediately encircled [Yuán] Shào in several layers, bow shot arrows like rain falling. Separate Carriage Following Official Tián Fēng supported [Yuán] Shào wishing to retreat into an empty wall, [Yuán] Shào threw his helmet to the ground stating: "A great man should forward fight to the death, but to instead enter within a wall, how could one live?" The strong crossbows then chaotically fired, many were by them killed and wounded. [Gōngsūn] Zàn's cavalry did not know it was [Yuán] Shào, and also somewhat drew back. It happened Qū Yì came to welcome, and so they scattered and left.
Every time [Gōngsūn] Zàn with caitiffs battled, he always rode a white horse, in pursuit never shot in vain, repeatedly winning military victories, the caitiffs informed one another saying: "You should avoid the white horse." Taking advantage of what the caitiffs feared, he selected out his white horses of several thousand, chose out servicemen of mounted archery, called as the White Horse Righteous Followers. Another account states: the strong of the Hú and Yí always rode white horses, [Gōngsūn] Zàn had strong cavalry of several thousand, many rode white horses, therefore they were called by that.
[Yuán] Shào had defeated [Gōngsūn] Zàn, led his army south arriving at Bóluò Ford, right when he with his guest retainers and various offers together gathered, he heard Wèi prefecture's troops had rebelled, with the Hēishān bandit Yú Dú together overturned Yè city, therefore killing Administrator Lì Chéng. The bandits were over ten divisions, multitudes several tens of thousands of people, gathered inside Yè. The seated various guests that had families in Yè all were anxious and afraid and lost color, some rising to cry and sob. [Yuán] Shào's expression did not change, at ease. The bandit Táo Shēng was a former Nèihuáng minor clerk, had a good heart, alone commanded a division multitude to go over the west city wall to enter, shut and defended the provincial gates, not letting in other bandits, with carts conveyed [Yuán] Shào's family and various robed and capped within the provincial seat, personally defending and guarding, escorting to arrive at Chìqiū^[Chìqiū county was in Wèi prefecture.] and then returning. [Yuán] Shào arrived, therefore garrisoned Chìqiū, appointed Táo Shēng as Establishing Righteousness Central Cadet General. Then led the army to enter Zhāogē's Lùcháng mountain's Cāngyán valley to suppress Yú Dú, besieged and attacked for five days, defeated them, beheaded [Yú] Dú with Cháng'ān's appointed Jì Province Governor Hú Shòu. Therefore along the mountains northward travelled, approached and strike the various bandits Zuǒ Zīzhàngbā and others, beheaded them all. Also struck Liú Shí, Qīng Niújiǎo, Huánglóng, Zuǒ Xiào, Guō Dàxián, Lǐ Dàmù, Yú Dīgēn and others,^[These bandit leaders all used rather stylistic sobriquets rather than formal names. A direct translation of these might be Yú the Poison, Zuǒ Eight-zhàng-mustache, Liú the Rock, Qīng Oxhorn or Green Oxhorn, Yellow Dragon, Zuǒ Colonel or Left Colonel, Guō the Great Worthy, Lǐ Big Eyes, Yú the Root (though it has also been proposed Yúdīgēn may instead be a phonetic transcription of a foreign name.)] slaughtering all their garrison camps, those that fled obtained escape, the beheaded were several tens of thousands of heads. [Yuán] Shào again returned to garrison Yè.
Chūpíng Fourth Year [193], Heaven's Son sent Grand Tutor Mǎ Mìdī and Minister Charioteer Zhào Qí to make peace with the east of the passes. [Zhào] Qí separately visited the Hé's north, [Yuán] Shào went out to welcome at over a hundred lǐ, bowing to receive the Emperor's command. [Zhào] Qí stayed in [Yuán] Shào's camp, dispatch letter to inform [Gōngsūn] Zàn. [Gōngsūn] Zàn sent envoy to provide a letter to [Yuán] Shào that stated: "Minister Charioteer Zhào by the virtue of Zhōu and Shào carried mandate to come on campaign, to announce and spread the Court's grace, demonstrate peace and harmony, vast as parting the clouds to see the sun, what joy compares to this? In the past Jiǎ Fù and Kòu Xún also quarreled over soldiers and wished to endanger and harm one another, encountered the magnamity of Guāng-Wǔ, personally met both at the Throne, in the same carriage together went out, at the time people believed it glorious.^[When the two officers quarreled, Hàn Emperor Guǎng-Wǔ had both summoned to his presence, and had them leave in the same carriage. The story is in the biography of Kòu Xún in Hòu Hàn shū 16.] Examining myself on the borders, to be able to with you General together share this fortune, this truly is affection for you General, and good fortune for [me, Gōngsūn] Zàn." Qū Yì later relied on his achievements and so was arrogant and presumptuous, [Yuán] Shào thus killed him.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　英雄記曰：公孫瓚擊青州黃巾賊，大破之，還屯廣宗，改易守令，冀州長吏無不望風響應，開門受之。紹自往征瓚，合戰于界橋南二十里。瓚步兵三萬餘人為方陳，騎為兩翼，左右各五千餘匹，白馬義從為中堅，亦分作兩校，左射右，右射左，旌旗鎧甲，光照天地。紹令麴義以八百兵為先登，彊弩千張夾承之，紹自以步兵數萬結陳于後。義久在涼州，曉習羌鬥，兵皆驍銳。瓚見其兵少，便放騎欲陵蹈之。義兵皆伏楯下不動，未至數十步，乃同時俱起，揚塵大叫，直前衝突，彊弩雷發，所中必倒，臨陳斬瓚所署冀州刺史嚴綱甲首，獲千餘級。瓚軍敗績，步騎奔走，不復還營。義追至界橋；瓚殿兵還戰橋上，義復破之，遂到瓚營，拔其牙門，營中餘眾皆復散走。紹在後，未到橋十數里，下馬發鞍，見瓚已破，不為設備，惟帳下彊弩數十張，大戟士百餘人自隨。瓚部迸騎二千餘匹卒至，便圍紹數重，弓矢雨下。別駕從事田豐扶紹欲卻入空垣，紹以兜鍪撲地曰：「大丈夫當前鬥死，而入牆閒，豈可得活乎？」彊弩乃亂發，多所殺傷。瓚騎不知是紹，亦稍引卻；會麴義來迎，乃散去。瓚每與虜戰，常乘白馬，追不虛發，數獲戎捷，虜相告云「當避白馬」。因虜所忌，簡其白馬數千匹，選騎射之士，號為白馬義從；一曰胡夷健者常乘白馬，瓚有健騎數千，多乘白馬，故以號焉，紹既破瓚，引軍南到薄落津，方與賓客諸將共會，聞魏郡兵反，與黑山賊于毒共覆鄴城，遂殺太守栗成。賊十餘部，眾數萬人，聚會鄴中。坐上諸客有家在鄴者，皆憂怖失色，或起啼泣，紹容貌不變，自若也。賊陶升者，故內黃小吏也，有善心，獨將部眾踰西城入，閉守州門，不內他賊，以車載紹家及諸衣冠在州內者，身自扞衛，送到斥丘乃還。紹到，遂屯斥丘，以陶升為建義中郎將。乃引軍入朝歌鹿場山蒼巖谷討于毒，圍攻五日，破之，斬毒及長安所署冀州牧壺壽。遂尋山北行，薄擊諸賊（左髮丈八）〔左髭丈八〕等，皆斬之。又擊劉石、青牛角、黃龍、左校、郭大賢、李大目、于氐根等，皆屠其屯壁，奔走得脫，斬首數萬級。紹復還屯鄴。初平四年，天子使太傅馬日磾、太僕趙岐和解關東。岐別詣河北，紹出迎於百里上，拜奉帝命。岐住紹營，移書告瓚。瓚遣使具與紹書曰：「趙太僕以周召之德，銜命來征，宣揚朝恩，示以和睦，曠若開雲見日，何喜如之？昔賈復、寇恂亦爭士卒，欲相危害，遇光武之寬，親俱陛見，同輿共出，時人以為榮。自省邊鄙，得與將軍共同此福，此誠將軍之眷，而瓚之幸也。」麴義後恃功而驕恣，紹乃殺之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns #guotu}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, Heaven's Son's establishment was not [Yuán] Shào's intention,^[The current Emperor Liú Xié had been enthroned by Dǒng Zhuó over Yuán Shào's opposition.] and when at Hédōng, [Yuán] Shào sent Yǐngchuān's Guō Tú as envoy. [Guō] Tú returned and advised [Yuán] Shào to welcome Heaven's Son to set capital at Yè, [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. <a href="#annotation-50" id="source-50">[50]</a> It happened that Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] welcomed Heaven's Son to set capital at Xǔ, collected the lands south of the Hé, Guānzhōng all attached. [Yuán] Shào was regretful, and wished to order Tàizǔ to relocate Heaven's Son's capital to Juànchéng to be closer to himself, Tàizǔ refused him. Heaven's Son had [Yuán] Shào become Grand Commandant, transferred to General-in-Chief, enfeoffed Marquess of Yè, <a href="#annotation-51" id="source-51">[51]</a> [Yuán] Shào declined the Marquessate and did not accept. Shortly after this, struck and defeated [Gōngsūn] Zàn at Yìjīng, absorbed his multitudes. <a href="#annotation-52" id="source-52">[52]</a> Sent out his eldest son [Yuán] Tán as Qīng Province, Jū Shòu remonstrated [Yuán] Shào: "Certainly this will be the beginning of disaster." [Yuán] Shào did not listen, stating: "I^[Yuán Shào uses the first person pronoun gū "orphaned," or "fatherless." This pronoun was historically used by vassal lords, as usually their noble titles would be inherited from a deceased father.] wish to have my various sons each occupy one province." <a href="#annotation-53" id="source-53">[53]</a> Also had his middle son [Yuán] Xī as Yōu Province, sister's son Gāo Gàn as Bìng Province. His multitudes were several hundred thousand, with Shěn Pèi, Páng Jì presiding military affairs, Tián Fēng, Xún Chén, Xǔ Yōu as strategy masters, Yán Liáng, Wén Chǒu as commanding leaders, selected elite soldiers of a hundred thousand, cavalry of ten thousand, about to attack Xǔ. <a href="#annotation-54" id="source-54">[54]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，天子之立非紹意，及在河東，紹遣潁川郭圖使焉。圖還說紹迎天子都鄴，紹不從。〔一〕會太祖迎天子都許，收河南地，關中皆附。紹悔，欲令太祖徙天子都鄄城以自密近，太祖拒之。天子以紹為太尉，轉為大將軍，封鄴侯，〔二〕紹讓侯不受。頃之。擊破瓚于易京，井其眾。〔三〕出長子譚為青州，沮授諫紹：「必為禍始。」紹不聽，曰：「孤欲令諸兒各據一州也。」〔四〕又以中子熙為幽州，甥高幹為并州。眾數十萬，以審配、逢紀統軍事，田豐、荀諶、許攸為謀主，顏良、文醜為將率，簡精卒十萬，騎萬匹，將攻許。〔五〕
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-50" id="annotation-50">[50]</a> Xiàn-dì zhuàn states: Jū Shòu advised [Yuán] Shào saying: "General [your family] for accumulated generations assisted and aided [the Emperor], for generations perpetuating loyalty and righteousness. Now the Court is scattered and wandering, the Ancestral Temple destroyed and ruined, observing the various provinces and prefectures, outside they claim righteous troops, inside they plot to exterminate one another, none preserving the Ruler and relieving the people. Moreover now the provincial city is roughly settled, it is appropriate to welcome the Great Chariot, secure the Palace in Yè capital, grasp Heaven's Son and so command the vassal lords, raise servicemen and horses to suppress those not submitted, who would be able to withstand it?" [Yuán] Shào was pleased and about to follow this. Guō Tú and Chúnyú Qióng said: "The Hàn House has declined for a long time, now to wish to restore it, is it not very difficult? Moreover now outstanding heroes occupy and possess provinces and prefectures, multitudes mobilized in the count of tens of thousands, what is called 'Qín lost its deer, the first to capture it is King.' If you welcome Heaven's Son to be near yourself, actions then must be memorialized and heard, following him then is authority lightened, opposing him then is to defy commands, it is not a good plan." [Jū] Shòu said: "Now to welcome the Court is utmost righteousness, also the grand strategy appropriate for the times, if it is not early planned, certainly there will be someone who pre-empts us. Power is in not losing opportunity, achievement is in fast speed, General may you consider this!" [Yuán Shào was not able to employ this.

Note: This book claims it was Jū Shòu's plan, then it is with the base biography in opposition.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝傳曰：沮授說紹云：「將軍累葉輔弼，世濟忠義。今朝廷播越，宗廟毀壞，觀諸州郡外託義兵，內圖相滅，未有存主恤民者。且今州城粗定，宜迎大駕，安宮鄴都，挾天子而令諸侯，畜士馬以討不庭，誰能禦之！」紹悅，將從之。郭圖、淳于瓊曰：「漢室陵遲，為日久矣，今欲興之，不亦難乎！且今英雄據有州郡，眾動萬計，所謂秦失其鹿，先得者王。若迎天子以自近，動輒表聞，從之則權輕，違之則拒命，非計之善者也。」授曰：「今迎朝廷，至義也，又於時宜大計也，若不早圖，必有先人者也。夫權不失機，功在速捷，將軍其圖之！」紹弗能用。案此書稱（郭圖）〔沮授〕之計，則與本傳違也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-51" id="annotation-51">[51]</a> Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shào was ashamed to be ranked below Tàizǔ, and angrily said: "Cáo Cāo was about to die several times, I at once rescued and preserved him, now he then turns back on kindness, grasps haven's Son to command me!" Tàizǔ heard, and so had the General-in-Chief [position] yielded to [Yuán] Shào.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝春秋曰：紹恥班在太祖下，怒曰；「曹操當死數矣，我輒救存之，今乃背恩，挾天子以令我乎！」太祖聞，而以大將軍讓于紹。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-52" id="annotation-52">[52]</a> Diǎnlüè states: From this, [Yuán] Shào's tribute became rare and slow, and he privately sent his Registrar Gěng Bāo to secretly report stating: "The Red Virtue has decayed completely, Yuán is the Yellow heir, and should obey Heaven's intentions." [Yuán] Shào had [Gěng] Bāo's secretly reported affair shown to the Army Office commanders and clerks. The discussions all believed [Gěng] Bāo was deceptive and absurd and should be executed, [Yuán] Shào thus killed [Gěng] Bāo to disassociate himself.

Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū states: [Yuán] Shào extended summons for Běihǎi's Zhèng Xuán but was not respectful, Zhào Róng heard this and said: "A worthy man is the hope of the noble men. To disrespect the worthy is to lose the hopes of the noble men. A lord of action does not dare to lose the pleased hearts of the myriad people, all the more the noble men. To lose the hopes of the noble men, is difficulty to have action."

Yīngxióng jì records Tàizǔ's Song of Dǒng Zhuó, the lyrics say: "Virtue and Conduct are not lacking, yet misfortunes are difficult to endure. Zhèng Kāngchéng was passing the liquor, fell to the ground and his breath severed, Guō Jǐngtú's fate ended in the garden mulberries." By this writing, then [Zhèng] Xuán without illness yet died, this is not seen in other books, therefore it is recorded here.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　典略曰：自此紹貢御希慢，私使主薄耿苞密白曰：「赤德衰盡，袁為黃胤，宜順天意。」紹以苞密白事示軍府將吏。議者咸以苞為妖妄宜誅，紹乃殺苞以自解。九州春秋曰：紹延徵北海鄭玄而不禮，趙融聞之曰：「賢人者，君子之望也。不禮賢，是失君子之望也。夫有為之君，不敢失萬民之歡心，況於君子乎？失君子之望，難乎以有為矣。」英雄記載太祖作董卓歌，辭云：「德行不虧缺，變故自難常。鄭康成行酒，伏地氣絕，郭景圖命盡于園桑。」如此之文，則玄無病而卒。餘書不見，故載錄之。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-53" id="annotation-53">[53]</a> Jiǔzhōu Chūnqiū records Jū Shòu's remonstration statement stating: "The world says when one rabbit flees through the intersection, ten thousand people chase it, when one person catches it, the greedy all stop, because the allocation is settled. Moreover, when age is equal use worthiness, when virtue is equal then use divination, is the system of antiquity. May you above ponder the admonishments of successes and failures of the former dynasties, below consider the meaning of chasing rabbits and allocation settlement." [Yuán] Shào said: "I wish to have my four sons each occupy one province, to observe their abilities." [Jū] Shòu went out and said: "Diaster will begin from this!" [Yuán] Tán first reached Qīng Province, became Overall Supervisor, not yet Inspector, later Tàizǔ appointed him Inspector.^[Overall Supervisor (dūdū) was a military supervisor in control over a certain region. Inspector (cìshǐ) was the actual head of a province.] His territory from the Hé on west overall did not exceed Píngyuán and nothing more, therefore he to the north expelled Tián Kǎi, to the east attacked Kǒng Róng, shining troops to the sea shore, at the time the Hundred Surnames were without master, and happily supported him. However he trusted and employed the petty, enjoyed receiving gossip, unrestained in will and extravagant in debauchery, not understanding the hardships of sowing and reaping. Huà Yàn and Kŏng Shùn both were treacherous flatterers and petty men, he trusted them as belly and heart. Wáng Xiū and others filled offices and nothing more. However he was able to receive guest retainers, admire reputation and respect servicemen. He had his wife's younger brother manage troops in the interior, to the extent it caused banditry in the markets and outside caitiffs plundered the fields and wilds. Separately sent two officers to recruit troops in subordinate counties, those that paid bribes met with exemption, those without met with capture, the poor and weak were many, so it reached to fleeing and hiding inside the hills and wilds, released troops to capture and search, like hunting birds and beasts. In towns that had ten thousand households, the registered did not reach several hundred. In collecting levies and taxes, out of three parts the income did not reach one. In recruiting and appointing worthy servicemen, they did not accept. Those that did not hasten to attend military service but resided peacefully with clan and associates, also could not be punished.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　九州春秋載授諫辭曰：「世稱一兔走衢，萬人逐之，一人獲之，貪者悉止，分定故也。且年均以賢，德均則卜，古之制也。願上惟先代成敗之戒，下思逐兔分定之義。」紹曰：「孤欲令四兒各據一州，以觀其能。」授出曰：「禍其始此乎！」譚始至青州，為都督，未為刺史，後太祖拜為刺史。其土自河而西，蓋不過平原而已。遂北排田楷，東攻孔融，曜兵海隅，是時百姓無主，欣戴之矣。然信用群小，好受近言，肆志奢淫，不知稼穡之艱難。華彥、孔順皆姦佞小人也，信以為腹心；王脩等備官而已。然能接待賓客，慕名敬士。使婦弟領兵在內，至令草竊，巿井而外，虜掠田野；別使兩將募兵下縣，有賂者見免，無者見取，貧弱者多，乃至於竄伏丘野之中，放兵捕索，如獵鳥獸。邑有萬戶者，著籍不盈數百，收賦納稅，參分不入一。招命賢士，不就；不趨赴軍期，安居族黨，亦不能罪也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-54" id="annotation-54">[54]</a> Shìyǔ states: [Yuán] Shào's infantry was fifty thousand, cavalry eight thousand.

Sūn Shèng's Appraisal states: Note that Wèi Wǔ [Cáo Cāo] spoke to Cuī Yǎn stating: "Yesterday consulting your esteemed province's household registries, I can obtain three hundred thousand in multitudes." By this considering it, if just Jì Province had numerous troops already like this, all the more when combined with Yōu, Bìng, and Qīng provinces! [Yuán] Shào in his great mobilization certainly with all his brigades rose up, a hundred thousand is closer to it.

Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to southward send brigades, Jū Shòu and Tián Fēng remonstrated stating: "The brigades have been sent out for successive years, the Hundred Surnames weary and distressed, the granaries without reserves, the taxes and conscription currently abundant, this is the state's deep distress. It is appropriate to first send envoy proffer report of the triumphs to Heaven's Son, attend to agriculture and rest the people. If [the envoy] cannot be connected, then memorialize that Cáo-shì is cutting off our ruler's road, and then afterward advance to garrison Líyáng, gradually fortify the Hé's south, increasingly build boats and ships, mend and repair equipment and weapons, divide and send elite cavalry, plunder their borders, to cause them to be unable to be at ease, while we obtain rest. Within three years, the matter can be settled while sitting." Shěn Pèi and Guō Tú said: "In the methods of military books, if ten [times the enemy in size] besiege, if five attack, if matched then able to battle. Now with Your Enlightened Excellency's divine warfare, striding the Hé's north's strong multitudes to cut down Cáo-shì, is [as easy] as turning a hand. Now to not timely take him, is to later have trouble in planning." [Jū] Shòu said: "Overall rescuing from chaos and executing the cruel is called as Righteous Troops, relying on numbers and depending on strength is called as Arrogant Troops. Troops that are righteous are without match, the arrogant are the first exterminated. Cáo-shì welcomed Heaven's Son and secured Palace at Xǔ capital, now to raise troops to head south, in righteousness then is violation. Moreover strategies of a Temple Victory is not in strength or weakness.^[Temple Victory (miàoshèng) refers to the concept of achieving victory from the overall strategic planning in the Temple.] Cáo-shì's laws and orders are enacted, his soldiers elite and trained, not the situation of Gōngsūn Zàn sitting and waiting to be surrounded. Now to abandon the techniques of total security, and instead raise troops without justification, I humbly on behalf of Your Excellency fear this!" [Guō] Tú and others said: "King Wǔ attacking Zhòu was not called not righteous, all the more when troops are used against Cáo-shì and yet said to be without justification! Moreover Your Excellency's brigades and martial ministers are strong, the officers and servicemen indignant and wrathful, the people think to exert themselves, but yet to not follow the timing and early settle the great enterprise, is a failure in thinking. If what Heaven gives is not taken, it is instead to receive its blame, this is how Yuè became the hegemon and how Wú was destroyed. The plan of the Overseer of the Army [Jū] Shòu is a plan to hold firm, but yet not to see the timing and understand the transformations of opportunity." [Yuán] Shào followed this. [Guō] Tú and the rest took advantage of this to slander [Jū] Shòu: "The Overseer presides interior and exterior, authority shakes the Three Armies, if he gradually flourishes further, how will you control him? For the servant and master to not be the same is prosperity, the master and servant to be the same is destruction, this is what Huángshí dreaded.^[Huángshígōng "Yellow Stone Elder" was a reclusive figure during the Qín-Hàn transition period said to have taught military strategy to Zhāng Liáng.] Moreover the one managing the multitudes in the exterior, is not appropriate to know the interior." [Yuán] Shào became suspicious, and so divided the Overseer of the Army office into Three Overall Supervisors, having [Jū] Shòu with Guō Tú and Chúnyú Qióng each managing one army, therefore gathered and went south.
:::
