:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　世語曰：紹步卒五萬，騎八千。孫盛評曰：案魏武謂崔琰曰「昨案貴州戶籍，可得三十萬眾」。由此推之，但冀州勝兵已如此，況兼幽、并及青州乎？紹之大舉，必悉師而起，十萬近之矣。獻帝傳曰：紹將南師，沮授、田豐諫曰：「師出歷年，百姓疲弊，倉庾無積，賦役方殷，此國之深憂也。宜先遣使獻捷天子，務農逸民；若不得通，乃表曹氏隔我王路，然後進屯黎陽，漸營河南，益作舟船，繕治器械，分遣精騎，鈔其邊鄙，令彼不得安，我取其逸。三年之中，事可坐定也。」審配、郭圖曰：「兵書之法，十圍五攻，敵則能戰。今以明公之神武，跨河朔之彊眾，以伐曹氏。譬若覆手，今不時取，後難圖也。」授曰：「蓋救亂誅暴，謂之義兵；恃眾憑彊，謂之驕兵。兵義無敵，驕者先滅。曹氏迎天子安宮許都，今舉兵南向，於義則違。且廟勝之策，不在彊弱。曹氏法令既行，士卒精練，非公孫瓚坐受圍者也。今棄萬安之術，而興無名之兵，竊為公懼之！」圖等曰：「武王伐紂，不曰不義，況兵加曹氏而云無名！且公師武臣（竭）力，將士憤怒，人思自騁，而不及時早定大業，慮之失也。夫天與弗取，反受其咎，此越之所以霸，吳之所以亡也。監軍之計，計在持牢，而非見時知機之變也。」紹從之。圖等因是譖授「監統內外，威震三軍，若其浸盛，何以制之？夫臣與主不同者昌，主與臣同者亡，此黃石之所忌也。且御眾于外，不宜知內。」紹疑焉。乃分監軍為三都督，使授及郭圖、淳于瓊各典一軍，遂合而南。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Before this, Tàizǔ [Cáo Cāo] sent Liú Bèi to visit Xú Province to resist Yuán Shù. [Yuán] Shù died, [Liú] Bèi killed Inspector Chē Zhòu and led his army to garrison Pèi. [Yuán] Shào sent cavalry to assist him. Tàizǔ sent Liú Dài and Wáng Zhōng to strike him, not successful. Jiàn'ān Fifth Year [200], Tàizǔ personally campaigned east against [Liú] Bèi. Tián Fēng advised [Yuán] Shào to attack Tàizǔ's rear, [Yuán] Shào refused due to his child's illness and did not permit it. [Tián] Fēng raised his cane and struck the ground stating: "To encounter a difficult to find opportunity, but yet for an infant's illness lose the chance, a pity!" Tàizǔ arrived, struck and defeated [Liú] Bèi, [Liú] Bèi fled to [Yuán] Shào. <a href="#annotation-55" id="source-55">[55]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
先是，太祖遣劉備詣徐州拒袁術。術死，備殺刺史車冑，引軍屯沛。紹遣騎佐之。太祖遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克。建安五年，太祖自東征備。田豐說紹襲太祖後，紹辭以子疾，不許，豐舉杖擊地曰：「夫遭難遇之機，而以嬰兒之病失其會，惜哉！」太祖至，擊破備；備奔紹。〔一〕

::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-55" id="annotation-55">[55]</a> Wèi-shì Chūnqiū records [Yuán] Shào's Dispatch to the Provinces and Prefectures Writing stating: "Overall it is heard that the Enlightened Ruler plans for danger to control for changes, the Loyal Minister considers difficulties to establish expedience. Formerly strong Qín had a weak Ruler, Zhào Gāo seized the handles [of power], concentrating control over Court commands, authority and fortune coming from himself, in the end there was the disaster of Wàngyí, the filth and disgrace reaching the present.^[The Second Emperor of Qín was weak, allowing the powerful Chancellor Zhào Gāo to seize control. The Shàng Shū has a quote of "create authority create fortune" as exclusive prerogatives of the ruler, referring respectively to the ruler's authority to issue punishments and rewards. Eventually Zhào Gāo sent troops to attack Wàngyí Palace to force the Emperor to commit suicide.] Reaching to arrive at Empress Lǚ, [Lǚ] Lù and [Lǚ] Chǎn controlled the government, usurped authority to decide the myriad affairs,^[After the death of Hàn Emperor Gāo Liú Bāng, his widow the Empress Lǚ took control of the government, greatly empowering her clansmen Lǚ Lù and Lǚ Chǎn.] determining affairs in the Restricted Ministries,^[The Restricted Ministries (shěngjīn) referred to the government offices within the Imperial Palace.] the below rising to replace the above,^['The below rising to replace the above' (xià líng shàng tì) is a quote from the Zuǒ Zhuàn.] Within the Seas was cold in heart. Thereupon the Marquess of Jiàng and Zhūxū raised authority and exerted fury, executed and exterminated the rebellious and chaotic, honored and established Tàizōng,^[After the death of Empress Lǚ, the Marquess of Jiàng Zhōu Bó along with the Marquess of Zhūxū Liú Zhāng (a grandson of Hàn Emperor Gāo Liú Bāng) led a military coup to overthrow the Lǚ clan and invite Liú Héng, another son of Liú Bāng, to become Emperor. Liú Héng later received the posthumous name Hàn Emperor Wén and the Temple Name Tàizōng.] therefore able to make moral cultivation rise and expand, radiance and brilliance clear and harmonizing, this then is a clear example of chief ministers establishing expedience. The Excellency of Works Cáo Cāo's grandfather [Cáo] Téng was a former Central Regular Attendant, with Zuǒ Guàn, Xú Huáng together created evils, gluttony and greed unleased unrestrained, injuring cultivation and oppressing the people. His father [Cáo] Sōng was a beggar taken in for adoption, took advantage of illicit wealth to buy position, carts of gold and carriages of jade, to donate money to powerful gates, to steal rank in the Three Excellencies^[Tripod managers (dǐng sī) refer to the Three Excellencies through the analogy of the tripod having three legs], overturning the Heaviest Vessels. [Cáo] Cāo is a castrate's lingering disgrace, originally without good virtue, a frivolous cunning reckless vigilante, enjoys chaos and delights in disaster. Our Tent Office^[Tent Office (mùfǔ) refers to the tents of the commanding military officer. In this case Yuán Shào uses it as a first person pronoun for himself. Japan also famously adopted the term Tent Office as Bakufu, along with the term General (jiāngjūn) as Shogun, to refer to their Shogunate] in the past commanded falcons rising,^[Falcons rising (yīng yáng) is a metaphor for military commanders.]" to sweep away and exterminated vicious rebels. Continuing to encounter Dǒng Zhuó invading the government and terrorizing the state, thereupon I raised sword and beat the drums, issuing commands on the eastern Xià, then collecting and gathering outstanding heroes, ignoring blemishes to employ, and therefore then with [Cáo] Cāo consulted on strategies, believing him a talent of hawks and hounds, claws and teeth that could be appointed.^[Hawks and hounds (yīngquán) and claws and teeth (zhǎoyá) are both metaphors for hired thugs and lackeys.] It led then to his foolish and frivolous short-sighted plans, recklessly advancing and easily retreating, wounded and razed and broken and bleeding, repeatedly losing brigades and followers. Our Tent Office then again divided troops to command the keen, to repair and reinforce him, memorialized him as Acting Dōng Prefecture Administrator, Yǎn Province Inspector, covering him in tiger stripes, conferring him with auxiliary brigades, encouraging and pressing authority and control, hoping to obtain the repayment of the Qín brigade's single success.^[This is a reference to the Spring and Autumn era Qín commander Mèngmíng Shì. He suffered a humiliating defeat against Jìn but was pardoned, and repaid the generous treatment he received with a great victory.] But [Cáo] Cāo then took advantage of the resources to be insolent, recklessly enacting cruel fierceness, cutting apart the common people, ruining the worthy and harming the good. Former Jiǔjiāng Administrator Biān Ràng was an outstanding talent eminent and transcendant, Heaven's Under knew his name, for his blunt speech and stern expression, in discussion not fawning or flattering, his body and head suffered the massacre of cutting off and hanging, his wife and offspring received the calamity of ash and extermination. From this the forest of servicemen were indignant and pained, the people's grievances increasingly heavy, one man exerted arm, the entire province was alike in sound, and therefore his person was defeated in Xú region, his land seized away by Lǚ Bù, wavering about the eastern frontiers, nowhere to walk or stand. Our Tent Office pondered the meaning of strong trunks and weak branches, and moreover would not support a faction of rebels, and therefore again raised banners and wore armor, rolling up to go on campaign, metal drums sounded and shook, [Lǚ] Bù's multitudes were broken and destroyed, rescuing him [Cáo Cāo] from the misfortune of death and destruction, restoring his appointment as a regional governor, this then was Our Tent Office being without virtue to the people of Yǎn's lands, but having great benefit to [Cáo] Cāo. Later it happened the Belled Chariot returned east, crowds of caitiffs disordered the government. At the time Jì Province just had alarms on the northern border, without the leisure to leave its station, therefore I sent Following Official Central Cadet Xú Xūn to meet and send [Cáo] Cāo to have him mend and repair the Suburbs and Temple, support and defend the Young Ruler. But yet he then unleashed his ambitions to arbitrarily act, coercing the relocation of the Restricted Ministries, humiliating and insulting the Ruler's Officials, destroying law and disordering discipline, seated summoned the Three Terraces, usurping control over Court and government, noble ranks and rewards from his heart, punishment and executions by his mouth, those he favored were glorified to the Five Clans, those he hated were exterminated to Three Clans, the crowds that spoke out suffered prominent execution, those that discussed privately suffered secret killings, on the roads [people communicated only] by eyes, the hundred bureaus clamped their mouths, the Secretariat Writers recorded Court meetings, the Excellencies and Ministers filled personnel quotas and nothing more. Former Grand Commandant Yáng Biāo successively managed the Three Departments, reached the state's utmost positions,^[Yáng Biāo successively served in all three positions of the Three Excellencies.] [Cáo] Cāo because of an angry look, subjected him to wrongful punishment, beatings and canings both at once, the five tortures all arrived, indulging his passions and unleashing his malice, without regard to statute charters. Also Consultant Cadet Zhào Yàn loyally remonstrated with blunt speech, his suggestions had those that could be accepted, therefore the Sagely Court attentively listened, changed expression and applied bestowments, [Cáo] Cāo wished to seize away the authority of that time, block and sever the roads of speech, without authority arrested and immediately killed, not waiting to report and seek approval. Also King Xiào of Liáng was a Former Emperor's younger brother of the same mother,^[Liú Wǔ, posthumously Liáng King Xiào was a full younger brother of Hàn Emperor Jǐng. See Hàn shū 47 and Shǐjì 58.] his grave tomb honored and prominent, pines and cypress and mulberry and catalpa, and yet should have been respectfully maintained, but yet [Cáo] Cāo led commanders and officers and clerks and servicemen to personally oversee an excavation, breaking the coffin and stripping the corpse, plundering and taking the gold and treasures, so that it caused the Sagely Court to shed tears, servicemen and people wounded and grieved. Also he installed an Excavating Mounds Central Cadet General and Retrieving Gold Colonel, wherever they passed they desecrated, no skeletons not exposed. His body occupies the office of the Three Excellencies, but his conduct is the attitude of cruel caitiffs, destroying the state and oppressing the people, his toxicity flowing to people and ghosts. Additionally his trifling government is oppressive and cruel, rules and prohibitions set everywhere, silk snares fill the paths, pitfall traps block the roads, raise a hand and get caught in a net, move a foot and step on a mechanical trap, and therefore Yǎn and Yù [Provinces] have people with nothing they can do, the Emperor's capital has hushed sighs in resentment. Reading through the books and registers from antiquity to the present, of the recorded ministers of ruinous greed and intense cruelty and immorality, [Cáo] Cāo is the most extreme. Our Tent Office was busy investigating outer treacheries, not able to organize and train, gave attention to tolerance and covering, hoping it could be completely mended, but yet [Cáo] Cāo has a ravenous wolf's wild heart, secretly harbors disastrous plans, and so wishes to disturb and break the supporting pillars, isolate and weaken the Hàn House, eliminate and exterminate the correct and upright, usurp power as a ruthless warlord.^[The term xiāoxióng refers to an individual of ambitious and ruthless character. Compare similar terms yīngxióng "outstanding hero" and jiànxiōng "treacherous opportunist," where xióng "hero" should be understood in the classical sense of an individual of great strength and ability, without any particular comment on morality.] In former years I beat the drums on northern campaign to suppress Gōngsūn Zàn, a strongly defended cruel rebel who resisted a siege for one year. [Cáo] Cāo took advantage that he was not yet defeated, secretly exchanged letters and commands, wishing to claim to assist with the Ruling Brigades, to coordinate a surprise attack, and therefore led troops to the Hé, preparing boats to cross north. It happened that his messenger was exposed, [Gōngsūn] Zàn also was beheaded and exterminated, therefore causing his spear point to be blocked and withdrawn, his plots could not bear fruit. He garrisons and occupies Áo Granary, obstructs the Hé as defense, and so wishes to with the claw of a mantis block a massive chariot's path. Our Tent Office serves Hàn's authoritative spirit, breaks and charges through the cosmos, long halberds of a million, Hú cavalry of a thousand crowds, exerting the capabilities of Zhōnghuáng, [Xià] Yù, [Wū] Huò,^[Zhōnghuáng Bó was a legendary warrior of antiqutiy, Xià Yù and Wū Huò were legendary warriors from the Warring States era.] unleashing the power of fine bows and strong crossbows, Bìng Province crosses the Tàiháng [mountains], Qīng Province wades the Jǐ and Tà [rivers], the main army sails the Yellow Hé to horn his front, Jīng Province goes down Yuān and Shè to drag his rear,^[Horn (jiǎo) and drag (jǐ) refer to a strategy of attacking front and rear using the metaphor of hunting a beast by engaging its horns at the front and dragging its legs from the rear. Yuān and Shè counties were in Nányáng prefecture. The characters for the names are also commonly pronounced Wǎn and Yè in modern times, but the older readings are favored here, especially to disambiguate Yuān county from the Wǎn county in Lújiāng prefecture.] thunder shaking and tiger pouncing, together gathering at the caitiff's hall, like raising a flaming fire to burn through a flying tumbleweed, overturning the azure sea to flood a burning coal, how can it not be annihilated? Right now Hàn's Way is declined, network slackened and cords severed. [Cáo] Cāo with elite troops of seven hundred encircles and guards the Palace watchtowers, outside claiming to assist the defense, inside to maintain detainment, fearing that the disaster of usurpation and rebellion will take advantage of this to be created, thus it is the autumn for loyal ministers to stain their livers and brains on the ground, the opportunity for ardent martyrs to establish achievement, can you not exhort yourselves!" This was Chén Lín's writing.^[For Chén Lín see the biography of Wáng Càn in Sān Guó zhì 21.]

〔一〕　魏氏春秋載紹檄州郡文曰：「蓋聞明主圖危以制變，忠臣慮難以立權。曩者彊秦弱主，趙高執柄，專制朝命，威福由己，終有望夷之禍，汙辱至今。及臻呂后，祿、產專政，擅斷萬機，決事省禁，下陵上替，海內寒心。於是絳侯、朱虛興威奮怒，誅夷逆亂，尊立太宗，故能道化興隆，光明顯融，此則大臣立權之明表也。司空曹操，祖父騰，故中常侍，與左悺、徐璜並作妖孽，饕餮放橫，傷化虐民。父嵩，乞匄攜養，因贓假位，輿金輦璧，輸貨權門，竊盜鼎司，傾覆重器。操贅閹遺醜，本無令德，僄狡鋒俠，好亂樂禍。幕府昔統鷹揚，掃夷凶逆。續遇董卓侵官暴國，於是提劍揮鼓，發命東夏，方收羅英雄，棄瑕錄用，故遂與操參咨策略，謂其鷹犬之才，爪牙可任。至乃愚佻短慮，輕進易退，傷夷折衄，數喪師徒。幕府輒復分兵命銳，修完補輯，表行東郡太守、兗州刺史，被以虎文，授以偏師，獎蹙威柄，冀獲秦師一克之報。而操遂乘資跋扈，肆行酷烈，割剝元元，殘賢害善。故九江太守邊讓，英才俊逸，天下知名，以直言正色，論不阿諂，身〔首〕被梟縣之戮，妻孥受灰滅之咎。自是士林憤痛，民怨彌重，一夫奮臂，舉州同聲，故躬破於徐方，地奪於呂布，彷徨東裔，蹈據無所。幕府唯彊幹弱枝之義，且不登叛人之黨，故復援旌擐甲，席卷赴征，金鼓響震，布眾破沮，拯其死亡之患，復其方伯之任，是則幕府無德於兗土之民，而有大造於操也。後會鑾駕東反，群虜亂政。時冀州方有北鄙之警，匪遑離局，故使從事中郎徐勛就發遣操，使繕修郊廟，翼衛幼主。而便放志專行，脅遷省禁，卑侮王官，敗法亂紀，坐召三臺，專制朝政，爵賞由心，刑戮在口，所愛光五宗，所惡滅三族，群談者蒙顯誅，腹議者蒙隱戮，道路以目，百寮鉗口，尚書記朝會，公卿充員品而已。故太尉楊彪，歷典三司，享國極位，操因睚眥，被以非罪，榜楚并兼，五毒俱至，觸情放慝，不顧憲章。又議郎趙彥，忠諫直言，議有可納，故聖朝含聽，改容加錫，操欲迷奪時權，杜絕言路，擅收立殺，不俟報聞。又梁孝王，先帝母弟，墳陵尊顯，松柏桑梓，猶宜恭肅，而操率將校吏士親臨發掘，破棺裸尸，略取金寶，至令聖朝流涕，士民傷懷。又署發丘中郎將、摸金校尉，所過墮突，無骸不露。身處三公之官，而行桀虜之態，殄國虐民，毒流人鬼。加其細政苛慘，科防互設，繒繳充蹊，坑阱塞路，舉手挂網羅，動足蹈機陷，是以兗、豫有無聊之民，帝都有吁嗟之怨。歷觀古今書籍，所載貪殘虐烈無道之臣，於操為甚。幕府方詰外姦，未及整訓，加意含覆，冀可彌縫。而操豺狼野心，潛苞禍謀，乃欲撓折棟梁，孤弱漢室，除滅中正，專為梟雄。往歲伐鼓北征，討公孫瓚，彊禦桀逆，拒圍一年。操因其未破，陰交書命，欲託助王師，以相掩襲，故引兵造河，方舟北濟。會其行人發露，瓚亦梟夷，故使鋒芒挫縮，厥圖不果。屯據敖倉，阻河為固，乃欲以螳螂之斧，禦隆車之隧。幕府奉漢威靈，折衝宇宙，長戟百萬，胡騎千群，奮中黃、育、獲之材，騁良弓勁弩之勢，并州越太行，青州涉濟、漯，大軍汎黃河以角其前，荊州下宛、葉而掎其後，雷震虎步，並集虜庭，若舉炎火以概飛蓬，覆滄海而沃熛炭，有何不消滅者哉？當今漢道陵遲，綱弛紀絕。操以精兵七百，圍守宮闕，外稱陪衛，內以拘執，懼其篡逆之禍，因斯而作。乃忠臣肝腦塗地之秋，烈士立功之會也，可不勖哉！」此陳琳之辭。
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Yuán] Shào advanced army to Líyáng, sent Yán Liáng to attack Liú Yán at Báimǎ. Jū Shòu again remonstrated [Yuán] Shào: "[Yán] Liáng by nature is impatient and narrow-minded, though he is valiant and brave he cannot be appointed alone." [Yuán] Shào did not listen. Tàizǔ rescued [Liú] Yán, with [Yán] Liáng battled, defeated and beheaded [Yán] Liáng. <a href="#annotation-55" id="source-55">[55]</a> [Yuán] Shào crossed the Hé, fortified Yán Ford's south, sent Liú Bèi and Wén Chǒu to challenge battle. Tàizǔ struck and defeated them, beheaded [Wń] Chǒu. In two battles took [Yuán] Shào's chief officers, [Yuán] Shào's army was greatly shaken. <a href="#annotation-56" id="source-56">[56]</a> Tàizǔ returned to Guāndù. Jū Shòu again said: "The northern troops more are numerous but their determination and spirit does not reach the south's, the south's grain is lacking and scarce and money and wealth does not reach the north's, the south's advantage is in quick battle, the north's advantage is in protracted combat. It is appropriate to slowly maintain for a long time, draw out by days and moons." [Yuán] Shào did not follow this, linked camps to gradually advance, pressured Guāndù, engaged in battle, Tàizǔ's army was not successful, returned to the ramparts. [Yuán] Shào made high towers, raised earthen mountains, shot into the camps, inside the camps all covered with shields, the multitudes greatly afraid. Tàizǔ thus made shooting stone carts, struck [Yuán] Shào's towers, all were broken, [Yuán] Shào's multitudes called them Thunderbolt Carts. <a href="#annotation-57" id="source-57">[57]</a> [Yuán] Shào made earthen tunnels, wishing to surprise attack Tàizǔ's camp. Tàizǔ at once in the interior made a long moat to resist this. Also sent surprise troops to raid and strike [Yuán] Shào's transport carts, greatly defeated them, completely burned his grain. Tàizǔ with [Yuán] Shào were locked together for a long time, the Hundred Surnames exhausted, and many rebelled in support of [Yuán] Shào, the army's provisions were exhuasted. It happened that [Yuán] Shào sent Chúnyú Qióng and others to command troops of over ten thousand men to welcome transport carts, Jū Shòu advised [Yuán] Shào: "You can send officer Jiǎng Qí separately as a branch army on the exterior, to cut off Cáo-gōng's raids." [Yuán] Shào again did not follow this. [Chúnyú] Qióng lodged at Wūcháo, from [Yuán] Shào's army by forty lǐ. Tàizǔ then left Cáo Hóng to defend, personally commanded infantry and cavalry of five thousand in the cover of night to secretly go attack [Chúnyú] Qióng. [Yuán] Shào sent cavalry to rescue him, they were defeated and fled. Defeatd [Chúnyú] Qióng and the rest, beheaded them all. Tàizǔ returned, had not yet reached his camp, [Yuán] Shào's officers Gāo Lǎn and Zhāng Hé and others led their multitudes to surrender. [Yuán] Shào's multitudes greatly collapsed, [Yuán] Shào with [Yuán] Tán on single horseback retreatd to cross the Hé. The remaining multitudes falsely surrendered, completely massacred them.^[The term for massacre (kēng) later also gained another meaning of "bury alive," but does not have that meaning here."] <a href="#annotation-58" id="source-58">[58]</a> Jū Shòu did not reach [Yuán] Shào to cross, was by someone captured, sent to Tàizǔ. <a href="#annotation-59" id="source-59">[59]</a> Tàizǔ generously treated him. Later he plotted to return to the Yuán clan, was put to death.

:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
紹進軍黎陽，遣顏良攻劉延于白馬。沮授又諫紹：「良性促狹，雖驍勇不可獨任。」紹不聽。太祖救延，與良戰，破斬良。〔一〕紹渡河，壁延津南，使劉備、文醜挑戰。太祖擊破之，斬醜，再戰，禽紹大將。紹軍大震。〔二〕太祖還官渡。沮授又曰：「北兵數眾而果勁不及南，南穀虛少而貨財不及北；南利在於急戰，北利在於緩搏。宜徐持久，曠以日月。」紹不從。連營稍前，逼官渡，合戰，太祖軍不利，復壁。紹為高櫓，起土山，射營中，營中皆蒙楯，眾大懼。太祖乃為發石車，擊紹樓，皆破，紹眾號曰霹靂車。〔三〕紹為地道，欲襲太祖營。太祖輒於內為長塹以拒之，又遣奇兵襲擊紹運車，大破之，盡焚其穀。太祖與紹相持日久，百姓疲乏，多叛應紹，軍食乏。會紹遣淳于瓊等將兵萬餘人北迎運車，沮授說紹：「可遣將蔣奇別為支軍於表，以斷曹公之鈔。」紹復不從。瓊宿烏巢，去紹軍四十里。太祖乃留曹洪守，自將步騎五千候夜潛往攻瓊。紹遣騎救之，敗走。破瓊等，悉斬之。太祖還，未至營，紹將高覽、張郃等率其眾降。紹眾大潰，紹與譚單騎退渡河。餘眾偽降，盡坑之。〔四〕沮授不及紹渡，為人所執，詣太祖，〔五〕太祖厚待之。後謀還袁氏，見殺。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-56" id="annotation-56">[56]</a> Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to set out, Jū Shòu met with his clansmen, scattered his wealth to give to them stating: "When momentum is present then one's power has nowhere it cannot be applied, when momentum is lost then one cannot protect one's own body, a sorrow!" His younger brother [Jū] Zōng said: "Cáo-gōng's servicemen and horses are no match, why are you afraid?" [Jū] Shòu said: "With Cáo Yǎnzhōu's enlightened strategy,^[At this time Cáo Cāo was Governor of Yǎn Province (yǎnzhōu) and therefore referred to by his office.] and also holding Heaven's Son as his resource, although we overcame Gōngsūn [Zàn], the multitudes in fact are weary and worn, but the officers arrogant and the ruler complacent, the defeat of the army will be in this action. Yáng Xióng had a saying: 'Six States of ignorant worms, for the Yíng weakend the Jī.'^[Jī was the ruling family of the declining Zhōu dynasty, Yíng the ruling family of Qín state which eventually conquered the rival six states to establish the Qín Empire.] This speaks of the present."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　獻帝傳曰：紹臨發，沮授會其宗族，散資財以與之曰：「夫勢在則威無不加，勢亡則不保一身，哀哉！」其弟宗曰：「曹公士馬不敵，君何懼焉！」授曰：「以曹兗州之明略，又挾天子以為資，我雖克公孫，眾實疲弊，而將驕主泰，軍之破敗，在此舉也。揚雄有言，『六國蚩蚩，為嬴弱姬』，今之謂也。」
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-57" id="annotation-57">[57]</a> Xiàn-dì Zhuàn states: [Yuán] Shào was about to cross the Hé, Jū Shòu remonstrated stating: "The transformations of victory or defeat cannot be not scrutinized. Now it is appropriate to remain to garrison Yán Ford, divide troops to Guāndù. If they overcome and capture, returning to welcome will not be too late, but supposing if there are difficulties, the multitudes would not be able to return." [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. [Jū] Shòu oversaw the crossing and sighed stating: "The above overflows in ambition, the below attend to their achievements. Vast vast Yellow Hé, will I not return?" Therefore he claimed illness to resign. [Yuán] Shào resented this, and so reduced his division's troops to be subordinated to Guō Tú.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　獻帝傳曰：紹將濟河，沮授諫曰：「勝負變化，不可不詳。今宜留屯延津，分兵官渡，若其克獲，還迎不晚，設其有難，眾弗可還。」紹弗從。授臨濟歎曰：「上盈其志，下務其功，悠悠黃河，吾其不反乎！」遂以疾辭。紹恨之，乃省其所部兵屬郭圖。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-58" id="annotation-58">[58]</a> Wèishì Chūnqiū states: As antiquity had projectile stones, also there was a saying: "The Kuài moves and drums." Shuōwén states: "Kuài is a shot stone." Thereupon built Shooting Stone Carts.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔三〕　魏氏春秋曰：以古有矢石，又傳言「旝動而鼓」，說〔文〕曰「旝，發石也」，於是造發石車。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-59" id="annotation-59">[59]</a> Zhāng Fán's Hàn jì says: Killed [Yuán] Shào's soldiers altogether eighty thousand people.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　張璠漢紀云：殺紹卒凡八萬人。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-60" id="annotation-60">[60]</a> Xiànd-ì Zhuàn says: [Jū] Shòu greatly shouted stating: "[I, Jū] Shòu do not surrender, I was only by the army captured!" Tàizǔ and he had an old relationship, faced and spoke to [Jū] Shòu stating: "Our Field Allocations were different,^[Field Allocations (fēnyě) refers to the astrological process of mapping regions of the sky to regions of the earth. Here it refers to the fate and fortune that Jū Shòu and Cáo Cāo should have ended up in different places.] and therefore we were estranged, unexpectedly today then I captured you." [Jū] Shòu replied stating: "Jìzhōu^[This refers to Yuán Shào by his office title as Governor of Jì Province (jìzhōu)] failed in strategy, and by this resulted in fleeing north. [I, Jū] Shòu in intelligence and strength was both lacking, it is merely appropraite to meet with capture." Tàizǔ said: "Běnchū was without strategy, did not employ your plans, now the decline and chaos has passed a decade, the country is not yet settled, we should work together to plan for it." [Jū] Shòu said: "The lives of my father's younger brother, mother, younger brother hang on the Yuán clan. If I amy be favored with Your Excellency's spirit, a swift death would be good fortune." Tàizǔ sighed and said: "If I had earlier obtained you, Heaven's Under would not be worth worrying about."
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔五〕　獻帝傳云：授大呼曰：「授不降也，為軍所執耳！」太祖與之有舊，逆謂授曰：「分野殊異，遂用圮絕，不圖今日乃相禽也！」授對曰：「冀州失策，以取奔北。授智力俱困，宜其見禽耳。」太祖曰：「本初無謀，不用君計，今喪亂過紀，國家未定，當相與圖之。」授曰：「叔父、母、弟，縣命袁氏，若蒙公靈，速死為福。」太祖歎曰：「孤早相得，天下不足慮。」
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Previously, when [Yuán] Shào went south, Tián Fēng advised [Yuán] Shào stating: "Cáo-gōng excels in using troops, his adaptability without limit. Although his multitudes are few, he cannot be taken lightly. It is not as good as holding against him for a long time. General you occupy the firmness of mountains and rivers, embrace multitudes from four provinces, outside bond with outstanding heroes, inside attend to agriculture and war, and then afterward select out the most elite and keen, divide out surprise troops, take advantage of openings to repeatedly set out, by this disturb the Hé's south, when he rescues the right then strike his left, when he rescues the left then strike his right, to cause the enemy to be worn from fleeing about, their people to be unable to securely work, we will be without toil and they will already be exhausted, and not reaching to two years, you can overcome him while sitting. Now to discard the strategies of Temple Victory, and instead decide success or failure in a single battle, if it is not as you wish, regret would be too late." [Yuán] Shào did not follow this. [Tián] Fēng earnestly remonstrated, [Yuán] Shào's anger intensified, believed it discouraging the multitudes, shackled and bound him. When [Yuán] Shào's army was defeated, someone spoke to [Tián] Fēng stating: "You will certainly meet with value." [Tián] Fēng said: "If the army had been successful, I would certainly survive. Now that the army is defeatd, it is my death." [Yuán] Shào returned, spoke to his Left and Right stating: "I did not use Tián Fēng's advice, and indeed was laughed at by him." Therefore killed him. <a href="#annotation-61" id="source-61">[61]</a> [Yuán] Shào outside was lenient and elegant, having composure, sorrow and joy not appearing in his expression, but inside had many resentments and harms, all of this sort.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
初，紹之南也，田豐說紹曰：「曹公善用兵，變化無方，眾雖少，未可輕也，不如以久持之。將軍據山河之固，擁四州之眾，外結英雄，內脩農戰，然後簡其精銳，分為奇兵，乘虛迭出，以擾河南，救右則擊其左，救左則擊其右，使敵疲於奔命，民不得安業；我未勞而彼已困，不及二年，可坐克也。今釋廟勝之策，而決成敗於一戰，若不如志，悔無及也。」紹不從。豐懇諫，紹怒甚，以為沮眾，械繫之。紹軍既敗，或謂豐曰：「君必見重。」豐曰：「若軍有利，吾必全，今軍敗，吾其死矣。」紹還，謂左右曰：「吾不用田豐言，果為所笑。」遂殺之。〔一〕紹外寬雅，有局度，憂喜不形于色，而內多忌害，皆此類也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #tianfeng}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-61" id="annotation-61">[61]</a> Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Tián] Fēng appellation Yuánhào was a Jùlù man, some say Bóhǎi man. [Tián] Fēng was naturally endowned with extraordinary distinguishment, expedient strategies with many marvels, in youth lost his parents, observed mourning with thorough grief, although the days and moons passed, smiles never reached his lips. He extensively read with much knowledge, his reputation valued in the province and locality. First he was recruited to the Grand Commandant's Office, nominated Abundant Talent, promoted to Attendant Censor. The castrate eunuchs dominated the Court, outstanding worthies were harmed, [Tián] Fēng thus left office and returned home. When Yuán Shào rose up in righteousness, he used humble statements and generous gifts to recruit and attract [Tián] Fēng, [Tián] Fēng, because the Ruling House had many troubles, his ambition was to preserve and rescue it, and so he answered [Yuán] Shào's summons, becoming Separate Carriage. He urged [Yuán] Shào to welcome Heaven's Son, [Yuán] Shào did not accept [the proposal]. [Yuán] Shào later employed [Tián] Fēng's plans to pacify Gōngsūn Zàn. Páng Jì feared [Tián] Fēng's clear directness, repeatedly slandered him to [Yuán] Shào, [Yuán] Shào therefore dreaded [Tián] Fēng. At the defeat of [Yuán] Shào's army, they collapsed apart and fled north, the brigades and followers almost wiped out, the army all beat their chests and sobbed stating: "If Tián Fēng had been here, it would not have reached to this." [Yuán] Shào spoke to [Páng] Jì stating: "Jì Province's men on hearing that my army is defeated, will all pity me, only Separate Carriage Tián formerly remonstrated to stop me, with the masses not the same, I also am ashamed to see him." [Páng] Jì further said: "[Tián] Fēng on hearing of your retreat General, clapped his hands and greatly laughed, pleased that his advice was correct." [Yuán] Shào thereupon had the intention to harm [Tián] Fēng. Previously, Tàizǔ heard that [Tián] Fēng was not accompanying the army, was pleased and said: "[Yuán] Shào will certainly be defeated." Reaching to [Yuán] Shào fleeing and escaping, he further said: "If [Yuán] Shào had employed Separate Carriage Tián's plans, things would yet be uncertain."

Sūn Shèng states: Observing the plans of Tián Fēng and Jū Shòu, how would even [Zhāng] Liáng and [Chén] Píng surpass them?^[Zhāng Liáng and Chén Píng were celebrated strategists who served Liú Bāng at the initial rise of Hàn.] Therefore the lord values searching for talent, the minister esteemes measuring the master. When the lord employs the loyal and good, then the enterprise of hegemon kings expands. When the minister serves an ignorant ruler, then the disaster of downfall arrives. Survival or destruction, glory or disgrace, always are certain to come from this. [Tián] Fēng knew [Yuán] Shào was about to be defeated, and on defeat then he himself would certainly die, but willingly entered the tiger's mouth to be exhaustive in loyal admonishment. The ardent martyrs in their services, their considerations are not to preserve themselves. For the ministers of vassal lords, their relationships allow leaving and going, all the more when [Tián] Fēng to [Yuán] Shào was not an absolute minister.^[This refers to the fact that Yuán Shào was not an Emperor, so Tián Fēng was morally permitted to leave him.] The Shī says: 'I will leave you, to go to that happy land,' saying that leaving a chaotic country and going to where there is morality is permitted.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕先賢行狀曰：豐字元皓，鉅鹿人，或云勃海人。豐天姿瑰傑，權略多奇，少喪親，居喪盡哀，日月雖過，笑不至矧。博覽多識，名重州黨。初辟太尉府，舉茂才，遷待御史。閹宦擅朝，英賢被害，豐乃棄官歸家。袁紹起義，卑辭厚幣以招致豐，豐以王室多難，志存匡救，乃應紹命，以為別駕。勸紹迎天子，紹不納。紹後用豐謀，以平公孫瓚。逢紀憚豐亮直，數讒之於紹，紹遂忌豐。紹軍之敗也，土崩奔北，師徒略盡，軍皆拊膺而泣曰：「向令田豐在此，不至於是也。」紹謂逢紀曰：「冀州人聞吾軍敗，皆當念吾，惟田別駕前諫止吾，與眾不同，吾亦慚見之。」紀復曰：「豐聞將軍之退，拊手大笑，喜其言之中也。」紹於是有害豐之意。初，太祖聞豐不從戎，喜曰：「紹必敗矣。」及紹奔遁，復曰：「向使紹用田別駕計，尚未可知也。」孫盛曰：觀田豐、沮授之謀，雖良、平何以過之？故君貴審才，臣尚量主；君用忠良，則伯王之業隆，臣奉闇后，則覆亡之禍至：存亡榮辱，常必由茲。豐知紹將敗，敗則己必死，甘冒虎口以盡忠規，烈士之於所事，慮不存己。夫諸侯之臣，義有去就，況豐與紹非純臣乎！詩云「逝將去汝，適彼樂土」，言去亂邦，就有道可也。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
Of Jì Province's cities and towns many rebelled, [Yuán] Shào again struck and settled them. From since his army's defeat afterward he fell ill, Seventh Year [202] in distress died.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
冀州城邑多叛，紹復擊定之。自軍敗後發病，七年，憂死。
:::
:::

### Sons Tán, Xī, Shàng  {.unnumbered #yuantan #yuanxi #yuanshang}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
[Yuán] Shào's favorite and youngest son [Yuán] Shàng was handsome and beautiful, wished to make him his successor but had not made it explicit. <a href="#annotation-62" id="source-61">[62]</a> Shěn Pèi, Páng Jì, with Xīn Píng, Guō Tú fought for power, [Shěn] Pèi, [Páng] Jì sided with [Yuán] Shàng, [Xīn] Píng, [Guō] Tú sighed with [Yuán] Tán. The multitudes because [Yuán] Tán was the eldest wished to establish him. [Shěn] Pèi and the rest feared if [Yuán] Tán was established then [Xīn] Píng and the rest would harm them, relied on [Yuán] Shào's previous intentions, and so served supported [Yuán] Shàng to succeeded [Yuán] Shào's positions. [Yuán] Tán arrived, could not be established, declared himself Chariots and Cavalry General. From this [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng had discord. Tàizǔ campaigned north against [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Tán's army stationed Líyáng. [Yuán] Shàng gave a few troops to [Yuán] Tán, but sent [Páng] Jì to follow [Yuán] Tán. [Yuán] Tán requested additional troops, [Shěn] Pèi and the rest discussed and did not give them. [Yuán] Tán was angry, killed [Páng] Jì. <a href="#annotation-63" id="source-62">[63]</a> Tàizǔ crossed the Hé and attacked [Yuán] Tán, [Yuán] Tán reported the emergency to [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Shàng wished to divide troops to reinforce [Yuán] Tán, feared that [Yuán] Tán would then seize away his multitudes, and so had Shěn Pèi defend Yè, [Yuán] Shàng personally commanded troops to assist [Yuán] Tán, with Tàizǔ resisting one another at Líyáng. From the Ninth Moon [202 Oct 4 - Nov 2] reaching to the Second Moon [203 Mar 1 - Mar 30] greatly battled below the city walls, [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng were defeated and retreated, entered the city walls to defend. Tàizǔ was about to encircle them, then in the night they escaped. Pursued reaching Yè, collected their wheat, captured Yīn'ān, led the army to return to Xǔ. Tàizǔ campaigned south against Jīng Province, the army reached Xīpíng. [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng therefore raised troops to attack one another, [Yuán] Tán was defeated and fled to Píngyuán. [Yuán] Shàng attacked him urgently, [Yuán] Tán sent Xīn Pí to visit Tàizǔ to request rescue. Tàizǔ thus returned to rescue [Yuán] Tán, Tenth Moon [203 Nov 22 - Dec 20] reached Líyáng. <a href="#annotation-64" id="source-64">[64]</a> [Yuán] Shàng heard that Tàizǔ had gone north, released Píngyuán and returned to Yè. His officers Lǚ Kuàng and Lǚ Xiáng rebelled against [Yuán] Shàng to submit to Tàizǔ, [Yuán] Tán further secretly carved General's seals to lend to Kuàng and Xiáng. Tàizǔ knew [Yuán] Tán was being deceitful, formed a marriage alliance to calm him, and then led the army to return. [Yuán] Shàng had Shěn Pèi and Sū Yóu defend Yè and again attacked [Yuán] Tán at Píngyuán. Tàizǔ advanced the arm and was about to attack Yè, arrived at the Huán river, from Yè by fifty lǐ, [Sū] Yóu wished to be inside support, the plan leaked, he with [Shěn] Pèi battled inside the city, was defeated, went out and fled to Tàizǔ. Tàizǔ therefore advanced and attacked them, making earthen tunnels, [Shěn] Pèi also in the inside made moats to block them. [Shěn] Pèi's officer Féng Lǐ opened a sortie gate^[A sortie gate (tūmén) was a smaller gate in the city walls used by the defenders to send out sorties for surprise attacks and raids against besiegers.] to let in Tàizǔ's troops of over three hundred people, [Shěn] Pèi discovered it, from the city wall's top used large stones to strike the sortie interior screen gate, the screen gate closed, those that entered were all lost. Tàizǔ therefore encircled them, made a moat, circumference forty lǐ, at first ordering it shallow, to appear as if it could be crossed. [Shěn] Pèi saw from afar and laughed at it, and did not go out to contest the advantage. Tàizǔ in one night dug it, width and depth two zhàng, breached the Zhāng river to irrigate it. From the Fifth Moon [204 Jun 16 - Jul 14] reaching to the Eighth Moon [204 Sep 12 - Oct 11], inside the city the starved to death were over half. [Yuán] Shàng heard that Yè was in emergency, commanded troops of over ten thousand men to return to rescue it, following the western mountains to come, east reaching Yángpíng precinct, from Yè by seventy lǐ, overlooking the Fǔ river, lit fires to signal to the city interior, the city interior also lit fires to answer them. [Shěn] Pèi sent out troops to the city's north, wishing to with [Yuán] Shàng together break the encirclement. Tàizǔ opposed and struck them, defeated and returned, [Yuán] Shàng also was defeated and fled, along the bend of the Zhāng making camp, Tàizǔ therefore went to encircle him, it was not yet complete, [Yuán] Shàng was afraid and sent Yīn Kuí and Chén Lín to ask to surrender, did not listen. [Yuán] Shàng returned to flee to Lànkǒu, advanced to again encircle him urgently, his officers Mǎ Yán and others on facing the battle lines surrendered, the multitudes greatly collapsed, [Yuán] Shàng fled to Zhōngshān. Completely collected his heavy baggage, obtained [Yuán] Shàng's seal and ribbon, Stave and Battle-Ax and his clothes and things, to show to his family, the city interior collapsed in despair. [Shěn] Pèi's elder brother's Son [Shěn] Róng defended the east gate, in the night opened the gate to let in Tàizǔ's troops. With [Shěn] Pèi battled inside the city, captured alive [Shěn] Pèi. [Shěn] Pèi's voice and spirit was strong and fierce, to the end without yielding statements, of those who saw none did not sigh. Therefore beheaded him. <a href="#annotation-65" id="source-65">[65]</a> Gāo Gàn with Bìng Province surrendered, restored [Gāo] Gàn as Inspector.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
紹愛少子尚，貌美，欲以為後而未顯。〔一〕審配、逢紀與辛評、郭圖爭權，配、紀與尚比，評、圖與譚比。眾以譚長，欲立之。配等恐譚立而評等為己害，緣紹素意，乃奉尚代紹位。譚至，不得立，自號車騎將軍。由是譚、尚有隙。太祖北征譚、尚。譚軍黎陽，尚少與譚兵，而使逢紀從譚。譚求益兵，配等議不與。譚怒，殺紀。〔二〕太祖渡河攻譚，譚告急於尚。尚欲分兵益譚，恐譚遂奪其眾，乃使審配守鄴，尚自將兵助譚，與太祖相拒於黎陽。自〔二〕〔九〕月至（九）〔二〕月，大戰城下，譚、尚敗退，入城守。太祖將圍之，乃夜遁。追至鄴，收其麥，拔陰安，引軍還許。太祖南征荊州，軍至西平。譚、尚遂舉兵相攻，譚敗奔平原。尚攻之急，譚遣辛毗詣太祖請救。太祖乃還救譚，十月至黎陽。〔三〕尚聞太祖北，釋平原還鄴。其將呂曠、呂翔叛尚歸太祖，譚復陰刻將軍印假曠、翔。太祖知譚詐，與結婚以安之，乃引軍還。尚使審配、蘇由守鄴，復攻譚平原。太祖進軍將攻鄴，到洹水，去鄴五十里，由欲為內應，謀泄，與配戰城中，敗，出奔太祖。太祖遂進攻之，為地道，配亦於內作塹以當之。配將馮禮開突門，內太祖兵三百餘人，配覺之，從城上以大石擊突中柵門，柵門閉，入者皆沒。太祖遂圍之，為塹，周四十里，初令淺，示若可越。配望而笑之，不出爭利。太祖一夜掘之，廣深二丈，決漳水以灌之，自五月至八月，城中餓死者過半。尚聞鄴急，將兵萬餘人還救之，依西山來，東至陽平亭，去鄴十七里，臨滏水，舉火以示城中，城中亦舉火相應。配出兵城北，欲與尚對決圍。太祖逆擊之，敗還，尚亦破走，依曲漳為營，太祖遂圍之。未合，尚懼，遣陰夔、陳琳乞降，不聽。尚還走濫口，進復圍之急，其將馬延等臨陳降，眾大潰，尚奔中山。盡收其輜重，得尚印綬、節鉞及衣物，以示其家，城中崩沮。配兄子榮守東門，夜開門內太祖兵，與配戰城中，生禽配。配聲氣壯烈，終無撓辭，見者莫不歎息。遂斬之。〔四〕高幹以并州降，復以幹為刺史。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-62" id="annotation-62">[62]</a> Diǎnlùn states: [Yuán] Tán was elder and intelligent, [Yuán] Shàng was younger and beautiful. [Yuán] Shào's wife Liú-shì favored [Yuán] Shàng, repeatedly praising his talent, [Yuán] Shào also marveled at his appearance, wished to have him be successor, had not yet made it explicit when [Yuán] Shào died. Liú-shì by nature was ruthless and jealous, when [Yuán] Shào died, the corpse not yet in the coffin, his favorite concubines of five women, Liú completely killed them. Believing that the dead had awareness, and they would again meet [Yuán] Shào below the ground, thus shaved the heads and blackened the faces to ruin their appearances. [Yuán] Shàng also completely killed the families of the deceased [concubines].
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔一〕　典論曰：譚長而惠，尚少而美。紹妻劉氏愛尚，數稱其才，紹亦奇其貌，欲以為後，未顯而紹死。劉氏性酷妒，紹死，僵尸未殯，寵妾五人，劉盡殺之。以為死者有知，當復見紹於地下，乃髡頭墨面以毀其形。尚又為盡殺死者之家。
:::
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" #pangji}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-63" id="annotation-63">[63]</a> Yīngxióng jì states: [Páng] Jì appellation Yuántú. Previously, [Yuán] Shào left Dǒng Zhuó and went out to flee, with Xǔ Yōu and [Páng] Jì together visiting Jì Province, [Yuán] Shào, because [Páng] Jì was intelligent and had strategy, was extremely close with and trusted him, with him together raising affairs. Later Shěn Pèi was appointed and employed, with [Páng] Jì not friendly. Someone slandered [Shěn] Pèi to [Yuán] Shào, [Yuán] Shào asked [Páng] Jì, [Páng] Jì appraised: "[Shěn] Pèi is naturally stern and direct, the integrity of the ancients, you should not suspect him." [Yuán] Shào said: "Do you not hate him?" [Páng] Jì answered stating: "In former days our conflict was a personal affair, now what I explain is a state affair." [Yuán] Shào praised this, and in the end did not dismiss [Shěn] Pèi. [Shěn] Pèi because of this instead with [Páng] Jì became close and friendly.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　英雄記曰：紀字元圖。初，紹去董卓出奔，與許攸及紀俱詣冀州，紹以紀聰達有計策，甚親信之，與共舉事。後審配任用，與紀不睦。或有讒配于紹，紹問紀，紀稱「配天性烈直，古人之節，不宜疑之」。紹曰：「君不惡之邪？」紀答曰：「先日所爭者私情，今所陳者國事。」紹善之，卒不廢配。配由是更與紀為親善。
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
<a href="#source-64" id="annotation-64">[64]</a> Wèi-shì Chūnqiū records Liú Biào's sent letter to [Yuán] Tán stating: "Heaven has sent down calamity, disaster and difficulty abundantly flow, Your Honored Father has perished, the Four Seas lament in heart. Worthy Scion you inherit the command, far and near give their gaze, all wishing to spread their total strength, to throw themselves in service to the Alliance Leader, that even on the day of death, yet the desire survives. How could one have expected blue flies to fly on the standards and flags,^[Qīng Yíng "Blue Flies" is a song in the Shī jīng. Blue flies are a metaphor for slanderers spreading contamination through their accusations.] limitless drifting into two camps, causing the legs and arms to be separated into two bodies, back and spine severed into different bodies! In the past from the Three Kings and Five Hegemons, down reaching to the Warring States, fathers and sons destroyed one another, indeed there was such. However some wished to achieve a King's enterprise, some wished to settle hegemon's achievement, some wished to exalt the clan master, some wished to solidfy the senior succession, never once was there a discarding of kin to join the foreign, pulling out their base roots, and yet able to raise an enterprise and reach achievement, and bequeath blessings to their later generations. As for Qí Xiāng avenging a grudge of nine generations,^[According to the Gōngyáng Zhuàn, Duke Zhuāng Fourth Year, Duke Xiāng of Qí destroyed Jǐ state to avenge a nine generation blood feud.] Shì Gài finishing Xún Yǎn's task,^[According to the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Xiāng Nineteenth Year, after the Jìn state military commander Xún Yǎn died, the deputy commander Shì Gài took it upon himself to complete Xún Yǎn's work in attacking the campaign against Qí state.] for this reason the Chūnqiū glorified their righteousness, noble men praised their faithfulness. Bóyóu's hatred of Qí does not compare to your father's anger against Cáo,^[Bóyóu was the appellation of Xún Yǎn.] Xuān-zǐ's inheritance of the enterprise does not compare to your benevolent lordship's succession to command.^[Xuān-zǐ was the posthumous name of Shì Gài.] Moreover a noble man in avoiding troubles does not go to an enemy state, how can you forget the Former Excellency's resentments, abandon the loves of closest kin, become a warning for ten thousand generations, and leave behind a disgrace for the entire alliance? The arrogance of Jìzhōu not being fraternal,^[Yuán Shàng is referred to by his office as Governor of Jì Province (jìzhōu).] is already the situation, Your Benevolent Lordship should subdue your ambitions and endure the personal humilliation, to take rectifying the state as your concern. Although you meet with hatred from the madame [Liú], it does not compare to Zhèng Zhuāng's with Jiāng-shì,^[According to the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Yǐn Inaugural Year, Jiāng-shì plotted against her elder son Duke Zhuāng of Zhèng, attempting to replace him with her younger son.] and the enmity between elder and younger brothers does not compare to Chónghuá's with Xiàng's arrogance.^[Chónghuá was the personal name of Shùn, one of the Five Emperors. His younger brother Xiàng resented and repeatedly plotted against him.] However Duke Zhuāng had the joy of the Great Tunnel,^[According to the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Yǐn Inaugural Year, after defeating his mother's plot against him, Duke Zhuāng swore he would never see his mother again until they reached the underworld. Later he regretted this, and they met again in the Great Tunnel, the underground passage way into a tomb, to technically fulfill his oath while also allowing a reconciliation.] Xiàng received the enfeoffment of Yǒubí. May you abandon your former indignation, distantly consider old righteousness, and return to being a mother's son and elder and younger brothers as before." Also sent a letter to [Yuán] Shàng stating: "Knowing that the change arose from Xīn [Píng] and Guō [Tú], disaster entangles those of the same parent, recalling the legacies of È Bó and Shí Shěn,^[È Bó and Shí Shěn were two legendary figures from high antiquity, said to be brothers that warred for a long time until they were separated to opposite ends of hte world. See the Zuǒ Zhuàn Duke Zhāo Inaugural Year.] forgetting the righteousness of Chángdì's 'death and mourning,'^[Chángdì is a song in the Shī jīng, 'death and mourning' (sǐ sàng) a line in the lyrics, singing that brothers must stand together in times of crisis.] personally resorting to shield and spear, stiff corpses and flowing blood, hearing of it I am choked in sobs, though surviving yet like one dead. In the pst Xuānyuán had the battle of Zhuōlù, Zhōu Wǔ had the brigades of Shāng and Yǎn, both were in order to cut down and eliminate filth and harm and to settle the King's enterprise, not disputes of strong or weak or resentments of joy or anger. Therefore although they exterminated kin it was not a fault, executed elder brothers but did not injure righteousness. Now you two lords have just begun to inherit a vast enterprise, continue the former course, advancing there is the consideration of the country toppling in peril, retreating there is the burden of the Former Excellency's remaining regrets, and should only take righteousness as your concern, only the state as your well-being. Why? Metal and wood, water and fire, by hard or soft relieve one another, only then afterward is one able to obtain their harmony, enabling them to be used for the people. Now Qīngzhōu^[This refers to Yuán Tán by his office as Inspector of Qīng Province (qīngzhōu cìshǐ).] by nature is harsh and rash, confused as to wrong and right. Your Benevolent Lordship is measured and generous in ample abundance, and should with the large cover the small, with the superior tolerate the inferior, first eliminate Cáo Cāo to finish the Former Excellency's regrets, after the matter is settled, then discuss calculations of wrong and right, would that not be very excellent? If you leave attention on far-reaching plans, restrain yourself and return to courtesy, you should shake the banners and charge ahead, together encouraging the Ruling House. If you remain deluded and do not turn back, disobedient and do not reform, then the Hú and Yí will have words of ridicule and reproach, all the more for our alliance, could it ever again devote strength for your lordship's campaigns? This is Hán Lú and Dōngguō exhausted themselves at the beginning and so leaving the field farmer with the catch.^[Hán Lú and Dōngguō were legendary hunting dogs of antiquity. A parable tells that the two chased a hare, exhausting themselves, allowing a bystander farmer to reap the reward of their effort.] I excitedly leap and crane nekc to watch, hoping to hear the sound of peace and unity. If it is successful, then the Yuán clan with with the Hàn rise or fall. If not, then the alliance will forever be without hope." [Yuán] Tán and [Yuán] Shàng completely would not follow this.

Hàn Jìn Chūnqiū records Shěn Pèi's proffered letter to [Yuán] Tán stating: "By the principles of the Chūnqiū, a state's lord dies for the State Altars, a loyal minister dies for the King's command. If there is a plot to endager the Ancestral Temple, damage and disorder the country, in the King's network of order and law, close kin and distant relation are the same. Therefore Zhōu-gōng shed tears and carried out the judgment on Guǎn and Cài,^[Zhōu-gōng suppressed the rebellions of his own brothers Guǎn and Cài.] Jìyǒu sobbed and sighed and yet enacted the poisoning of Zhēnshū.^[Jìyǒu arranged for his own relative Zhēnshū to be poisoned for plotting against the ruling family.] Why was this? Righteousness is heavy and people are light, the matters could not be but so. In the past Wèi Duke Líng deposed Kuǎikuì and established Zhé, Kuǎikuì was immoral, entered Qī to usurp, the Wèi brigades attacked him. The Chūnqiū Zhuàn states: "By the righteousness of Shí Màn'gǔ, it was permissible to resist him." Therefore Kuǎikuì in the end obtained the punishment of rebellion, and Màn'gǔ forever enjoyed the fame of a loyal minister. If father and son are yet like this, how much more for elder and younger brothers? In the past the Former Excellency deposed and dismissed you General to continue the lineage of his worthy elder brother, and established our General as the legitimate successor, above reported it to the ancestral spirits, below wrote it in the geneoalogical records, the Former Excellency called you General as his elder brother's son, you General called the Former Excellency as father's younger brother, Within the Seas far and near, who did not hear of it?^[At some point Yuán Tán was adopted over to continue the lineage of Yuán Shào's elder brother, making him a legal nephew rather than son of Yuán Shào. This process involved a ritual declaration in the family ancestral shrines to inform the ancestors, and a record of the adoption in the family geneological records.] Moreover on the day the Former Excellency departed the world, our General wore course mourning clothes and resided in the hut, while you General mourned in the plaster room, the separation of outside and inside, by this was all the more clear.^[Yuán Shàng observed the highest level of mourning, wearing the mourning clothes called zhǎnshuāi, and resided in the ritual mourning hut near the grave, while Yuán Tán observed a lesser form of mourning. This reflected Yuán Tán's changed status as a legal nephew rather than son of Yuán Shào.] At the time the treacherous minister Páng Jì absurdly drew legs on a snake,^[This is a reference to a story of an art competition. Painters competed to see who could draw a snake the fastest. The first to finish had beaten the others so quickly that he then drew legs on the snake, but the second to finish then claimed the prize by arguing that snakes did not have legs.] deceitful statements of flattery, spreading chaos between closest kin, you General exerted your awe-inspiring fury, executed him without time to delay, our General also received the command and approved the decree, applying severe punishments. From then afterward, the abscess was pierced and drained, bone and flesh without the finest hair of suspicion, ministers that doubted themselves all preserved the fortune of preserved lives. Therefore all sent strong Hú, chose and mandated famed officers, prepared and organized equipment and weapons, selected battle servicemen, exhausted the wealth of the office treasuries, spent the produce of the provisions and lands, thus in order to supply and support you General, what request was not fulfilled? Lord and minister lead one another, together guarded banner and flag, in battle as the flight of geese, in taxation as the main income, although they poured out the granaries and overturned the storehouses, stripping and flaying the people of resources, above and below were happy to support, none dared complain of the labors. Why was this? To push forward the longing feelings of bare loyalty, use up the livers and brains of every hosuehold, lips and teeth, cheekbone and jaw, not treating mutual support as favors. It was said that we were with your General's heart united and alike in intention, mingled and uniform as one body, certain to combine power and match strength, to resist the invaders and pacify the house. How could one have planned for the vicious danger of men of slander and evil, forming fabrications without basis, enticing and guiding treasonous profiteering, to reach to causing you General to suddenly turn and change plans, forget the benevolence of filial piety and fraternity, listen to the plots of jackals and wolves, falsely claim the Former Excellency's statement on deposing and establishing, violate the nearby position of observing mourning, pervert the coherence of the ordered network, with no regard for the integrity of rebellion or obedience, rashly replacing the master of Jì Province, wishing to interfere in the succession to the Former Excellency. Therefore you unleased troops to plunder and pillage, slaughtered cities and killed clerks, interlocked corpses filling the fields, stripped civilians covering the wilds, some having shaved and stripped of hair or skin, cut and severed limbs and bodies, the vengeful ghosts pained in the netherworld, the wounded screaming in the grasses and thorns. Also you then plotted to capture Yè city, promising to bestow the Qín and Hú with wealth and women, in advance having divisions of borders. Some heard of the announced order to the clerks and servicemen saying: 'Although I have an aged mother, I will have her body remain intact [after death] and nothing more.' Those that heard this speech, none were not stunned and lost breath, mourning in heart and wiping tears, causing the Dowager Madame distress and grief and indignant sorrow in the hall rooms, our province's lord and ministers and servicemen and friends could barely sleep and sighed and grief, not knowing what to do with their hands and feet. Considering the wish to quiet the brigades and salute in silence to listen to the plans to enact affairs, then we fear to violate the Chūnqiū's integrity to serve to death, leaving on the Dowager Madame an immeasurable disaster, and tearing down the Former Excellency's towering enterprise. Moreover the Three Armies were indignant and resentful, the people filled with private anger, our General's could not obtain his wishes, so that it reached to the battle of Guǎntáo. At the time outside we resisted the crisis, inside truly begged for the crime, but did not meet with pardon, and further the Túgè were treacherous in heart, while facing the battle lines rebelled and betrayed. Our General advanced and withdrew without achievement, head and tail received enemies, led the army to flee and escape, not daring to take leave. Also we said that you General would slightly bequeath the benevolence toward in, confer the kindness of a sluggish pursuit, but yet you then you sought the footprints and followed the tracks, with no way to flee for our lives. Cornered beasts will certainly fight, to challenge stern action, and so General your brigades and regiments collapsed apart, this was not by the strength of men, it was by Heaven's will. From then afterward again we hoped you General would change your ways and reform to come, subdue self and return to courtesy, seek to return to fraternal^[The word for fraternal here is Kǒnghuái "deep yearning," a quote from the Shījīng: "Brothers in deep yearning" (xiōngdì kǒnghuái).] love as before, but instead you indulged your passions to unleash your rage, hastening to destroy family and clan, standing like a crane,^[Standing like a crane (qǐ zhǒng hè lì) is a visual metaphor for eager anticipation and desire.] joining with external enemy, scattering spearpoints into the fire, spreading and increasing venemous stings, fire beacons answer one another, wading blood across a thousand lǐ, abandoned cities and distressed people, craning neck in grief and resentment, even if one wished not to rescue it, how could it be stopped? Therefore we then led army to turn east, protecting the proper boundary borders, though near the suburb ramparts, not yet infringing on the frontier region, thus seeing the banners and flags, can we not perpetually sigh? [We, Shěn] Pèi and the rest serve as the Former Excellency's family ministers, received the command to depose and establish, while [Guō] Tú and the rest subverted the state and disordered the family, for which ritual has standard punishments. Therefore we exert the resources of our poor province, to eliminate the affliction upon you General. If then heaven awakens your heart, to early enact his punishment, then our General will crawl and sorrowfully wail above the palm of your hand General, and we [Shěn] Pèi and the rest also strip body and bare form to wait for the punishment of hatchet and battle-ax. If you certainly will not reform, bringing about the state's downfall, if [Guō] Tú's head does not hang high, our army will not turn away. May you General in detail consider the situation, and bestow a ring or pendant."^[The jade ring (huán) and jade pendant (jué) could be used in diplomacy to convey intentions. The complete ring indicated a wish to return and reconcile. The pendant was a notched incomplete ring, representing a definitive break and determination to fight.]

Diǎnlüè states: [Yuán] Tán obtained the letter and was frustrated, ascended the city walls and sobbed. He was coerced by Guō Tú, also as the troop spearpoints were repeatedly engaged, therefore the battle could not be resolved.

〔三〕　魏氏春秋載劉表遺譚書曰：「天篤降害，禍難殷流，尊公殂殞，四海悼心。賢胤承統，遐邇屬望，咸欲展布旅力，以投盟主，雖亡之日，猶存之願也。何寤青蠅飛於干旍，無極游於二壘，使股肱分為二體，背膂絕為異身！昔三王五伯，下及戰國，父子相殘，蓋有之矣；然或欲以成王業，或欲以定霸功，或欲以顯宗主，或欲以固冢嗣，未有棄親即異，扤其本根，而能崇業濟功，垂祚後世者也。若齊襄復九世之讎，士匄卒荀偃之事，是故春秋美其義，君子稱其信。夫伯游之恨于齊，未若（文公）〔太公〕之忿曹；宣子之承業，未若仁君之繼統也。且君子之違難不適讎國，豈可忘先君之怨，棄至親之好，為萬世之戒，遺同盟之恥哉！冀州不弟之傲，既已然矣；仁君當降志辱身，以匡國為務；雖見憎於夫人，未若鄭莊之於姜氏，兄弟之嫌，未若重華之於象傲也。然莊公有大隧之樂，象受有鼻之封。願棄捐前忿，遠思舊義，復為母子昆弟如初。」又遺尚書曰：「知變起辛、郭，禍結同生，追閼伯、實沈之蹤，忘常棣死喪之義，親尋干戈，僵尸流血，聞之哽咽，雖存若亡。昔軒轅有涿鹿之戰，周武有商、奄之師，皆所以翦除穢害而定王業，非彊弱之（事）爭，喜怒之忿也。故雖滅親不為尤，誅兄不傷義。今二君初承洪業，纂繼前軌，進有國家傾危之慮，退有先公遺恨之負，當唯義是務，唯國是康。何者？金木水火以剛柔相濟，然後克得其和，能為民用。今青州天性峭急，迷于曲直。仁君度數弘廣，綽然有餘，當以大包小，以優容劣，先除曹操以卒先公之恨，事定之後，乃議曲直之計，不亦善乎！若留神遠圖，克己復禮，當振旆長驅，共獎王室，若迷而不反，違而無改，則胡夷將有誚讓之言，況我同盟，復能戮力為君之役哉？此韓盧、東郭自困於前而遺田父之獲者也。憤踴鶴望，冀聞和同之聲。若其泰也，則袁族其與漢升降乎！如其否也，則同盟永無望矣。」譚、尚盡不從。漢晉春秋載審配獻書於譚曰：「春秋之義，國君死社稷，忠臣死王命。苟有圖危宗廟，敗亂國家，王綱典律，親疏一也。是以周公垂泣而蔽管、蔡之獄，季友歔欷而行鍼叔之鴆。何則？義重人輕，事不得已也。昔衛靈公廢蒯聵而立輒，蒯聵為不道，入戚以篡，衛師伐之。春秋傳曰：『以石曼姑之義，為可以拒之。』是以蒯聵終獲叛逆之罪，而曼姑永享忠臣之名。父子猶然，豈況兄弟乎！昔先公廢絀將軍以續賢兄，立我將軍以為適嗣，上告祖靈，下書譜牒，先公謂將軍為兄子，將軍謂先公為叔父，海內遠近，誰不備聞？且先公即世之日，我將軍斬衰居廬，而將軍齋于堊室，出入之分，於斯益明。是時凶臣逢紀，妄畫蛇足，曲辭諂媚，交亂懿親，將軍奮赫然之怒，誅不旋時，〔我〕將軍亦奉命承旨，加以淫刑。自是之後，癰疽破潰，骨肉無絲髮之嫌，自疑之臣，皆保生全之福。故悉遣彊胡，簡命名將，料整器械，選擇戰士，殫府庫之財，竭食土之實，其所以供奉將軍，何求而不備？君臣相率，共衛旌麾，戰為雁行，賦為幣主，雖傾倉覆庫，翦剝民物，上下欣戴，莫敢告勞。何則？推戀戀忠赤之情，盡家家肝腦之計，脣齒輔車，不相為賜。謂為將軍心合意同，混齊一體，必當并威偶勢，禦寇寧家。何圖凶險讒慝之人，造飾無端，誘導姦利，至令將軍翻然改圖，忘孝友之仁，聽豺狼之謀，誣先公廢立之言，違近者在喪之位，悖紀綱之理，不顧逆順之節，橫易冀州之主，欲當先公之繼。遂放兵鈔撥，屠城殺吏，交尸盈原，裸民滿野，或有髡{髟剔}髮膚，割截支體，冤魂痛於幽冥，創痍號於草棘。又乃圖獲鄴城，許賜秦、胡，財物婦女，豫有分界。或聞告令吏士云：『孤雖有老母，輒使身體完具而已。』聞此言者，莫不驚愕失氣，悼心揮涕，使太夫人憂哀憤懣于堂室，我州君臣士友假寐悲歎，無所措其手足；念欲靜師拱默以聽執事之圖，則懼違春秋死命之節，貽太夫人不測之患，隕先公高世之業。且三軍憤慨，人懷私怒，我將軍辭不獲已，以及館陶之役。是時外為禦難，內實乞罪，既不見赦，而（屠辱谷）〔屠各〕二三其心，臨陳叛戾。我將軍進退無功，首尾受敵，引軍奔避，不敢告辭。亦謂將軍當少垂親親之仁，貺以緩追之惠，而乃尋蹤躡軌，無所逃命。困獸必鬥，以干嚴行，而將軍師旅土崩瓦解，此非人力，乃天意也。是後又望將軍改往修來，克己復禮，追還孔懷如初之愛；而縱情肆怒，趣破家門，企踵鶴立，連結外讎，散鋒於火，播增毒螫，烽煙相望，涉血千里，遺城厄民，引領悲怨，雖欲勿救，惡得已哉！故遂引軍東轅，保正疆埸，雖近郊壘，未侵境域，然望旌麾，能不永歎？配等備先公家臣，奉廢立之命。而圖等干國亂家，禮有常刑。故奮敝州之賦，以除將軍之疾，若乃天啟于心，早行其誅，則我將軍匍匐悲號于將軍股掌之上，配等亦袒躬布體以待斧鉞之刑。若必不悛，有以國斃，圖頭不縣，軍不旋踵。願將軍詳度事宜，錫以環玦。」典略曰：譚得書悵然，登城而泣。既劫于郭圖，亦以兵鋒累交，遂戰不解。
:::

::: {.columns}

<a href="#source-65" id="annotation-65">[65]</a> Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Shěn] Pèi appellation Zhèngnán was a Wèi prefecture man, in youth fiercely loyal and ardently fervent, having integrity that could not be violated. When Yuán Shào was designated Jì Province, entrusted with appointment as belly and heart, becoming Manager Central and Separate Carriage, further presiding over the Tent Office. Previously, when [Yuán] Tán departed, Xīn Pí's and Guō Tú's families were all called and able to get out, but Xīn Píng's family alone was arrested. When [Shěn] Pèi's elder brother's son opened the city gates to let in the troops, at the time [Shěn] Pèi was at the city wall's southeast corner tower top, looked out and saw Tàizǔ's troops entering, was furious that Xīn and Guō had ruined Jì Province, and so sent someone to gallop to visit Yè prison, directing to kill [Xīn Píng] Zhòngzhì's family. At the time Xīn Pí was in the army, heard the gates were open, galloped to run to visit the prison, wishing to release his elder brother's family, his elder brother's family was already dead. that day captured alive [Shěn] Pèi, brought to visit below the curtains, Xīn Pí and others opposed him and with horsewhips struck his head, cursing him stating: "Slave, today you are truly dead!" [Shěn] Pèi looked back and said: "You dogs, exactly because of you all our Jì Province is ruined, I regret not being able to kill you! Moreover today are you able to kill or spare me?" Shortly afterward the Excellency [Cáo Cāo] invited him to meet, said to [Shěn] Pèi: "Do you know who opened your city gate?" [Shěn] Pèi said: "I do not know." Said: "It was your boy [Shěn] Róng." [Shěn] Pèi said: "The petty boy was so not worth employing that it came to this!" The Excellency furhter said: "On a previous day I was walking the encirclement, why were there so many crossbows?" [Shěn] Pèi said: "I only regret they were too few!" The Excellency said: "You are loyal to the Yuán clan father and sons, and also surely could not not be so." He had the intention to spare him. [Shěn] Pèi was without statements of yielding, and further Xīn Pí and the rest wailed and wept without end, and so killed him. Previously, Jì Province man Zhāng Zǐqiān in advance surrendered, formerly with [Shěn] Pèi was not friendly, laughed and spoke to [Shěn] Pèi stating: "Zhèngnán, how do you care to me now?" [Shěn] Pèi in stern voice said: "You are a surrendered caitiff, Shěn Pèi is a loyal minister, even if death how can I be compared to you living?" Facing the execution enactment, he shouted at the soldiers holding him to have him face north, stating: "My lord is in the north."

Lè Zī's Shaāyáng Gōng Zàijì and Yuán Wěi's Xiàn-dì Chūnqiū both say that when Tàizǔ's troops entered the city, Shěn Pèi battled in the gates, was defeated, and fled into a well, and in the well captured him. Your Servant Sōngzhī believes: [Shěn] Pèi was an ardent martyr of an era, the Yuán clan's servant to the death, how could it be on the day of his fortunes ending, that he would hide his body in a well, that this is difficult to trust, is truly easy to understand. It is unknown what kind of men were the sorts as [Lè] Zī and [Yuán] Wěi, to be unable to recognize and destinguish right and wrong, and yet recklessly play with writing brush and ink, rashly creating bizarre heresy, to circulate their books. Sorts like this, are exactly sufficient to deceive in sight and sound, to confuse and mislead the later born. They truly are criminals to historical record, what understanding scholars would not accept.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔四〕　先賢行狀曰：配字正南，魏郡人，少忠烈慷慨，有不可犯之節。袁紹領冀州，委以腹心之任，以為治中別駕，并總幕府。初，譚之去，皆呼辛毗、郭圖家得出，而辛評家獨被收。及配兄子開城門內兵，時配在城東南角樓上，望見太祖兵入，忿辛、郭壞敗冀州，乃遣人馳詣鄴獄，指殺仲治家。是時，辛毗在軍，聞門開，馳走詣獄，欲解其兄家，兄家已死。是日生縛配，將詣帳下，辛毗等逆以馬鞭擊其頭，罵之曰：「奴，汝今日真死矣！」配顧曰：「狗輩，正由汝曹破我冀州，恨不得殺汝也！且汝今日能殺生我邪？」有頃，公引見，謂配：「知誰開卿城門？」配曰：「不知也。」曰：「自卿（文）〔子〕榮耳。」配曰：「小兒不足用乃至此！」公復謂曰：「曩日孤之行圍，何弩之多也？」配曰：「恨其少耳！」公曰：「卿忠于袁氏父子，亦自不得不爾也。」有意欲活之。配既無撓辭，而辛毗等號哭不已，乃殺之。初，冀州人張子謙先降，素與配不善，笑謂配曰：「正南，卿竟何如我？」配厲聲曰：「汝為降虜，審配為忠臣，雖死，豈若汝生邪！」臨行刑，叱持兵者令北向，曰：「我君在北。」樂資山陽公載記及袁暐獻帝春秋並云太祖兵入城，審配戰于門中，既敗，逃于井中，於井獲之。臣松之以為配一代之烈士，袁氏之死臣，豈當數窮之日，方逃身于井，此之難信，誠為易了。不知資、暐之徒竟為何人，未能識別然否，而輕弄翰墨，妄生異端，以行其書。如此之類，正足以誣罔視聽，疑誤後生矣。寔史籍之罪人，達學之所不取者也。
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
When Tàizǔ was besieging Yè, [Yuán] Tán captured Gānlíng, Ānpíng, Bóhǎi, Héjiān, attacked [Yuán] Shàng at Zhōngshān. [Yuán] Shàng fled to Gù'ān to follow [Yuán] Xī, [Yuán] Tán completely collected his multitudes. Tàizǔ was about to suppress him, [Yuán] Tán thus evacuated Píngyuán, consolidated Nánpí, personally garrisoned Lóngcòu. Twelfth Moon [205 Jan 8 - Feb 6], Tàizǔ's army was at his gates, [Yuán] Tán did not go out, in the night escaped to flee to Nánpí, overlooking Qīnghé and garrisoned. Tenth Year Standard Moon [205 Feb 7 - Mar 7], attacked and captured it, beheaded [Yuán] Tán and [Guō] Tú and others. [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng were by their officers Jiāo Chù and Zhāng Nán attacked, fled to Liáoxī's Wūhuán. [Jiāo] Chù declared himself Yōu Province Inspector, compelled the various prefecture administrators and magistrates and chiefs to turn back on the Yuán and turn to the Cáo, lining up troops of several tens of thousands, killing a white horse for [blood] oath, the order stating: "Those that violate the command are beheaded." Of the multitudes none dared speak, each in their sequence drank [the sacrificial blood]. On reaching Separate Carriage Hán Héng, he said: "I received generous favor from Excellency Yuán, father and sons, now they are defeated and destroyed, my wisdom could not save them, my valor could not die for them, in terms of righteousness I was deficient. As for then facing north to the Cáo clan, it is not what I am able to do." The entire seated assembly for [Hán] Héng lost color. [Jiāo] Chú said: "In raising great affairs, one must establish great righteousness. Whether affairs are relieved or not, does not depend on one man. We can grant [Hán] Héng his will, to encourage service to one's lord." Gāo Gàn rebelled, seized the Shàngdǎng Administrator, raised troops to defend Húkǒu Pass. Sent Yuè Jìn and Lǐ Diǎn to strike him, had not yet succeeded. Eleventh Year [206], Tàizǔ campaigned against [Gāo] Gàn. [Gāo] Gàn then left his officers Xià Zhāo and Dèng Shēng to defend the city, and personally visited the Xiōngnú Chányú to ask for rescue, did not obtain it, and alone with several cavalry fled, wishing to flee south to Jīng Province, the Shàngluò Commandant captured and beheaded him. <a href="#annotation-66" id="source-66">[66]</a> Twelfth Year [207], Tàizǔ reached Liáoxī to strike the Wūhuán. [Yuán] Shàng and [Yuán] Xī with the Wūhuán opposed the army in battle, was defeated and fled to Liáodōng, Gōngsūn Kāng enticed and beheaded them, sent their heads. <a href="#annotation-67" id="source-67">[67]</a> Tàizǔ highly regarded Hán Héng's integrity, repeatedly recruited him, he did not come, and died at home. <a href="#annotation-68" id="source-68">[68]</a>
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
太祖之圍鄴也，譚略取甘陵、安平、勃海、河間，攻尚於中山。尚走故安從熙，譚悉收其眾。太祖將討之，譚乃拔平原，并南皮，自屯龍湊。十二月，太祖軍其門，譚不出，夜遁奔南皮，臨清河而屯。十年正月，攻拔之，斬譚及圖等。熙、尚為其將焦觸、張南所攻，奔遼西烏丸。觸自號幽州刺史，驅率諸郡太守令長，背袁向曹，陳兵數萬，殺白馬盟，令曰：「違命者斬！」眾莫敢語，各以次歃。至別駕韓珩，曰：「吾受袁公父子厚恩，今其破亡，智不能救，勇不能死，於義闕矣；若乃北面於曹氏，所弗能為也。」一坐為珩失色。觸曰：「夫興大事，當立大義，事之濟否，不待一人，可卒珩志，以勵事君。」高幹叛，執上黨太守，舉兵守壺口關。遣樂進、李典擊之，未拔。十一年，太祖征幹。幹乃留其將夏昭、鄧升守城，自詣匈奴單于求救，不得，獨與數騎亡，欲南奔荊州，上洛都尉捕斬之。〔一〕十二年，太祖至遼西擊烏丸。尚、熙與烏丸逆軍戰，敗走奔遼東，公孫康誘斬之，送其首。〔二〕太祖高韓珩節，屢辟不至，卒於家。〔三〕
:::

<a href="#source-66" id="annotation-66">[66]</a> Diǎnlüè states: Shàngluò Commandant Wáng Yǎn captured Gāo Gàn, for the achievement enfeoffed a Marquess, his wife wept in her room, believing that [Wáng] Yǎn on obtaining riches and honor would further take concubines that would seize away her favor.

〔一〕　典略曰：上洛都尉王琰獲高幹，以功封侯；其妻哭于室，以為琰富貴將更娶妾媵而奪己愛故也。

::: {.columns}

<a href="#source-67" id="annotation-67">[67]</a> Diǎnlüè states: [Yuán] Shàng as a man had valor and strength, wished to seize and take away [Gōngsūn] Kāng's multitudes, with [Yuán] Xī plotted stating: "Now we have arrived, [Gōngsūn] Kāng certainly will meet with us. I wish to with you elder brother personally strike him, with Liáodōng we yet can expand ourselves." [Gōngsūn] Kāng also in his heart calculated stating: "Now to not capture [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng, is to have nothing to offer to the country." Thus he in advance placed is elite and valorous inside the stables, and afterward invited [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng. [Yuán] Xī and [Yuán] Shàng entered, [Gōngsūn] Kāng's hidden troops went out, bound them all, seated on freezing ground. [Yuán] Shàng was cold and requested a seating mat. [Yuán] Xī said: "Our heads are about to travel ten thousand lǐ, what use is a seating mat?" Therefore cut off their heads.

[Yuán] Tán appellation Xiǎnsī. [Yuán] Xī appellation Xiǎnyì. [Yuán] Shàng appellation Xiǎnfǔ.

Wú shū states: [Yuán] Shàng held a younger brother named [Yuán] Mǎi, with [Yuán] Shàng together fled to Liáodōng.

Cáo Mán Zhuàn says [Yuán] Mǎi was [Yuán] Shàng's elder brother's son. It is uncertain.
:::
::: {.column width="5%"}
:::
::: {.column width="25%"}
〔二〕　典略曰：尚為人有勇力，欲奪取康眾，與熙謀曰：「今到，康必相見，欲與兄手擊之，有遼東猶可以自廣也。」康亦心計曰：「今不取熙、尚，無以為說於國家。」乃先置其精勇于廄中，然後請熙、尚。熙、尚入，康伏兵出，皆縛之，坐于凍地。尚寒，求席，熙曰：「頭顱方行萬里，何席之為！」遂斬首。譚，字顯思。熙，字顯奕。尚，字顯甫。吳書曰：尚有弟名買，與尚俱走遼東。曹瞞傳云：買，尚兄子。未詳。
:::

<a href="#source-68" id="annotation-68">[68]</a> Xiānxián Xíngzhuàng states: [Hán] Héng appellation Zǐpèi was a Dài prefecture man, pure and having magnamity. In youth lost his father and mother, served and supported his elder brothers and elder sisters, the clansmen praised his filial piety and fraternal duty.

〔三〕　先賢行狀曰：珩字子佩，代郡人，清粹有雅量。少喪父母，奉養兄姊，宗族稱孝悌焉。
